title: Advanced Displacement Magnitude Prediction in Multi-Material Architected Lattice Structure Beams Using Physics Informed Neural Network Architecture
relevance_to_user: 该论文将PINN应用于多材料点阵结构的位移预测，方法可迁移至生物力学植入物的代理建模。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context, no uncertainty quantification, and validation is only against linear regression on a simple beam problem.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高点阵结构变形预测的精度和物理一致性。
summary_zh.method: 结合PINN与有限元分析，设计专用损失函数融合数据与物理约束。
summary_zh.result: PINN比线性回归R²更高(0.79 vs 0.57)，误差更低。
summary_zh.validation: 与线性回归对比，基于FCC点阵梁的数值算例。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and physical consistency of deformation prediction in architected lattice structures.
summary_en.method: A PINN model is combined with finite element analysis, incorporating a custom loss function that blends data-driven learning with physics-based constraints.
summary_en.result: PINN outperforms linear regression with higher R² (0.7923 vs 0.5686) and lower MSE (0.00017417 vs 0.00036187).
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark on FCC-based lattice beams with five materials under varying loads, compared against linear regression.

relevance_to_user: 该综述总结了基于选区激光熔化成型多孔结构的研究进展，涉及生物医学领域应用，但未具体讨论应力屏蔽或刚度匹配。

summary_zh.method: 综述了多孔结构的类型、性能、设计方法及SLM工艺参数影响。
summary_zh.result: 多孔结构在生物医学和航空航天等领域有广泛优势。
summary_zh.validation: 基于已发表文献的综合评述，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: This review summarizes the state-of-the-art in forming porous structures via selective laser melting for various applications including biomedical.
summary_en.method: The authors survey types, properties, design methods of porous structures and the influence of SLM process parameters on their molding.
summary_en.result: Porous structures fabricated by SLM exhibit excellent properties and are applicable in fields such as medical implants and aerospace.
summary_en.validation: The paper is a literature review without experimental validation or quantitative benchmarking.

title: DeepF-fNet: a physics-informed neural network for vibration isolation optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理信息神经网络框架可用于解决结构优化中的昂贵仿真采样问题，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no uncertainty quantification, and validation is only on a metamaterial case study.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统振动控制方法难以实时优化结构以抑制宽频振动。
summary_zh.method: 提出DeepF-fNet框架，结合DeepONet和物理信息神经网络进行快速参数优化。
summary_zh.result: 在局部共振超材料案例中，计算速度优于遗传算法且结果相当。
summary_zh.validation: 通过超材料隔振案例验证框架有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional active vibration control methods struggle with real-time optimization for suppressing vibrations across a wide frequency range.
summary_en.method: A novel neural network framework, DeepF-fNet, integrates DeepONets with physics-informed neural networks to rapidly identify optimal parameters for vibration suppression.
summary_en.result: The framework outperforms genetic algorithms in computational speed while achieving comparable results in a locally resonant metamaterial case study.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through a simulation case study of a locally resonant metamaterial for vibration isolation.

title: A gradient-based and determinant-free framework for fully Bayesian Gaussian process regression
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过避免行列式计算加速贝叶斯高斯过程回归，可迁移至代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及FEA或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses purely on computational efficiency for Bayesian GPR.

summary_zh.motivation: 全贝叶斯高斯过程回归中核矩阵行列式计算是主要瓶颈
summary_zh.method: 提出基于梯度的无行列式方法，结合高斯积分技巧和哈密顿蒙特卡洛采样
summary_zh.result: 方法可扩展至高维超参数和大核矩阵，GPU加速且内存线性
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试验证了方法的可扩展性和效率

summary_en.motivation: The computational bottleneck of determinant evaluation in fully Bayesian Gaussian process regression limits scalability to large datasets and high-dimensional hyperparameters.
summary_en.method: A gradient-based, determinant-free framework is introduced, combining a Gaussian integration trick to avoid determinant computation with Hamiltonian Monte Carlo sampling.
summary_en.result: The method achieves linear-scaling memory footprint and GPU acceleration, scaling gracefully to high-dimensional hyperparameter spaces and large kernel matrices.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on benchmark problems demonstrate the method's scalability and efficiency.

title: Scalable Bayesian Optimization via Focalized Sparse Gaussian Processes
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种可扩展的贝叶斯优化方法，适用于高维和大样本问题，其稀疏高斯过程技术可迁移到生物力学植入物设计的代理模型优化中。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for implant biomechanics; it focuses on black-box optimization with sparse GPs and demonstrates on robot morphology and musculoskeletal control, not on structural or contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化受限于低维和小样本问题，需扩展至大规模数据。
summary_zh.method: 提出聚焦稀疏高斯过程（focalized GP）和分层优化框架FocalBO。
summary_zh.result: 在机器人形态设计和585维肌肉骨骼系统控制上达到最优性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过机器人形态设计和肌肉骨骼控制仿真验证。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization is limited to low-dimensional and small-budget problems due to cubic complexity of Gaussian processes, motivating scalable methods for larger sample sizes.
summary_en.method: This work proposes focalized Gaussian processes with a novel variational loss for local prediction and FocalBO, which hierarchically optimizes the acquisition function over shrinking search spaces.
summary_en.result: FocalBO achieves state-of-the-art performance on robot morphology design and control of a 585-dimensional musculoskeletal system by efficiently leveraging offline and online data.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through simulation cases on robot morphology design and high-dimensional musculoskeletal control.

visual.caption: Figure 1 : Performance comparison of focalized GP and SVGP over 1d GP functions. Posteriors are shown as mean ± \pm 1 standard deviation.

title: Safe Bayesian Optimization for the Control of High-Dimensional Embodied Systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的高维安全贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的约束优化问题，但未涉及有限元代理模型或生物力学验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification for point predictions; it focuses on safe control optimization in robotics and neuromodulation.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维控制策略优化中保证安全性的需求
summary_zh.method: 提出局部乐观探索的高维安全贝叶斯优化方法
summary_zh.result: 在数百至数千维空间中实现安全优化，首次用于高维肌肉骨骼系统控制
summary_zh.validation: 仿真案例与神经刺激诱导人体运动控制实验

summary_en.motivation: To enable safe optimization of control policies in high-dimensional embodied systems, where existing methods are inefficient or ignore safety constraints.
summary_en.method: Proposes High-dimensional Safe Bayesian Optimization (HdSafeBO) with local optimistic exploration and isometric embedding to handle up to thousands of dimensions under probabilistic safety constraints.
summary_en.result: HdSafeBO achieves high safety probability and cumulative safety violation bounds, and is the first algorithm to safely optimize high-dimensional musculoskeletal control and real-world neural stimulation.
summary_en.validation: Validated on simulated high-dimensional control tasks and a real-world online optimization of neural stimulation-induced human motion.

visual.caption: Figure 1: Workflow of HdSafeBO . Local optimistic safe optimization is employed to efficiently optimize the objective function while guaranteeing probabilistic safety. We utilize isometric embedding to reduce the problem dimension to deal with high-dimensional inputs.

title: MscaleFNO: Multi-scale Fourier Neural Operator Learning for Oscillatory Function Spaces
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多尺度傅里叶神经算子方法可推广到生物力学有限元代理建模中，用于处理高频振荡响应。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant mechanics problems, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not address multi-objective or constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准FNO在处理高频振荡函数映射时存在谱偏差，需要改进。
summary_zh.method: 提出MscaleFNO，通过并行多个输入缩放的FNO捕捉不同频率成分。
summary_zh.result: 在Helmholtz方程高频波散射问题上，MscaleFNO显著优于标准FNO。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证了方法的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Fourier neural operators suffer from spectral bias when learning mappings between highly oscillatory functions, limiting their accuracy in high-frequency regimes.
summary_en.method: The proposed MscaleFNO employs a series of parallel FNOs with scaled inputs to capture multiple frequency components of the target mapping.
summary_en.result: MscaleFNO substantially outperforms the standard FNO with similar parameter count on the Helmholtz equation wave scattering problem in the high-frequency regime.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on numerical benchmarks of the Helmholtz equation with oscillatory coefficients.

title: Condensed Stein Variational Gradient Descent for Uncertainty Quantification of Neural Networks

title: An explainable operator approximation framework under the guideline of Green's function

summary_zh.motivation: 传统数值方法求解PDE计算昂贵，格林函数解析推导困难。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional numerical solvers for PDEs are computationally expensive, and analytical derivation of Green's functions is challenging for complex systems.

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究Ti6Al4V点阵结构的拉伸行为，与AM生物医学植入物的力学性能相关，但未涉及疲劳、表面粗糙度或骨整合。
why_not_core: No fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration analysis, and no direct stress shielding quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究点阵结构作为骨植入物的力学性能。
summary_zh.method: LPBF制造Ti6Al4V三种点阵拓扑并拉伸测试。
summary_zh.result: 报告了不同拓扑的拉伸行为和设计准则。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸实验验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the mechanical behavior of lattice structures for potential bone implant applications.
summary_en.method: Three strut-based lattice topologies (octahedron, dodecahedron, star) were fabricated from Ti6Al4V using laser powder bed fusion and subjected to tensile tests.
summary_en.result: Tensile test results were reported and design criteria for lattice structures were discussed.
summary_en.validation: Experimental tensile testing was performed to validate the mechanical response of the lattice specimens.

title: Osseointegration and fixation opportunities of sacroiliac instrumentation: a preclinical evaluation in a large animal model.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Surgical and Orthopaedic Research Laboratories, Prince of Wales Clinical School, University of New South Wales, Sydney, AUS.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及增材制造植入物的骨整合和力学测试，但未聚焦于应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: No stress shielding quantification, no fatigue testing, and no stiffness matching analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估不同设计和制造方法对骶髂植入物骨整合和固定力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 在羊模型中比较3D打印与传统制造钛合金植入物的体内骨整合和力学测试。
summary_zh.result: 3D打印植入物表面更粗糙，骨整合更好，扭转性能优于传统制造。
summary_zh.validation: 通过羊动物模型、组织学和力学测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate how different design features and manufacturing methods influence implant osseointegration and mechanical fixation in cancellous bone.
summary_en.method: In vivo comparison of three titanium alloy implants (additively manufactured vs. traditionally manufactured) in a sheep model, assessed via mechanical testing, histology, and histomorphometry.
summary_en.result: The additively manufactured implant with rougher surface and porous domains exhibited superior osseointegration and torsional fixation compared to traditional implants.
summary_en.validation: Animal model (sheep) with mechanical push-out and removal torque tests, PMMA histology, and fluorochrome labeling.

relevance_to_user: 该综述回顾了增材制造在骨组织工程中的应用，包括材料和设计策略，但没有涉及应力遮挡或疲劳等特定力学问题。
why_not_core: It is a review that does not present original experimental data on LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing (fatigue or static), stress shielding, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 骨移植和人工植入物需求增长，需有效修复或替换受损骨骼。
summary_zh.method: 综述增材制造技术、材料及支架设计策略在骨组织工程中的应用。
summary_zh.result: TPMS和Voronoi等参数化设计有潜力，未来需发展新材料和多材料打印。
summary_zh.validation: 无（综述文章）

summary_en.motivation: The increasing annual demand for bone grafts and artificial implants necessitates effective solutions for bone repair and replacement.
summary_en.method: This review surveys additive manufacturing technologies, materials, and scaffold architectures for bone tissue engineering, focusing on design strategies such as TPMS and Voronoi.
summary_en.result: Parametric designs like TPMS and Voronoi are identified as promising, while topology optimization and gradient models show superior properties; future research should address novel biomaterials and multi-material printing.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the paper is a literature review.

title: A tensor-train reduced basis solver for parameterized partial differential equations on Cartesian grids
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过张量列格式加速参数化PDE求解，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及约束优化或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and no application to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低参数化PDE降阶模型的高离线计算成本
summary_zh.method: 利用张量列格式高效表示有限元量，构建投影降阶模型
summary_zh.result: 在泊松、热传导和线弹性问题上验证了精度和计算效率
summary_zh.validation: 通过后验误差估计和数值基准测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the high offline computational cost of projection-based reduced-order models for parameterized PDEs.
summary_en.method: The tensor-train format is used to efficiently represent high-dimensional finite element quantities, enabling cost-effective construction of reduced subspaces and hyper-reduction.
summary_en.result: The method achieves accurate solutions with reduced computational cost on benchmark problems including Poisson, heat, and linear elasticity equations.
summary_en.validation: A posteriori error estimates and numerical benchmarks on 2D/3D Cartesian grids validate the accuracy and efficiency.

title: Uncertainty separation via ensemble quantile regression
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的集成分位数回归不确定性分离方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性量化任务。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling, lacks biomedical or implant design context, and does not address constrained optimization or simulation efficiency.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升数据驱动模型中不确定性估计与分离的可靠性。
summary_zh.method: 提出集成分位数回归框架，通过渐进采样迭代改进不确定性分离。
summary_zh.result: 在合成基准上优于深度集成和MC Dropout等方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成数据集上进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the reliability of uncertainty estimation and separation in data-driven models for scientific and engineering tasks.
summary_en.method: Proposes an ensemble quantile regression framework with iterative progressive sampling to enhance aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty separation.
summary_en.result: Outperforms Deep Ensembles and MC Dropout on synthetic benchmarks, demonstrating scalability and robustness.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic numerical benchmarks without real-world or biomedical applications.

visual.caption: Figure 1: On the left figure, we observe how the lack of data in a region with aleatoric uncertainty causes each sub-network to fit the noise differently, as they only access small subsets of the data. This overfitting results in the false reporting of epistemic uncertainty where none exists. On the right figure, we see that in regions lacking sufficient data, the fits for aleatoric uncertainty become unreliable, leading to incorrect report of aleatoric uncertainty.

title: Reliability analysis for non-deterministic limit-states using stochastic emulators
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的随机仿真器可靠性分析方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的不确定性量化，但未涉及具体植入物或有限元代理模型。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics application; no FEA surrogate; no constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低随机仿真器可靠性分析的高计算成本
summary_zh.method: 使用广义lambda模型和随机多项式混沌展开作为代理模型
summary_zh.result: 代理模型在三个案例中收敛到正确解，计算成本远低于蒙特卡洛
summary_zh.validation: 解析函数、简支梁算例和风力涡轮机案例验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the high computational cost of reliability analysis for stochastic simulators with non-repeatable outputs.
summary_en.method: Employ generalized lambda models and stochastic polynomial chaos expansions as surrogate models to learn the inherent randomness.
summary_en.result: The emulators converge to correct solutions in three case studies, achieving efficient uncertainty quantification at much lower cost than Monte Carlo.
summary_en.validation: Validation via an analytical function with closed-form solution, a simply supported beam toy example, and a realistic wind turbine case study.

title: QP Based Constrained Optimization for Reliable PINN Training
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于二次规划的约束优化训练方法，可提高PINN的收敛性和稳定性，对解决代理模型训练中的约束处理问题具有参考价值。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant design problems, lacks uncertainty quantification, and only demonstrates on a simple 2D Laplace equation without comparison to expensive simulation sampling.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN训练中的收敛性和稳定性问题
summary_zh.method: 将训练过程建模为约束优化问题，采用二次规划梯度下降法
summary_zh.result: 实现了数据损失和PDE残差损失的动态平衡，保证精度同时优先最小化PDE损失
summary_zh.validation: 在含噪声数据的电容器拉普拉斯方程求解上验证

summary_en.motivation: To address convergence and stability challenges in PINN training by reformulating the training as a constrained optimization problem.
summary_en.method: A quadratic program (QP)-based gradient descent law is introduced to dynamically balance data loss and PDE residual loss during training.
summary_en.result: The method guarantees convergence to optimal parameters and achieves acceptable accuracy while prioritizing PDE loss minimization.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on solving Laplace's equation in a capacitor with noisy data and complex geometry.

title: Inverse Design of Nonlinear Mechanics of Bio-inspired Materials Through Interface Engineering and Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用贝叶斯优化进行非线性力学逆向设计，方法可迁移至植入物力学性能优化，但未涉及FEA代理模型或生物力学约束。
why_not_core: No surrogate model for FEA, no uncertainty quantification, no implant or biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 逆向设计具有指定非线性应力-应变曲线的仿生复合材料。
summary_zh.method: 采用贝叶斯优化框架搜索界面属性以实现目标曲线。
summary_zh.result: 贝叶斯优化能发现多种界面设计，产生相似应力-应变响应但变形机制不同。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值模拟验证逆向设计结果。

summary_en.motivation: To inversely design bio-inspired composite materials with a specified nonlinear stress-strain response by tuning interface properties.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian optimization framework is introduced to efficiently search the infinite design space of interface properties for target stress-strain curves.
summary_en.result: Bayesian optimization identifies multiple distinct interface designs that yield similar target stress-strain responses but differ in deformation and failure mechanisms.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated through numerical simulations of bio-inspired composite models.

visual.caption: Figure 1 : The two-dimensional model material and interface law. (A) The model is composed of hard grains glued by soft interface materials; (B) The bilinear traction-separation interface law in the normal direction; (C) The bilinear traction-separation interface law in the shear direction.

title: Optimal Control Operator Perspective and a Neural Adaptive Spectral Method
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种用于最优控制问题的神经算子方法，可迁移到FEA替代建模中，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决最优控制问题中依赖迭代优化和显式动力学表达式的效率瓶颈
summary_zh.method: 提出实例-解控制算子视角，并设计神经自适应谱方法（NASM）实现一次性求解
summary_zh.result: 在合成环境和真实数据集上实现显著加速和高质量泛化
summary_zh.validation: 理论误差界证明加数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the inefficiency of iterative optimization and dependence on explicit dynamics in optimal control problems.
summary_en.method: Proposes an instance-solution control operator perspective and implements it via a Neural Adaptive Spectral Method (NASM) for one-shot solution.
summary_en.result: Achieves substantial speedup and high-quality in- and out-of-distribution generalization on synthetic and real-world datasets.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical approximation error bounds and numerical experiments on benchmark environments.

title: Efficient damage simulations under material uncertainties in a weakly-intrusive implementation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效的不确定性量化方法，可应用于生物力学植入物设计的有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on damage simulations in general engineering structures, not specifically on implant biomechanics or contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决工程仿真中不确定性量化计算成本高的问题
summary_zh.method: 在Abaqus中弱侵入式实现时间分离随机力学方法
summary_zh.result: 仅需两次确定性有限元模拟即可近似随机行为，成本降低两个数量级
summary_zh.validation: 通过损伤仿真数值算例与蒙特卡洛对比验证精度

summary_en.motivation: To enable efficient uncertainty quantification in inelastic finite element simulations, which is computationally prohibitive with standard Monte Carlo methods.
summary_en.method: A weakly-intrusive implementation of time-separated stochastic mechanics in Abaqus, requiring only two deterministic simulations for homogeneous material fluctuations.
summary_en.result: The method reduces computational cost by at least two orders of magnitude compared to Monte Carlo while maintaining accuracy for damage simulations.
summary_en.validation: Numerical comparisons with Monte Carlo simulations on damage examples demonstrate the method's efficiency and accuracy.

title: BOIDS: High-dimensional Bayesian Optimization via Incumbent-guided Direction Lines and Subspace Embeddings
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的高维贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题，但未涉及约束处理或生物力学背景。
why_not_core: This paper does not handle constraints, lacks uncertainty quantification for point predictions, and is not validated on implant or biomechanics design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维贝叶斯优化仍受维度诅咒困扰，需提升效率。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于方向线的序列优化与自适应选线策略，结合子空间嵌入。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实基准上优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准函数上对比实验。

summary_en.motivation: High-dimensional Bayesian optimization still suffers from the curse of dimensionality, necessitating more efficient algorithms.
summary_en.method: BOIDS guides optimization via a sequence of one-dimensional direction lines with adaptive line selection and subspace embedding.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on synthetic and real-world benchmark problems.
summary_en.validation: Extensive experiments on standard numerical benchmark functions demonstrate superior performance.

visual.caption: Figure 1: Illustration of our proposed BOIDS algorithm. (1) The incumbent-guided lines are constructed from the personal and global incumbents. (2) The optimal lines are selected based on Thompson Sampling MAB strategy. (3) Line-based Optimization is performed following the optimal line. (4) Subspace embedding technique is incorporated to enhance the performance.

title: A Paradigm Shift to Assembly-like Finite Element Model Updating
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种类似组装的有限元模型更新方法，可提高计算效率，对生物力学植入物设计中的代理模型构建具有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on aeronautical wing structures and does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or patient-specific FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少复杂结构有限元模型更新的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 提出类似组装的模型更新框架，逐步组装子模型并求解
summary_zh.result: 相比全局方法，计算工作量降低约28%，精度损失在1%以内
summary_zh.validation: 使用柔性机翼的真实实验数据验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of finite element model updating for complex structures.
summary_en.method: An assembly-like model updating framework is proposed, where the model is updated as parts are assembled, using lower-fidelity subassembly models.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves about 28% lower overall computational effort compared to the global approach, while retaining fidelity within 1% of a joint natural frequencies and modal shapes index.
summary_en.validation: Validated using real experimental data from a flexible wing.

relevance_to_user: 本文使用AI工具优化生物打印参数，实现了个性化口腔软组织构建物的制备，与您的AI生物打印方向相关。
why_not_core: This paper uses AI for parameter optimization but does not achieve autonomous decision-making or closed-loop control, and the AI tool is auxiliary rather than central.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发个性化口腔软组织移植物，修复牙龈和黏膜缺陷。
summary_zh.method: 结合3D生物打印和AI参数优化，使用多糖/纤维蛋白原生物墨水构建全层牙龈组织。
summary_zh.result: 细胞存活率高，形状保真度好，组织标志物表达正常。
summary_zh.validation: 通过细胞培养18天，评估活力和组织结构。

summary_en.motivation: To develop patient-specific oral soft tissue grafts for repairing mucogingival defects, addressing the need for personalized shape and cellular organization.
summary_en.method: This study combines 3D bioprinting of a polysaccharide/fibrinogen-based bioink with AI-driven parameter optimization to fabricate full-thickness gingival constructs with controlled geometry.
summary_en.result: The bioprinted constructs maintained high cell viability and shape fidelity over 18 days in culture, with appropriate tissue-specific marker expression.

title: Regional Expected Improvement for Efficient Trust Region Selection in High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的区域期望改进（REI）获取函数可提升高维贝叶斯优化的效率，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维贝叶斯优化中信任区域方法易陷入局部最优，需改进全局搜索能力。
summary_zh.method: 提出区域期望改进（REI）获取函数，用于识别可能包含全局最优的区域。
summary_zh.result: REI在中等至高维实际问题上优于传统BO及其他高维BO方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过理论证明和多个基准测试数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Trust-region-based Bayesian optimization methods suffer from stagnation in local optima in high-dimensional spaces, motivating a new acquisition function to improve global search.
summary_en.method: A novel acquisition function, regional expected improvement (REI), is proposed to identify promising trust regions without relying on problem-specific assumptions.
summary_en.result: Incorporating REI into trust-region-based BO outperforms conventional BO and other high-dimensional BO methods on medium to high-dimensional real-world problems.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical proof of REI's effectiveness is provided, along with empirical validation on multiple benchmark optimization problems.

title: AutoSciLab: A Self-Driving Laboratory For Interpretable Scientific Discovery
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种自主科学实验的机器学习框架，其主动学习和方程发现方法可迁移至生物打印中的工艺优化与参数探索。
why_not_core: This paper does not address bioprinting workflow stages, lacks experimental validation on bioprinting data, and does not involve autonomous decision-making for bioprinting processes.

summary_zh.motivation: 自动化实验室在高维空间中实验设计效率低，受限于人类直觉。
summary_zh.method: 提出AutoSciLab框架，结合变分自编码器、主动学习和方程学习器实现自主科学发现。
summary_zh.result: 成功重新发现抛体运动原理和伊辛模型相变，并在纳米光子学中发现新的非相干光定向方法。

summary_en.motivation: Automated laboratories are limited by human intuition in designing and interpreting high-dimensional experiments, throttling scientific discovery.
summary_en.method: AutoSciLab integrates a variational autoencoder for experiment generation, active learning for hypothesis selection, a directional autoencoder for latent variable discovery, and a neural network equation learner for interpretable equations.
summary_en.result: The framework rediscovered projectile motion principles and Ising model phase transitions, and uncovered a novel method for directing incoherent light emission surpassing state-of-the-art.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed on classical physics benchmarks and an NP-hard problem, demonstrating generalizability.

title: Distribution free uncertainty quantification in neuroscience-inspired deep operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于共形预测的不确定性量化方法，可应用于神经算子，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。

summary_zh.motivation: 降低深度学习能耗的同时提供可靠的不确定性估计
summary_zh.method: 将共形预测与随机先验网络结合，用于脉冲神经算子
summary_zh.result: 共形化方法显著提升了不确定性边界的校准质量
summary_zh.validation: 在四个一维和二维PDE基准问题上验证

summary_en.motivation: To enable energy-efficient deep learning with reliable uncertainty quantification for neural operators.
summary_en.method: A conformalized randomized prior framework is integrated with spiking wavelet neural operators to produce calibrated prediction intervals.
summary_en.result: The proposed method yields tighter and better calibrated uncertainty bounds compared to existing approaches on PDE benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on four numerical PDE examples (1D and 2D) without experimental or biomedical data.

title: Conformal Prediction on Quantifying Uncertainty of Dynamic Systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文将共形预测应用于动态系统的不确定性量化，方法可迁移至FEA代理模型的不确定性评估。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or constrained optimization; it focuses on video-based dynamic systems and PDE benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 物理系统模型需要可靠的不确定性量化，但现有方法缺乏理论保证。
summary_zh.method: 将共形预测与算子学习方法结合，用于动态系统的不确定性评估。
summary_zh.result: 在PDE数据集上，共形预测有效量化了时间序列预测的不确定性。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE基准数据集上与MC Dropout和集成方法对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Reliable uncertainty quantification is crucial for physical system models, yet existing methods lack theoretical guarantees.
summary_en.method: Conformal prediction is integrated with operator learning methods to assess uncertainties in dynamic systems.
summary_en.result: On PDE datasets, conformal prediction effectively quantifies uncertainty in time-series roll-outs.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard PDE benchmark datasets, comparing against Monte Carlo Dropout and Ensemble methods.

title: Bayesian Optimization via Continual Variational Last Layer Training
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效的贝叶斯优化代理模型，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constrained optimization, uncertainty quantification beyond point prediction, or implant/biomechanics design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 高斯过程在复杂相关结构上核选择困难，贝叶斯神经网络性能不佳。
summary_zh.method: 提出连续变分最后层训练方法，结合GP精确条件化与在线优化。
summary_zh.result: 在复杂输入相关任务上显著优于GP和其他BNN，在标准基准上匹配调优GP。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准基准任务和复杂相关任务上进行数值实验对比。

summary_en.motivation: Gaussian processes suffer from kernel selection difficulties for complex correlation structures, while Bayesian neural networks underperform on certain problem types.
summary_en.method: A continual variational last layer training algorithm is proposed, connecting variational Bayesian last layers to exact conditioning in GPs for efficient online learning.
summary_en.result: The proposed VBLL networks significantly outperform GPs and other BNNs on tasks with complex input correlations and match well-tuned GPs on standard benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard optimization tasks and tasks with complex input correlations are used for evaluation.

title: Reliable Uncertainty Quantification for Fiber Orientation in Composite Molding Processes using Multilevel Polynomial Surrogates
relevance_to_user: 该论文的多层多项式代理模型和不确定性量化方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真替代建模。

summary_en.motivation: Uncertainty in fiber orientation during composite molding critically affects mechanical performance, necessitating efficient quantification.
summary_en.method: Multilevel polynomial surrogates are employed with novel error bounds for statistical measures to propagate material uncertainties.
summary_en.result: The method significantly outperforms standard Monte Carlo estimation while providing rigorous error guarantees.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments using Cross-WLF viscosity model and Hagen-Poiseuille flow verify the approach.

title: Non-Myopic Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出非短视多目标贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真多目标优化问题。

summary_en.result: The proposed non-myopic acquisition functions substantially outperform existing myopic methods on diverse real-world multi-objective problems.

summary_en.validation: Validated on simulated EIT data, demonstrating improved reconstruction accuracy and noise robustness.

why_not_core: The paper does not address constraints, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics-specific PDEs, and lacks experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高维PINN中自适应配置点方法计算成本过高的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出PACMANN，利用梯度优化逐步将配置点移至残差较高区域
summary_zh.result: 低维问题性能与现有方法相当，高维问题表现更优且计算成本低
summary_zh.validation: 通过前向和逆向PDE数值基准测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the poor scalability of adaptive collocation point sampling methods for high-dimensional Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs).
summary_en.method: PACMANN iteratively moves collocation points toward regions of high PDE residual using gradient-based optimization guided by the loss gradient.
summary_en.result: The method matches state-of-the-art accuracy-efficiency tradeoff for low-dimensional problems and outperforms existing methods for high-dimensional ones.
summary_en.validation: Validated on forward and inverse PDE benchmark problems, demonstrating computational efficiency and accuracy.

title: Meta-learning Loss Functions of Parametric Partial Differential Equations Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过元学习自动优化损失函数，可迁移至生物力学代理模型，提高参数化PDE求解效率。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no contact mechanics, no implant context, only tested on Burger's and Heat equations, lacks constraint handling and uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高参数化PDE求解效率，避免手动设计损失函数。
summary_zh.method: 采用广义可加模型进行元学习，自动生成PINN损失函数。
summary_zh.result: 在Burgers和2D热方程上，收敛速度和性能均优于传统方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE基准上验证数值精度和收敛性。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency of solving parametric PDEs with PINNs by automatically learning optimal loss functions rather than manual design.
summary_en.method: Proposes meta-learning loss functions using Generalized Additive Models for parametric PDEs within a PINN framework.
summary_en.result: Learned loss functions enhance meta-learner convergence and solution accuracy on Burger's and 2D Heat equations.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical benchmarks comparing loss function performance on two canonical PDEs.

title: Localized Conformal Multi-Quantile Regression
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的自适应预测区间方法可用于代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及有限元或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: The paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or application to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有共形预测区间无法适应局部异方差性，效率低且对不同子群体有效性差。
summary_zh.method: 提出局部共形多分位数回归，结合多分位数信息和核局部化构建自适应区间，并用分层校准处理异质群体。
summary_zh.result: 在标准数据集上效率更优，GC-LCMQR在混合群体中实现组级覆盖。
summary_zh.validation: 在基准数据集和个体处理效应任务上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard conformal prediction intervals are inefficient under local heteroscedasticity and fail to maintain validity across subgroups.
summary_en.method: Localized Conformal Multi-Quantile Regression (LCMQR) synergizes multi-quantile information with kernel-based localization, extended to Group-Calibrated LCMQR for stratified calibration.
summary_en.result: LCMQR achieves superior efficiency on benchmarks, and GC-LCMQR uniquely ensures group-level coverage in mixture populations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on benchmark datasets and an Individual Treatment Effect task.

title: Intrinsic Gaussian Process Regression Modeling for Manifold-valued Response Variable
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了内在高斯过程回归方法，可用于处理流形值响应变量，虽然未直接应用于FEA或生物力学，但其不确定性量化能力可迁移至植入物代理模型构建。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on theoretical development of GP for manifold-valued data with no FEA, biomechanics, or implant design context, and does not address constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 缺乏内在高斯过程用于流形值响应变量回归。
summary_zh.method: 利用平行传输算子提出内在协方差结构，构建流形值高斯过程回归模型。
summary_zh.result: 所提模型在模拟和真实数据上表现良好，并证明了渐近性质。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值模拟和实际数据示例验证模型性能。

summary_en.motivation: To address the lack of intrinsic Gaussian process models for regression with manifold-valued response variables.
summary_en.method: Propose an intrinsic covariance structure using parallel transport on Riemannian manifolds and develop a well-defined Gaussian process regression model.
summary_en.result: The proposed model achieves good performance on simulated and real data, with established information consistency and posterior consistency.
summary_en.validation: Numerical simulations and real data examples demonstrate the effectiveness of the method.

title: Boundary-Decoder network for inverse prediction of capacitor electrostatic analysis
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了处理边界条件变化的深度学习方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但未涉及植入物或固体力学分析。
why_not_core: No biomechanics context, no implant or FEA validation, and not applied to solid mechanics or constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统静电模拟在边界条件变化时需重新求解，耗时且效率低。
summary_zh.method: 提出端到端深度学习模型，直接学习边界条件变化对电场的影响。
summary_zh.result: 该方法在动态边界条件下显著优于普通神经网络和PINN，且保持前向模型能力。
summary_zh.validation: 在空气电容器结构数值问题上与PINN和NN对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional electrostatic simulations require re-solving when boundary conditions change, which is computationally expensive.
summary_en.method: An end-to-end deep learning approach is proposed to directly model the effect of boundary condition changes on electrostatic fields.
summary_en.result: The proposed method significantly outperforms vanilla neural networks and PINNs under dynamic boundary conditions while retaining forward modeling capability.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a numerical benchmark of a long air-filled capacitor structure, comparing against NN and PINN.

title: What do physics-informed DeepONets learn? Understanding and improving training for scientific computing applications
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的迁移学习方法可提升物理信息深度算子网络在偏微分方程求解中的效率，对生物力学代理模型构建有潜在借鉴意义。
why_not_core: Does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraints handling, uncertainty quantification, or direct biomechanics/implant design applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 理解物理信息深度算子网络的学习机制并改进训练过程
summary_zh.method: 通过奇异值衰减分析基础函数通用性，并提出跨参数迁移学习方法
summary_zh.result: 迁移学习显著降低误差并获得更有效的表示解的基础函数
summary_zh.validation: 在不同参数化偏微分方程上进行数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To understand what physics-informed DeepONets learn and improve their training for scientific computing.
summary_en.method: Analyzing singular value decays and expansion coefficients, and proposing a transfer learning approach across PDE parameters.
summary_en.result: Transfer learning substantially reduces error and yields basis functions that more effectively represent PDE solutions.
summary_en.validation: Validated on parametric PDEs including both same-type and cross-type problems.

key_terms.zh: 物理信息深度算子网络

title: Diffeomorphic Latent Neural Operators for Data-Efficient Learning of Solutions to Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过微分同胚映射在少量几何数据上学习PDE解算子，可用于患者特异性植入物力学模拟的代理模型。
why_not_core: Does not directly apply to implant stress shielding or micromotion; no biomechanical constraints or uncertainty quantification included.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效学习多种几何域上的PDE解算子
summary_zh.method: 利用微分同胚映射将不同几何域映射至参考域，训练潜在神经算子
summary_zh.result: 在少量几何数据上实现跨域泛化，减少数据需求
summary_zh.validation: 基于拉普拉斯算子的共形不变性进行数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To enable neural operators to generalize across geometric domains with minimal training data by leveraging diffeomorphic mappings.
summary_en.method: Train a latent neural operator on solution fields mapped from various geometries to a fixed reference domain, preserving differential operator properties.
summary_en.result: The approach significantly reduces data requirements while maintaining accuracy, demonstrated by exploiting conformal invariance of the Laplacian.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on a benchmark problem exploiting conformal invariance of the Laplacian.

title: Active partitioning: inverting the paradigm of active learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的数据分区方法可迁移至有限元代理模型的构建，但未直接解决采样效率、约束或多目标优化问题。
why_not_core: Does not address expensive simulation sampling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; lacks biomedical or implant application context.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过竞争机制自动划分数据中的功能模式，提升模型专业化。
summary_zh.method: 多模型迭代竞争预测，奖励最佳预测以形成专业分区。
summary_zh.result: 在20多个回归任务上实现最高54%的损失降低。
summary_zh.validation: 在基准回归数据集及多孔结构力学数据上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a general-purpose partitioning algorithm that detects functional patterns in data by reinforcing model strengths, inverting the active learning paradigm.
summary_en.method: Multiple models compete to predict each data point; the best model is rewarded with training on that point, inducing specialization and a data-driven partition.
summary_en.result: Partition-based modular models achieve up to 54% reduction in loss over single models across more than twenty regression benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on benchmark regression datasets and a mechanical stress-strain dataset from a porous structure.

title: Robust Bayesian Optimization via Localized Online Conformal Prediction
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过共形预测提供了不确定性量化，可迁移至FEA替代模型优化，但未处理约束且未在生物力学中验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not validate on FEA or biomechanics design problems, does not handle constraints, and is not applied to implant or structural optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决贝叶斯优化在模型误设下性能下降的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出局部在线共形预测（LOCBO）以校准高斯过程似然。
summary_zh.result: LOCBO在模型误设时显著优于现有贝叶斯优化算法。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和真实优化任务上验证理论保证和性能。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization degrades under model misspecification, and this paper aims to improve robustness. (paraphrased)
summary_en.method: Localized online conformal prediction is integrated to calibrate the GP likelihood, yielding a corrected posterior. (paraphrased)
summary_en.result: LOCBO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art BO algorithms on both synthetic and real-world optimization tasks with model misspecification. (paraphrased)
summary_en.validation: Theoretical guarantees are provided under minimal noise assumptions, and numerical experiments on benchmark functions validate the approach. (paraphrased)

title: Posterior sampling with Adaptive Gaussian Processes in Bayesian parameter identification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出自适应高斯过程代理模型提高后验采样效率，方法可迁移至生物力学设计中的仿真替代。
why_not_core: The paper does not address constraints handling, nor does it apply or validate the method on implant/biomechanics design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低贝叶斯参数识别中大量正向模型评估的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 采用自适应高斯过程代理模型，交替优化采样位置和精度
summary_zh.result: 相比仅位置自适应和静态设计，计算量显著减少
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值算例验证了方法的有效性

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational burden of many forward model evaluations required in Bayesian parameter identification via posterior sampling.
summary_en.method: An adaptive Gaussian process surrogate is built by interleaving posterior sampling with optimization of training point positions and accuracies.
summary_en.result: The proposed adaptive approach achieves significant reduction in computational cost compared to position-adaptive and static designs.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on numerical benchmark problems with known ground truth.

title: Fast, Precise Thompson Sampling for Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种改进的贝叶斯优化方法，可提高采样效率，但未涉及FEA代理模型或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification for predictions, or any biomechanical/implant design application.

summary_zh.motivation: 改进贝叶斯优化中的汤普森采样，提高精度和速度。
summary_zh.method: 提出交错汤普森采样器（STS），通过更精确定位最大值点实现高效采样。
summary_zh.result: STS在多个测试函数上优于TS、PSS和其他采集函数。
summary_zh.validation: 在多维测试函数上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the efficiency and accuracy of Thompson sampling in Bayesian optimization by precisely locating the optimal point.
summary_en.method: Proposing a Stagger Thompson Sampler (STS) that refines the sampling process using Hit-and-Run to improve precision and reduce computation time.
summary_en.result: STS outperforms standard Thompson sampling, PSS, and other acquisition functions on a wide range of benchmark functions.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on multi-dimensional test functions from standard optimization benchmarks.

title: Model-based reinforcement corrosion prediction: Continuous calibration with Bayesian optimization and corrosion wire sensor data
relevance_to_user: 该论文的贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真校准，但未涉及生物力学或骨科应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomechanical implant design, surrogate modeling for FEA, or contact mechanics; it focuses on chloride diffusion in civil structures.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高钢筋混凝土结构氯离子迁移预测的准确性
summary_zh.method: 比较物理模型和神经网络模型，利用贝叶斯优化校正扩散系数
summary_zh.result: 物理模型透明度高，神经网络灵活性好
summary_zh.validation: 基于桥体导线传感器和钻孔样本数据

summary_en.motivation: To improve prediction accuracy of chloride transport in reinforced concrete structures.
summary_en.method: Compare physics-based and neural network models, calibrating diffusion coefficient via Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.result: Physics-based model offers transparency, neural network shows adaptability.
summary_en.validation: Calibration and comparison using in-situ wire sensor and drilling dust sample data.

title: Gaussian Process Priors for Boundary Value Problems of Linear Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了满足线性偏微分方程和边界条件的高斯过程先验方法，可推广至生物力学代理建模中的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: The method is limited to linear constant-coefficient PDEs with simple geometry, not demonstrated on nonlinear biomechanics or implant FEA problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解带边界条件的线性偏微分方程系统
summary_zh.method: 构建满足线性和边界条件的GP先验并更新数据
summary_zh.result: 相比现有方法显著提升精度和计算效率
summary_zh.validation: 在典型线性PDE系统上进行数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve systems of linear PDEs with boundary conditions using a probabilistic framework
summary_en.method: Construct Gaussian process priors that exactly satisfy both the PDE and boundary conditions, then condition on data
summary_en.result: Achieves significant improvements in accuracy and computational efficiency over state-of-the-art methods
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation on representative linear PDE systems with practical boundary conditions

title: Alpha Entropy Search for New Information-based Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯优化新方法可迁移至植入物设计领域，但未直接处理约束或面向生物力学。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constrained optimization, uncertainty quantification for predictions, or biomechanical implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提出基于α散度的新采集函数以改进贝叶斯优化
summary_zh.method: 利用α散度量化点与全局最优解的相关性并近似截断高斯分布
summary_zh.result: 在合成、基准和深度网络调参任务中表现竞争力
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准与真实DNN超参数调优实验

summary_en.motivation: To improve Bayesian optimization by generalizing information-based acquisition functions using α-divergence beyond Kullback-Leibler divergence.
summary_en.method: Derive the Alpha Entropy Search acquisition function based on α-divergence and approximate it efficiently with a truncated Gaussian distribution.
summary_en.result: AES achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art information-based BO methods on synthetic, benchmark, and real-world hyperparameter tuning tasks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic functions, standard optimization problems, and tuning deep neural network hyperparameters.

title: A Simple and Efficient Approach to Batch Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法提供了一种高效的批量贝叶斯优化策略，可迁移至基于有限元仿真的植入物设计优化中，但未涉及约束处理或生物力学具体应用。
why_not_core: The paper does not address FEA simulation surrogates, handle constraints (e.g., implant design constraints), or validate on any biomechanical or implant design problem.

summary_zh.motivation: 针对批次贝叶斯优化在大批量时性能下降的问题，提出可扩展的高效方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出期望子空间改进准则，从各轴对齐子空间中同时选取查询点。
summary_zh.result: 方法显著加速收敛，在标准测试函数上与七种批量算法性能相当或更优。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个数值基准优化问题上进行对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To scale batch Bayesian optimization to large batches without performance degradation.
summary_en.method: Propose an expected subspace improvement criterion to select points from axis-aligned subspaces simultaneously.
summary_en.result: The method significantly speeds up convergence compared to sequential BO and performs competitively against seven batch algorithms.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on benchmark optimization test functions.

title: Safe PDE Boundary Control with Neural Operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用神经算子对偏微分方程进行建模并引入安全约束，可迁移至生物力学有限元仿真的代理建模与约束优化。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate application, no implant/biomechanics design context, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现未知偏微分方程边界控制中的安全约束满足。
summary_zh.method: 提出神经边界控制障碍函数，结合神经算子进行二次规划安全过滤。
summary_zh.result: 在多种PDE动力学上验证了安全约束的有效性和泛化能力。
summary_zh.validation: 在双曲、抛物和Navier-Stokes等数值PDE基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To guarantee safety constraints in boundary control of unknown PDE dynamics using model-free controllers.
summary_en.method: A neural boundary control barrier function (BCBF) is introduced and integrated with a neural operator to enable quadratic programming-based safety filtering.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves better constraint satisfaction and general performance across hyperbolic, parabolic, and Navier-Stokes PDE environments.
summary_en.validation: Validated through extensive numerical experiments on challenging PDE benchmark dynamics.

title: Capacitive Touch Sensor Modeling With a Physics-informed Neural Network and Maxwell's Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理信息神经网络替代模型方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及约束优化和不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant mechanics, biomechanics design constraints, uncertainty quantification, or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速电容触控传感器设计中的多物理场仿真
summary_zh.method: 将静电场控制方程嵌入神经网络损失函数训练替代模型
summary_zh.result: 替代模型在秒级完成推理，无需重新仿真
summary_zh.validation: 在未见的测试案例上评估预测精度

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate the time-consuming multi-physics simulations in capacitive touch sensor design using a surrogate model.
summary_en.method: A Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) is trained by incorporating electrostatic governing equations into the loss function to serve as a surrogate for the sensor.
summary_en.result: The learned surrogate model enables rapid inference for different experimental setups within seconds, eliminating the need for full simulations.
summary_en.validation: The model's efficacy is evaluated on unseen test cases from simulation data.

title: Learnable Activation Functions in Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Solving Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了PINN中可学习激活函数对谱偏差和收敛稳定性的影响，为改进代理模型训练提供了方法参考，但未涉及植入物或生物力学设计的具体应用。
why_not_core: Does not address constraints, UQ, or sampling efficiency; no application to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN在求解偏微分方程时面临的谱偏差和收敛不稳定问题
summary_zh.method: 系统比较固定激活函数、可学习激活函数MLP与KAN，结合NTK和Hessian分析
summary_zh.result: 可学习激活函数在简单架构有效但在复杂网络中扩展性差，低谱偏差不一定带来更好精度
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试(线性/非线性波动、流体动力学PDE)

summary_en.motivation: To address spectral bias and unstable convergence in PINNs for solving PDEs.
summary_en.method: Systematic comparison of MLPs with fixed/learnable activations and KANs using NTK and Hessian eigenvalue decomposition.
summary_en.result: Learnable activations improve simpler architectures but face scalability issues; low spectral bias does not guarantee accuracy due to convergence instability.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on diverse PDEs including linear/nonlinear wave and fluid dynamics.

title: Influence functions and regularity tangents for efficient active learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了主动学习的高效方法，可迁移至代理模型的训练数据选择，以降低FEA仿真成本。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and no application to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高回归模型在主动学习中数据选择效率
summary_zh.method: 通过正则切向量与损失梯度的内积计算影响力函数
summary_zh.result: 训练后可快速评估数据点的好奇程度
summary_zh.validation: 理论推导，无实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve data selection efficiency in active learning for regression models by providing a sense of curiosity.
summary_en.method: Proposes a regularity tangent vector computed during training and its inner product with the loss gradient as an influence measure.
summary_en.result: The influence measure can be evaluated as fast as computing the loss gradient, requiring only double storage.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical derivation; no experimental validation on real-world datasets.

title: Exact and approximate error bounds for physics-informed neural networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了PINN求解常微分方程的误差界，对于FEA代理模型的误差分析有参考价值，但未涉及生物医学应用。
why_not_core: Does not provide any experimental validation, does not address implant/biomechanics, and only considers first-order ODEs, not complex PDEs typical in FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 发展PINN求解微分方程的误差界理论。
summary_zh.method: 推导了非线性一阶ODE的误差表达式，给出了近似界和精确界。
summary_zh.result: 成功利用残差和方程结构提供了误差界。
summary_zh.validation: 理论推导和案例分析。

summary_en.motivation: To develop error bounds for PINN solutions of differential equations, addressing the lack of rigorous error analysis.
summary_en.method: Derived a general expression for the error of PINN solutions to nonlinear first-order ODEs, including an approximate bound for general cases and an exact bound for a specific case.
summary_en.result: The proposed method successfully provides error bounds using only residual information and equation structure, without relying on numerical solutions.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical analysis and application to particular ODE cases.

title: Deep operator network models for predicting post-burn contraction
relevance_to_user: 该方法展示了神经网络算子作为有限元替代模型的可行性，可迁移至植入物力学代理模型构建，但未涉及约束处理与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not handle constraints, multi-objective optimization, or uncertainty quantification; it is applied to wound contraction rather than implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 烧伤后挛缩预测的传统数值模型计算昂贵，急需高效替代方法。
summary_zh.method: 采用深度算子网络(DeepONet)作为有限元模拟的代理模型，集成初始伤口形状并应用正弦增强约束边界条件。
summary_zh.result: 模型在多种伤口形状上R²达0.99，预测一年内演变，加速比最高235倍。
summary_zh.validation: 基于有限元模拟结果进行数值基准测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional numerical models for predicting post-burn contraction are computationally expensive, necessitating efficient surrogates.
summary_en.method: A DeepONet surrogate model was developed for finite element simulations, incorporating initial wound shape information and sine augmentation to enforce boundary conditions.
summary_en.result: The model achieved an R² of 0.99 on test shapes, predicted evolution up to one year, and provided up to 128x CPU and 235x GPU speedups.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed against finite element simulation results on convex combinations of basic wound shapes.

title: Active Learning-Based Optimization of Hydroelectric Turbine Startup to Minimize Fatigue Damage
relevance_to_user: 该方法中的主动学习和黑箱优化策略可迁移到植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样效率问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on hydroelectric turbine startup optimization, not on biomedical implant or biomechanical FEA surrogate modelling.

summary_zh.motivation: 水轮机启动过程导致疲劳损伤，优化启动参数以延长寿命。
summary_zh.method: 结合主动学习和黑箱优化，利用虚拟应变传感器和动态仿真。
summary_zh.result: 仅用7次实测序列实现最大应变幅值降低42%。
summary_zh.validation: 在真实Francis水轮机原型上进行现场测量验证。

summary_en.motivation: Optimizing hydroelectric turbine startup sequences is challenging due to expensive stress measurements, motivating an active learning approach to minimize fatigue damage with limited data.
summary_en.method: An automated optimization framework combining active learning and black-box optimization, using virtual strain sensors and dynamic simulations of the hydro-generating unit.
summary_en.result: The algorithm achieved a 42% reduction in maximum strain cycle amplitude compared to the standard startup sequence using only seven measured startup sequences.
summary_en.validation: The method was validated through a real-time on-site measurement campaign on an instrumented Francis turbine prototype.

title: Predicting Wall Thickness Changes in Cold Forging Processes: An Integrated FEM and Neural Network approach
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种用图神经网络替代有限元仿真的代理模型方法，虽用于冷锻工艺，但可迁移至假体生物力学设计的代理建模。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling, and not applied to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决冷锻缩口工艺中有限元仿真耗时问题
summary_zh.method: 结合有限元仿真与图神经网络构建代理模型预测壁厚变化
summary_zh.result: 所提代理模型能有效预测壁厚变化，性能良好
summary_zh.validation: 通过新指标ABTC对仿真结果进行评估

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate expensive FEM simulations for predicting wall thickness changes during tube nosing in cold forging.
summary_en.method: A surrogate model based on graph neural networks with specialized edge encoders is trained on FEM data to capture object interactions.
summary_en.result: The proposed model achieves accurate predictions of wall thickness changes, validated using a new Area Between Thickness Curves (ABTC) metric.
summary_en.validation: Numerical validation on simulated FEM datasets using the ABTC metric, without experimental verification.

title: Nonlinear space-time model reduction in the frequency domain
relevance_to_user: 该方法虽未直接应用于生物力学，但其所提出的非线性时空模型降阶技术可迁移至植入物设计的代理模型构建，以提高仿真效率。
why_not_core: The paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or demonstrate transferability to implant/biomechanics design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低非线性动力系统仿真成本，实现高效代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 利用SPOD模态构建时空编码，投影隐式解导出一组代数方程。
summary_zh.result: 在相同模态数和CPU时间下，误差比POD-Galerkin低两个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值算例上用测试集（外推激励和参数变化）验证精度。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of simulating nonlinear dynamical systems by developing a reduced-order model that compresses both space and time.
summary_en.method: A frequency-domain space-time reduced-order model (SSOP) that encodes entire state trajectories using SPOD modes and solves a system of algebraic equations for the SPOD coefficients.
summary_en.result: The SSOP method achieves two orders of magnitude lower error than POD-Galerkin projection at the same number of modes and CPU time across various numerical tests.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated on numerical benchmarks with out-of-sample forcings and affine parameter variations.

title: DKMGP: A Gaussian Process Approach to Multi-Task and Multi-Step Vehicle Dynamics Modeling in Autonomous Racing
relevance_to_user: 该论文的深度核多任务高斯过程方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型构建，但缺乏约束处理和生物力学验证。
why_not_core: No FEA, no implant design, no biomechanics context, and no constraint handling in the optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高自动驾驶赛车动力学建模的精度和效率
summary_zh.method: 提出基于深度核的多任务高斯过程模型，结合自适应校正步长进行多步预测
summary_zh.result: 相比单步方法预测精度最高达99%，计算效率提升1752倍
summary_zh.validation: 使用真实赛车高速数据与基线模型对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and efficiency of vehicle dynamics modeling for autonomous racing.
summary_en.method: Proposes a Deep Kernel-based Multi-task Gaussian Process (DKMGP) with an adaptive correction horizon for multi-step prediction.
summary_en.result: DKMGP achieves up to 99% prediction accuracy and 1752x computational efficiency improvement over baselines.
summary_en.validation: Validated on high-speed dynamics data from a full-scale Indy race car, comparing with DKL-SKIP and a single-track model.

title: Mechanical properties and microstructure of Ti–6.5Al–2Zr–1Mo–1V/TiB composites produced by vacuum arc or selective laser melting

why_not_core: Does not address stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue, surface roughness, or osseointegration for biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究TiB复合材料在SLM和真空电弧下的力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM和真空电弧制备Ti-6.5Al-2Zr-1Mo-1V/TiB复合材料。
summary_zh.result: 比较了两种工艺的微观结构和力学性能差异。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试验证材料性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the mechanical properties of TiB composites fabricated by selective laser melting compared to vacuum arc melting.
summary_en.method: Ti-6.5Al-2Zr-1Mo-1V/TiB composites were produced via selective laser melting and vacuum arc melting, followed by microstructural and mechanical characterization.
summary_en.result: Significant differences in microstructure and mechanical properties were observed between the two fabrication methods.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing including compression and tensile tests was performed to validate the properties.

title: Uncertainty quantification for electrical impedance tomography using quasi-Monte Carlo methods
relevance_to_user: 该论文发展了准蒙特卡洛方法用于电学电阻抗成像的不确定性量化，方法本身可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的不确定性分析，但未涉及植入物设计或结构力学。
why_not_core: This paper does not address finite element analysis surrogate modeling, structural mechanics, or implant biomechanics; it focuses on electrical impedance tomography inverse problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 针对电学电阻抗成像反问题中的不确定性量化需求。
summary_zh.method: 采用随机移位秩1网格规则的准蒙特卡洛方法进行贝叶斯反演。
summary_zh.result: 在理想假设下证明收敛速率是维数无关且优于蒙特卡洛，数值实验验证。
summary_zh.validation: 使用模拟测量数据进行数值算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To quantify uncertainty in electrical impedance tomography, an ill-posed inverse problem, using improved quasi-Monte Carlo integration.
summary_en.method: Applied randomly shifted rank-1 lattice rules within a Bayesian statistical inversion framework to approximate the unknown conductivity field.
summary_en.result: Established dimension-independent, faster-than-Monte Carlo convergence rates under moderate assumptions on the conductivity parameterization.
summary_en.validation: Numerical results on simulated measurement data confirmed the theoretical convergence rates and practical feasibility.

title: Ti

summary_zh.motivation: 通过多孔结构减轻应力遮挡，促进骨长入。

summary_zh.result: 多孔区孔隙率70%，抗压强度25 MPa，接近松质骨。
summary_zh.validation: 压缩力学测试验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To address stress shielding in implants by developing porous structures that mimic trabecular bone.
summary_en.method: A green dough-forming technique using metal powders was employed to fabricate Ti6Al4V dense-porous bilayer structures.
summary_en.result: The porous region achieved 70% porosity and a compressive strength of 25 MPa, comparable to cancellous bone.
summary_en.validation: Compression mechanical testing was performed to evaluate the strength of the fabricated structures.

title: Modeling Multivariable High-resolution 3D Urban Microclimate Using Localized Fourier Neural Operator
relevance_to_user: 该方法使用局部FNO加速CFD模拟，可迁移至生物力学FEA替代模型。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling, and applied to urban microclimate, not implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速城市微气候CFD模拟，降低计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 提出局部FNO，结合局部训练、几何编码和重叠块。
summary_zh.result: 高分辨率3D预测，速度提升50倍，误差降低23.9%。
summary_zh.validation: 与CFD数值模拟对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate computationally expensive urban microclimate CFD simulations coupling velocity and temperature.
summary_en.method: A localized Fourier neural operator (Local-FNO) is proposed employing local training, geometry encoding, and patch overlapping.
summary_en.result: Local-FNO achieves high-resolution 3D predictions of wind and temperature fields at nearly 50 times the speed of CFD with reduced error.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated against CFD simulations for a 2 km by 2 km urban domain at 10 m resolution.

title: Harnessing Scale and Physics: A Multi-Graph Neural Operator Framework for PDEs on Arbitrary Geometries
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多图神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学代理建模，但未涉及不确定量化或约束处理。
why_not_core: Paper does not handle constraints or uncertainty quantification, and lacks application to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解任意几何上的偏微分方程
summary_zh.method: 提出多图神经算子，结合动态注意力和物理图
summary_zh.result: 在六个基准上一致超越现有方法
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve partial differential equations on arbitrary geometries using neural operators.
summary_en.method: Proposes a multi-graph neural operator with dynamic attention and a physics graph to handle complex geometries.
summary_en.result: Consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models across six numerical benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on six standard PDE benchmarks without experimental validation.

why_not_core: No link to stress shielding or stiffness matching for biomedical implants; only quasi-static compression, no fatigue testing; no surface roughness or osseointegration data.

title: Physics-informed neural networks need a physicist to be accurate: the case of mass and heat transport in Fischer-Tropsch catalyst particles
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了物理信息神经网络在求解输运方程时的可靠性问题及改进方法，对FEA替代模型的开发具有参考价值。
why_not_core: Does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or bone remodeling; validation is only on a chemical engineering case with finite-difference solver, not on structural FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN在输运方程求解中极端参数范围不准确的问题。
summary_zh.method: 结合领域知识与改进数值方案，修正PINN架构确保渐近行为。

summary_zh.validation: 与有限差分法对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address reliability issues of PINNs at extreme input parameter ranges in coupled reaction-diffusion and heat transfer problems.
summary_en.method: Propose domain-knowledge-based modifications to PINN architecture and an improved numerical scheme as initial guess generator.
summary_en.result: The modifications restore simulation stability while preserving the speed-up of PINN as a workflow component.
summary_en.validation: Compared against a finite-difference solver on Fischer-Tropsch catalyst particle simulations.

title: Physics-informed Machine Learning for Battery Pack Thermal Management

summary_zh.validation: 基于实验标定的简化有限元模型验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of finite element analysis in battery pack thermal management by developing a surrogate model.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed convolutional neural network is trained with a loss function incorporating the heat conduction equation via finite differences.
summary_en.result: The physics-informed surrogate achieves over 15% improvement in accuracy compared to a purely data-driven approach with the same training data.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed against a simplified finite element model that was itself calibrated based on experimental results.

title: Data-driven parameterization refinement for the structural optimization of cruise ship hulls
relevance_to_user: 论文提出的数据驱动参数化细化与多目标贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物结构设计优化。

summary_zh.motivation: 解决巡航船舯段结构优化中参数化方案依赖设计者经验、不适应新配置的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出数据驱动层次化重参数化流程，结合多目标贝叶斯优化与降阶模型。
summary_zh.result: 迭代细化方法在简单和全船模型上均优于基线参数化方案。
summary_zh.validation: 通过简化船中段和全船有限元算例验证，比较优化性能。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the reliance on designer experience for parameterization in structural optimization of cruise ship hulls, especially when novel configurations arise.
summary_en.method: A data-driven hierarchical reparameterization procedure is developed, integrating multi-objective Bayesian optimization and reduced-order modeling.
summary_en.result: The iterative refinement outperforms the baseline parameterization on both a simplified midship section and a full hull model.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via finite element simulations of a simplified midship section and a full cruise ship hull, comparing optimization outcomes.

summary_zh.validation: 通过大气中尺度非线性基准算例进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the limitations of reduced-order models for nonlinear dynamical systems when observational data is scarce.
summary_en.method: A novel ROM framework using optimal transport-based displacement interpolation to generate geodesic paths for data augmentation, coupled with Gaussian Process Regression for residual correction.
summary_en.result: The method achieves improved accuracy and efficiency in predicting complex nonlinear dynamics on atmospheric mesoscale benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks of advection-dominated atmospheric flows.
