why_not_core: No FEA or biomechanical context; focused on molecular interatomic potentials.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估高斯过程回归机器学习原子间势的不确定性估计。
summary_zh.method: 对比预测标准差和集成不确定性在标定和主动学习中的表现。
summary_zh.result: GPR标准差全局标定良好但高不确定性样本存在系统性偏差。
summary_zh.validation: 在分子势能面和激发能数据集上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Evaluate uncertainty estimations for Gaussian process regression-based machine learning interatomic potentials.
summary_en.method: Compare predictive GPR standard deviation and ensemble-based uncertainties in calibration and active learning performance.
summary_en.result: GPR standard deviation shows good global calibration but systematic bias for high-uncertainty predictions, leading to overemphasis on configuration space borders in active learning.
summary_en.validation: Tested on potential energy surfaces and excitation energies of molecules.

title: Embedded Nonlocal Operator Regression (ENOR): Quantifying model error in learning nonlocal operators
relevance_to_user: 该方法针对非局部代理模型中的模型误差量化进行了不确定性量化，但与植入物/生物力学设计无直接关联。
why_not_core: The paper does not address implant/biomechanics design; it is demonstrated only on a 1D wave propagation problem.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发能量化非局部代理模型模型误差的鲁棒均匀化框架
summary_zh.method: 嵌入式非局部算子回归结合贝叶斯推断和多级延迟接受MCMC
summary_zh.result: 相比加性噪声模型，ENOR改进了后验预测不确定性估计
summary_zh.validation: 在异质一维杆的长期波传播问题上验证，并与加性噪声模型对比

summary_en.motivation: Develop a robust homogenization framework that quantifies model error in nonlocal surrogate models.
summary_en.method: Propose Embedded Nonlocal Operator Regression (ENOR) with Bayesian inference and multilevel delayed acceptance MCMC for joint inference of kernel and model error parameters.
summary_en.result: ENOR achieves improved estimation of posterior predictive uncertainty compared to additive noise models.
summary_en.validation: Validated on long-term wave propagation in a heterogeneous one-dimensional bar, compared with additive noise models.

title: On the Gaussian process limit of Bayesian Additive Regression Trees
relevance_to_user: 该论文将BART模型等价为高斯过程，为代理模型提供了一种新的理解方式和实现途径，可迁移至生物力学设计中的代理建模。
why_not_core: No application to FEA surrogate or biomechanical design; no handling of constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: BART无限树极限等价于高斯过程的性质尚未被利用。
summary_zh.method: 推导了BART的协方差函数并将其实现为高斯过程回归。
summary_zh.result: 极限形式在调参后与标准BART性能相当。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准回归数据集上对比BART与GP性能。

summary_en.motivation: The equivalence between infinite-tree BART and Gaussian process regression has not been practically exploited.
summary_en.method: Derived the exact covariance function of BART and implemented its infinite-tree limit as a Gaussian process.
summary_en.result: The GP limit, with tuned hyperparameters, achieves competitive performance with standard BART.
summary_en.validation: Empirical comparison on standard regression benchmarks.

title: Latent Neural Operator Pretraining for Solving Time-Dependent PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的潜在神经算子预训练框架可迁移至生物力学设计中的偏微分方程求解，但未涉及约束处理和不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics-specific PDEs.

summary_zh.motivation: 缓解神经算子求解偏微分方程时数据稀缺的问题。
summary_zh.method: 基于潜在神经算子骨干，在混合时间依赖偏微分方程数据集上预训练，再微调到单个方程。
summary_zh.result: 预训练后误差降低31.7%，微调后降低57.1%；在分布外数据上误差降低约50%，数据效率提升3倍。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个偏微分方程数值基准数据集上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To alleviate data scarcity in neural operator learning for PDEs by leveraging pretraining on diverse PDE datasets.
summary_en.method: A latent neural operator pretraining framework that extracts universal representations from hybrid time-dependent PDE datasets and fine-tunes on single PDE tasks in latent space.
summary_en.result: The framework reduces solution error by 31.7% on four problems, further improved to 57.1% after fine-tuning, and achieves roughly 50% lower error and 3× data efficiency on out-of-distribution data.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark datasets for time-dependent PDEs, including out-of-distribution scenarios.

title: GeoFUSE: A High-Efficiency Surrogate Model for Seawater Intrusion Prediction and Uncertainty Reduction
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合U-FNO、PCA和ESMDA的代理模型框架，用于高效模拟和不确定性量化，该方法可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的代理建模与UQ任务。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on groundwater flow simulation, not on structural FEA, implant mechanics, or biomechanics design constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 海水入侵模拟计算成本高，需要快速且具有不确定性量化的代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 提出GeoFUSE框架，集成U-FNO、PCA和ESMDA，用于代理建模与不确定性缩减。
summary_zh.result: 以约360,000倍的速度提升实现高精度盐度分布预测，并显著降低地质不确定性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过PFLOTRAN仿真结果和监测井实测数据验证模型精度与UQ能力。

summary_en.motivation: Accurate modeling and uncertainty quantification of seawater intrusion are hindered by high computational costs of numerical simulations.
summary_en.method: GeoFUSE integrates U-Net Fourier Neural Operator with Principal Component Analysis and Ensemble Smoother with Multiple Data Assimilation for efficient surrogate modeling and uncertainty reduction.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves over 360,000x speedup while maintaining high accuracy in salinity prediction and significantly reducing geological uncertainty over a 20-year period.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing surrogate predictions against high-fidelity PFLOTRAN simulations and field measurements from monitoring wells.

key_terms.zh: 多数据同化集成平滑器

title: Evaluation of stiffness-matched, 3D-printed, NiTi mandibular graft fixation in an ovine model.
first_author_affiliation: Department of Materials Science and Engineering, The Ohio State University, 140 W 19th Ave., Columbus, OH, 43210, USA.; Department of Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery, Ohio State Plastic Surgery, 915 Olentangy River Road, Columbus, OH, 43212, USA.

corresponding_authors.name: David Dean
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Materials Science and Engineering, The Ohio State University, 140 W 19th Ave., Columbus, OH, 43210, USA. David.Dean@osumc.edu.; Department of Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery, Ohio State Plastic Surgery, 915 Olentangy River Road, Columbus, OH, 43212, USA. David.Dean@osumc.edu.; Department of Materials Science and Engineering, Department of Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery, The Ohio State University, 460 West 12th Ave., Rm. 388, Columbus, OH, 43210, USA. David.Dean@osumc.edu.

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究刚度匹配的LPBF镍钛合金植入物在动物模型中的骨愈合效果，与AM生物医学方向高度相关。
why_not_core: No fatigue testing or detailed surface roughness characterization; mechanical evaluation is limited to in vivo fracture observation.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过刚度匹配设计减少下颌骨移植固定失败
summary_zh.method: LPBF制备多孔NiTi固定板在羊模型中进行验证
summary_zh.result: 实验组完全愈合,对照组Ti64板断裂
summary_zh.validation: 羊下颌骨模型体内实验

summary_en.motivation: To reduce post-operative failure of mandibular graft fixation by stiffness-matched implant design.
summary_en.method: LPBF-fabricated porous NiTi fixation plates were evaluated in an ovine mandibular graft model.
summary_en.result: All four animals with NiTi plates showed complete healing, while the Ti64 control plate fractured.
summary_en.validation: In vivo large animal model (ovine).

title: Causality-Respecting Adaptive Refinement for PINNs: Enabling Precise Interface Evolution in Phase Field Modeling
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过自适应网格细化和因果训练提升了PINN在动态PDE求解中的精度，可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但缺乏实验验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, no contact mechanics, no experimental validation, no design optimization constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高PINN在动态系统(如相场模型)中的求解精度
summary_zh.method: 结合残差自适应网格细化与因果训练的迭代流程
summary_zh.result: 显著提升复杂界面演化的捕捉能力
summary_zh.validation: 在Allen-Cahn方程上的数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the accuracy of physics-informed neural networks for dynamical systems with sharp moving boundaries, such as phase field models.
summary_en.method: An iterative approach combining residual-based adaptive refinement with causality-informed training to refine the domain and improve solution fidelity.
summary_en.result: The method achieves significant improvements in capturing interface evolution, especially for complex morphologies, outperforming standard PINNs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on the Allen-Cahn equation demonstrate the effectiveness of the combined framework.

title: CGKN: A Deep Learning Framework for Modeling Complex Dynamical Systems and Efficient Data Assimilation
relevance_to_user: 该方法解决了复杂动力系统的高效数据同化和不确定性量化问题，可迁移至生物力学替代建模中的仿真采样效率问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on dynamical system modeling and data assimilation, not on expensive FEA simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 针对复杂动力系统的高效数据同化和预测的需求。
summary_zh.method: 提出条件高斯Koopman网络(CGKN)，将非线性系统转化为带条件高斯结构的神经微分方程。
summary_zh.result: 在三种强非线性湍流系统中验证了预测与同化的鲁棒性和计算效率。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a deep learning framework that simultaneously provides accurate forecasts and efficient data assimilation for complex dynamical systems.
summary_en.method: A Conditional Gaussian Koopman Network (CGKN) that transforms general nonlinear systems into neural differential equations with conditional Gaussian structures, enabling analytic data assimilation.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates robustness and computational efficiency on three strongly nonlinear turbulent systems: Burgers-Sivashinsky equation, Lorenz 96, and ENSO model.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on benchmark dynamical systems with non-Gaussian features and extreme events.

title: Parametric Nonlinear Volterra Series via Machine Learning: Transonic Aerodynamics
relevance_to_user: 该方法基于Volterra级数和机器学习对非线性气动响应进行代理建模，可迁移至生物力学中的参数化有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on transonic aerodynamics and does not address implant biomechanics, structural FEA, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for biomedical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升非定常跨声速气动力建模效率用于概念设计。
summary_zh.method: 从CFD指示响应提取Volterra核，用神经网络和高斯过程回归插值核系数。
summary_zh.result: 二阶核改善非线性捕捉精度，神经网络插值有效。
summary_zh.validation: 在二维和三维跨声速算例中验证精度。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently model unsteady transonic aerodynamics across a parametric space for conceptual design.
summary_en.method: First- and second-order Volterra kernels are derived from CFD indicial responses, and machine learning (ANN and GPR) interpolates kernel coefficients over Mach number and angle of attack.
summary_en.result: Including the second-order kernel improves accuracy for strong nonlinearities, and neural networks provide effective interpolation.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated on 2D and 3D transonic test cases, achieving accuracy sufficient for conceptual design.

title: Conformal Prediction for Multimodal Regression
relevance_to_user: 提出多模态共形预测方法，其不确定性量化框架可迁移至代理模型，但未涉及有限元计算或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or biomechanics applications; it focuses on conformal prediction for multimodal data without validation on engineering or biomedical problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统共形预测局限于数值特征，需要扩展至多模态数据。
summary_zh.method: 利用神经网络内部融合特征构建预测区间，实现多模态共形回归。
summary_zh.result: 证明了内部特征可用于共形预测，生成分布自由的不确定性区间。
summary_zh.validation: 未提供具体实验验证，仅通过理论分析展示方法潜力。

summary_en.motivation: To extend conformal prediction from numerical inputs to multimodal data by leveraging internal features of complex neural networks.
summary_en.method: Internal features from multimodal fusion points in neural networks are used to construct prediction intervals via conformal prediction.
summary_en.result: The approach enables distribution-free uncertainty quantification for regression tasks with multimodal inputs.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation is provided; the method is demonstrated theoretically and through potential application scenarios.

title: Using Parametric PINNs for Predicting Internal and External Turbulent Flows
relevance_to_user: 该方法使用参数化PINN构建湍流替代模型，可迁移至生物力学有限元分析中的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on CFD surrogate modeling for turbulent flows, not on FEA surrogate for implant biomechanics, and does not address constraints or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 构建参数化湍流替代模型以降低计算成本
summary_zh.method: 采用RANS-PINN框架并引入基于几何的采样策略
summary_zh.result: 对内部和外部湍流实现了高精度预测
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值模拟与参考解对比验证

summary_en.motivation: Develop parametric surrogate models for turbulent flows to reduce computational cost.
summary_en.method: RANS-PINN framework with a geometry-aware sampling strategy to balance loss contributions.
summary_en.result: Accurate prediction of turbulent variables for both internal and external flows.
summary_en.validation: Comparison with CFD reference solutions for two representative flow scenarios.

key_terms.zh: 雷诺平均纳维-斯托克斯方程

title: Differential Informed Auto-Encoder
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过自编码器学习数据的微分结构，可潜在地用于构建低成本替代模型，以加速植入物设计中的有限元分析。
why_not_core: The paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or transfer to implant/biomechanics design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 从数据中学习潜在的微分结构以高效生成新样本
summary_zh.method: 训练编码器提取微分方程，解码器结合物理信息神经网络重构数据
summary_zh.result: 生成的新数据符合原始数据的微分规律
summary_zh.validation: 论文未提供具体的验证方式

summary_en.motivation: To learn the underlying differential structure from data for efficient generation of new samples that obey the same physical laws.
summary_en.method: An encoder extracts differential equations from data, and a decoder uses a physics-informed neural network to generate new data consistent with the discovered differential structure.
summary_en.result: Generated data preserve the differential properties of the original dataset.
summary_en.validation: No explicit experimental or numerical validation is reported; the method is presented as a theoretical framework.

title: An Investigation on Machine Learning Predictive Accuracy Improvement and Uncertainty Reduction using VAE-based Data Augmentation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的VAE数据增强和不确定性量化方法可迁移至生物力学FEA替代模型的样本效率提升与置信度评估
why_not_core: Does not address constraint handling, not applied to structural mechanics or implant design, and lacks physical validation in a biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 核工程数据稀缺限制机器学习精度，需生成合成数据扩充训练集。
summary_zh.method: 用VAE从原始数据学习分布并生成合成样本，结合贝叶斯神经网络和共形预测量化不确定性。
summary_zh.result: 数据增强提高了深度神经网络的预测精度，同时缩减了置信区间并降低了预测不确定性。
summary_zh.validation: 基于NUPEC BFBT基准的TRACE模拟稳态空隙率数据进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome data scarcity in nuclear engineering by augmenting limited experimental or simulation datasets using deep generative models.
summary_en.method: A variational autoencoder (VAE) generates synthetic training samples, then a deep neural network with Bayesian neural network and conformal prediction quantifies both accuracy and uncertainty.
summary_en.result: Data augmentation via VAE improved the DNN's predictive accuracy, narrowed confidence intervals, and reduced prediction uncertainties on the void fraction regression task.
summary_en.validation: The approach was validated on TRACE simulations of the NUPEC Boiling Water Reactor Full-size Fine-mesh Bundle Test benchmark.

title: Process parameter optimization for selective laser melting Ti-6Al-4V with high layer thickness
first_author_affiliation: Faculty of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Kunming University of Science and Technology, Kunming 650500, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Xijun Li
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Materials Science and Engineering, Kunming University of Science and Technology, Kunming 650093, PR China

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了高厚度层的选区激光熔化Ti-6Al-4V工艺参数优化，虽与生物医用植入体的材料工艺相关，但未涉及应力遮挡或骨整合等核心问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not address implant-specific biomechanics such as stress shielding, fatigue performance, or surface roughness effects on osseointegration; it focuses on build parameters for thick-layer SLM.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化高厚度层SLM Ti-6Al-4V的工艺参数以获得高致密度。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验设计改变激光功率、扫描速度等参数，表征密度和力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 找到了获得近全致密和高力学性能的最佳参数组合。
summary_zh.validation: 通过密度测量和力学测试验证参数优化效果。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize selective laser melting process parameters for Ti-6Al-4V using high layer thickness to achieve high density and good mechanical properties.
summary_en.method: An experimental design was employed varying laser power, scanning speed, and other parameters, followed by density and mechanical characterization.
summary_en.result: Optimal parameters were identified that yield near-full density and satisfactory mechanical performance.
summary_en.validation: Validation was conducted through density measurements and mechanical testing (e.g., tensile or hardness).

title: Optimal process parameter determination in selective laser melting via machine learning-guided sequential quadratic programing
venue: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers Part C Journal of Mechanical Engineering Science
first_author_affiliation: Additive Manufacturing Technologies Application and Research Center (EKTAM), Gazi University, Ankara, Türkiye

corresponding_authors.name: Can Barış Toprak
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Additive Manufacturing Technologies Application and Research Center (EKTAM), Gazi University, Ankara, Türkiye

relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了机器学习与约束优化方法在工艺参数优化中的应用，对植入物设计中的多目标约束优化具有参考价值。
why_not_core: No FEA simulation or surrogate modeling for finite element analysis; no biomechanics or implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化SLM工艺参数以提高零件机械性能。
summary_zh.method: 结合ANN、GPR、SVM与序列二次规划构建多目标约束优化模型。
summary_zh.result: 实现了多目标高效优化，并通过实验与Micro-CT验证。
summary_zh.validation: 额外实验与Micro-CT扫描验证。

summary_en.motivation: To determine optimal SLM process parameters for enhanced mechanical properties.
summary_en.method: Machine learning (ANN, GPR, SVM) models are trained to predict mechanical properties, then a constrained multi-objective optimization is solved via Sequential Quadratic Programming.
summary_en.result: The integrated ML-SQP approach efficiently optimizes multiple objectives, validated by experiments and Micro-CT.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation with micro-CT scanning confirms the predicted mechanical properties.

title: Sample-efficient Bayesian Optimisation Using Known Invariances
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过利用目标函数的已知对称性来提高贝叶斯优化的采样效率，可迁移到生物力学植入物设计中昂贵仿真优化的场景。
why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modeling for FEA surrogate, does not involve implant or biomechanics design, and lacks biomedical context or experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 昂贵函数优化中，忽略目标函数已知对称性导致采样效率低。
summary_zh.method: 将群不变性融入高斯过程核，推导信息上界和ϵ-最优性下界。
summary_zh.result: 不变性感知算法在合成和聚变反应堆设计中显著提升采样效率。
summary_zh.validation: 数值测试和核聚变电流驱动系统设计验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Bayesian optimization algorithms waste samples when the objective function is invariant under a known group of transformations, motivating an invariance-aware approach to improve sample efficiency.
summary_en.method: We incorporate group invariances into the Gaussian process kernel, derive bounds on the maximum information gain, and provide theoretical guarantees on the number of observations needed for epsilon-optimality.
summary_en.result: The proposed invariance-aware BO achieves significant sample efficiency gains on synthetic invariant functions and successfully optimizes a nuclear fusion reactor current drive system where non-invariant methods fail.
summary_en.validation: Method is validated on synthetic invariant and quasi-invariant functions, and a real-world nuclear fusion design problem (numerical benchmark).

title: Guaranteeing Conservation Laws with Projection in Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过投影增强PINN对守恒律的保证，可迁移至生物力学中需满足物理约束的代理模型构建。
why_not_core: Does not address FEA sampling efficiency, constraint handling for optimization, or uncertainty quantification; lacks biomedical or implant application context.

summary_zh.motivation: PINN无法保证物理守恒律，导致预测不可靠。
summary_zh.method: 提出PINN-Proj，在训练后通过投影层强制满足守恒律。
summary_zh.result: 相比标准PINN，动量守恒误差降低3-4个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 在三个PDE数据集上进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) cannot guarantee adherence to conservation laws, which are crucial for accurate physical modeling.
summary_en.method: PINN-Proj introduces a projection layer after training to enforce conservation laws without modifying the loss function.
summary_en.result: The method reduces prediction error by three to four orders of magnitude on momentum conservation benchmarks compared to standard PINNs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on three PDE datasets demonstrate improved state prediction and conservation law satisfaction.

title: Global Optimization of Gaussian Process Acquisition Functions Using a Piecewise-Linear Kernel Approximation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于混合整数规划的采集函数全局优化方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型优化场景。
why_not_core: No direct application to biomechanics or implant design; no physical validation; no FEA coupling.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升贝叶斯优化中采集函数全局收敛的可靠性
summary_zh.method: 采用分段线性核逼近与混合整数二次规划优化采集函数
summary_zh.result: 理论上有遗憾界保证，数值上在基准测试中表现良好
summary_zh.validation: 合成函数、约束基准和超参数调优任务验证

summary_en.motivation: This work aims to improve the global convergence of acquisition function optimization in Bayesian optimization, which is typically a non-convex challenge.
summary_en.method: The authors propose a mixed-integer quadratic programming (MIQP) formulation with a piecewise-linear kernel approximation to globally optimize acquisition functions.
summary_en.result: The method provides theoretical regret bounds and achieves competitive performance on synthetic functions, constrained benchmarks, and hyperparameter tuning.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic optimization benchmarks and a real hyperparameter tuning task, demonstrating empirical effectiveness.

title: Characterisation of 18Ni 300 steel CT specimens in a fatigue test manufactured by selective laser melting at 0°, 45° and 90°
first_author_affiliation: Department of Civil and Materials Engineering, University of Malaga, C/Dr Ortiz Ramos, s/n, 29071 Malaga, Spain

corresponding_authors.name: Pablo Lopez‐Crespo
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Civil and Materials Engineering, University of Malaga, C/Dr Ortiz Ramos, s/n, 29071 Malaga, Spain

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了选区激光熔化18Ni300钢的疲劳裂纹扩展行为，与医疗器械植入物中疲劳性能评估有一定相关性，但未涉及生物医学应用。

summary_en.result: The proposed method outperformed standard lawn-mowing and myopic baselines in hardware-in-the-loop experiments on real bathymetry.

title: BI-EqNO: Generalized Approximate Bayesian Inference with an Equivariant Neural Operator Framework

summary_en.motivation: To develop a flexible approximate Bayesian inference framework that overcomes limitations of traditional methods in estimating marginal likelihoods.

summary_en.motivation: The scarcity of benchmark datasets for neural PDE solvers on fluid flow over complex geometries hinders progress in data-driven simulation.
summary_en.method: FlowBench provides over 10K samples from direct numerical simulations, covering parametric and non-parametric geometries, various Reynolds and Grashoff numbers, and both 2D and 3D flows.
summary_en.result: The dataset includes velocity, pressure, temperature fields at three resolutions and engineering-relevant summary statistics, enabling evaluation of neural solvers like FNO, CNO, WNO, and DeepONet.
summary_en.validation: Data is generated using a well-validated simulator framework for transport phenomena in complex geometries, with multiple evaluation metrics defined.

summary_en.motivation: Numerical simulations for geological carbon sequestration are computationally expensive, motivating the development of efficient surrogate models.

summary_en.result: The framework demonstrated efficiency and accuracy on three numerical examples: Lotka-Volterra, heat equation, and reaction-diffusion equation.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks (Lotka-Volterra, heat, reaction-diffusion) without experimental or biomedical data.

title: Sketched Lanczos uncertainty score: a low-memory summary of the Fisher information
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种低内存的不确定性量化方法，可迁移至代理模型中的不确定性估计，但未涉及有限元仿真或生物力学设计。

summary_zh.result: 该方法在低内存条件下校准良好，可靠检测分布外样本，优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个分类和回归基准数据集上评估校准性能和OOD检测能力。

summary_en.motivation: Current uncertainty quantification methods are memory and compute intensive, limiting their practical adoption in neural networks.
summary_en.method: The Sketched Lanczos Uncertainty (SLU) method combines Lanczos algorithm with dimensionality reduction to compute a sketch of the leading eigenvectors of the Fisher information matrix, yielding a cheap uncertainty score.
summary_en.result: SLU produces well-calibrated uncertainties, reliably detects out-of-distribution examples, and outperforms existing methods in low-memory settings.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation on classification and regression benchmarks, evaluating calibration and OOD detection performance.

title: Bayesian computation with generative diffusion models by Multilevel Monte Carlo
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种多层级蒙特卡洛策略，可显著降低扩散模型在贝叶斯计算中的成本，对不确定性量化有借鉴意义，但未涉及有限元代理模型或生物力学设计。

summary_zh.method: 提出多层级蒙特卡洛策略，利用不同精度扩散模型的成本-精度权衡来降低总计算成本。
summary_zh.result: 在三个基准成像问题上实现4到8倍的计算成本降低，且不损失精度。

summary_en.motivation: Generative diffusion models used as stochastic samplers for Bayesian computation are computationally expensive, especially when many samples are needed for uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: A Multilevel Monte Carlo strategy is introduced that couples diffusion models of varying accuracy to exploit cost-accuracy trade-offs, reducing overall computational cost without sacrificing final accuracy.
summary_en.result: The proposed approach achieves a 4x to 8x reduction in computational cost compared to standard techniques across three benchmark imaging problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on three imaging inverse problems demonstrate the cost savings and accuracy preservation.

title: A Physics Informed Neural Network (PINN) Methodology for Coupled Moving Boundary PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的PINN方法可求解耦合移动边界PDE，其多物理场处理策略可迁移至生物力学中的接触力学或骨重塑问题。

summary_en.motivation: To solve coupled moving boundary PDEs with multiple governing parameters, such as those in binary alloy solidification, using a PINN framework.
summary_en.method: A multi-network architecture with separate networks per variable and phase, combined with alternating temporal learning and adaptive loss weighting, is employed.
summary_en.result: The method accurately captures the discontinuous composition profile at the interface, matching analytical solutions.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on the benchmark problem of binary alloy solidification, comparing predictions to analytical solutions.

summary_en.result: Achieves up to 1-3 orders of magnitude lower errors compared to existing hard-constrained methods like penalty and augmented Lagrangian methods.

summary_en.method: A novel architecture integrating fusion frame theory with POD-enhanced DeepONet is introduced for operator learning.
summary_en.result: The proposed framework achieves superior performance on multiple PDE benchmarks compared to standard DeepONet.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated on numerical PDE examples including parameterized and domain-shifted scenarios.

title: Total Uncertainty Quantification in Inverse PDE Solutions Obtained with Reduced-Order Deep Learning Surrogate Models
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的不确定性量化方法可迁移至生物力学逆问题中，但未涉及植入物设计或生物医学应用。

summary_en.motivation: To quantify the total uncertainty arising from surrogate models in inverse PDE solutions, including both observational and model errors.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian approach that randomizes the maximum a posteriori objective function to sample from the posterior distribution using reduced-order deep learning surrogates.
summary_en.result: The proposed method yields similar or more descriptive posterior distributions of parameters and states compared to the iterative ensemble smoother, while deep ensembling underestimates uncertainty.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a nonlinear diffusion equation modeling groundwater flow, comparing against iterative ensemble smoother and deep ensembling methods.

title: Fredholm Integral Equations Neural Operator (FIE-NO) for Data-Driven Boundary Value Problems

summary_zh.validation: 在标准偏微分方程数值算例上验证

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve boundary value problems with irregular boundaries, which are computationally intensive for traditional methods.
summary_en.method: Integrates Random Fourier Features and Fredholm Integral Equations into a deep neural operator framework (FIE-NO) for data-driven BVP solving.
summary_en.result: Achieves superior accuracy and stability on Darcy flow, Laplace, and Helmholtz equations under various boundary conditions.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks of standard PDEs (Darcy, Laplace, Helmholtz) with comparative analysis.

title: Framework for uncertainty quantification of wave-structure interaction in a flume

summary_en.result: Demonstrates prediction of probabilistic structural responses under breaking and non-breaking wave scenarios.
summary_en.validation: Validated against numerical and experimental results from the literature.

title: Extracting Signal out of Chaos: Advancements on MAGI for Bayesian Analysis of Dynamical Systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯高斯过程方法可用于不确定量化，但仅针对ODE系统，未涉及FEA或生物力学设计中的PDE约束优化。

summary_zh.method: 引入pMAGI和PMSP方法，改进数值稳定性与预测能力

summary_en.result: The proposed methods outperform PINN-based approaches on chaotic dynamical systems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard dynamical systems.

title: ConFIG: Towards Conflict-free Training of Physics Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 本文提出的CONFIG方法可解决PINN多目标损失冲突问题，有望提升力学替代模型的训练效率与稳定性，但尚未在生物力学或植入物设计中进行验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply to FEA surrogate modeling or biomechanical implant design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and includes no experimental validation on real engineering problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN中多项损失函数梯度冲突导致的训练困难。
summary_zh.method: 通过确保更新方向与每个损失梯度正相关并动态调整梯度幅度实现无冲突更新。
summary_zh.result: 在多个PINN基准任务上性能优于基线方法且收敛更快。
summary_zh.validation: 在PINN标准算例和多任务基准上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address the conflicting gradient updates from multiple loss terms in Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) that hinder training convergence.
summary_en.method: Proposes ConFIG, which ensures a positive dot product between the final update and each loss-specific gradient and dynamically adjusts gradient magnitudes based on conflict levels, with momentum acceleration via alternating back-propagation.
summary_en.result: ConFIG consistently outperforms baseline methods on challenging PINN scenarios and a classic multi-task benchmark, with proven convergence.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a suite of PINN numerical benchmarks and a multi-task learning dataset, showing superior performance and runtime.

title: Solving Oscillator Ordinary Differential Equations in the Time Domain with High Performance via Soft-constrained Physics-informed Neural Network with Small Data
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过软约束和少量数据高效求解ODE，可迁移至代理建模，但缺乏不确定量化且未应用于生物力学。
why_not_core: Does not address implant/biomechanics design, lacks UQ for design optimization, and only tested on simple ODEs not real-world FEA problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 用小数据高效求解常微分方程，支持物理约束。
summary_zh.method: 软约束PINN结合少量标签点和无标签配点。
summary_zh.result: 仅需1-2个初始数据即可高精度预测线性/非线性振荡器。
summary_zh.validation: 在Van der Pol、Duffing等标准振荡器上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To solve ODEs efficiently with minimal labeled data while incorporating physical constraints.
summary_en.method: Soft-constrained PINN trained with sparse data and collocation points, adding regularization for energy conservation.
summary_en.result: Achieves accurate prediction and extrapolation for linear and nonlinear oscillators using only one or two initial data points.
summary_en.validation: Validated on benchmark oscillator ODEs (primer, Van der Pol, Duffing) with noise robustness tests.

title: Parameterized Physics-informed Neural Networks for Parameterized PDEs

summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: To alleviate the repetitive and time-consuming training of physics-informed neural networks when solving parameterized partial differential equations across many parameter points.
summary_en.method: The proposed parameterized physics-informed neural networks encode a latent representation of PDE parameters directly into the network architecture.
summary_en.result: P²INNs demonstrate superior accuracy and parameter efficiency compared to baselines on 1D and 2D parameterized benchmark problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is conducted through numerical experiments on standard 1D and 2D parameterized PDE benchmarks.

title: Fredholm Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 提出了一种基于弗雷德霍姆积分方程的神经网络架构，可求解PDE，有望用于代理建模，但未直接解决采样效率和约束处理问题。

summary_zh.motivation: 提出一种可解释的深度神经网络架构，用于高效求解积分方程和偏微分方程。
summary_zh.method: 基于弗雷德霍姆积分方程的不动点迭代格式设计神经网络结构，连接理论与网络参数。
summary_zh.result: 在线性和非线性椭圆型PDE及边值问题上取得了高精度近似解。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个线性和非线性数值算例验证逼近精度。

summary_en.motivation: To introduce an explainable deep neural network architecture derived from the fixed-point iteration of Fredholm integral equations for solving differential equations and inverse problems.
summary_en.method: Fredholm NNs are constructed by unrolling the fixed-point iteration scheme of second-kind Fredholm integral equations, with interpretable weights and biases linked to the mathematical theory.
summary_en.result: The proposed networks achieve high numerical accuracy on linear and nonlinear elliptic PDEs and boundary value problems across the entire domain.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on several numerical examples including elliptic PDEs and boundary value problems.

title: Deconvoluting Thermomechanical Effects in X-ray Diffraction Data using Machine Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文中的高斯过程回归反演方法可用于生物力学参数识别，但并未直接涉及植入物设计中的有限元替代模型。

summary_en.motivation: To deconvolve thermal and mechanical strains from X-ray diffraction data using machine learning.
summary_en.method: Training data are generated from physics-based simulations (heat transfer, fluid flow, elasto-plasticity, XRD) and Gaussian Process Regression maps diffracted intensity profiles to underlying strain fields.
summary_en.result: The trained GPR model effectively separates thermal and mechanical strain contributions and provides distribution information even from complex diffraction patterns.
summary_en.validation: Approach is validated on simulated laser melting of an Inconel 625 wall specimen with full thermomechanical and diffraction modeling.

title: Partitioned Surrogates and Thompson Sampling for Multidisciplinary Bayesian Optimization

title: Navigating Uncertainties in Machine Learning for Structural Dynamics: A Comprehensive Survey of Probabilistic and Non-Probabilistic Approaches in Forward and Inverse Problems

summary_en.motivation: Uncertainties such as measurement noise and modeling errors compromise the reliability of ML predictions in structural dynamics, necessitating effective uncertainty awareness.
summary_en.method: This survey categorizes uncertainty-aware approaches into probabilistic (Bayesian and frequentist) and non-probabilistic (interval and fuzzy learning) methods, with emphasis on Bayesian neural networks.
summary_en.result: Bayesian neural networks are highlighted for superior uncertainty quantification and nonlinear mapping capabilities in both forward and inverse problems.
summary_en.validation: The paper provides a conceptual review and comparison of methods without experimental or numerical validation.

title: U-WNO: U-Net Enhanced Wavelet Neural Operator for Solving Parametric Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的U-WNO方法可迁移用于生物力学有限元代理模型，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the extraction of high-frequency features in neural operators for solving parametric PDEs, which is critical for multiscale phenomena.
summary_en.method: A U-Net enhanced wavelet neural operator (U-WNO) integrating U-Net skip connections and residual shortcuts into the wavelet layer, with an adaptive activation mechanism to mitigate spectral bias.
summary_en.result: U-WNO achieves 45–83% error reduction compared to baseline WNO across seven PDE families, with mean L2 relative errors between 0.043% and 1.56%.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical benchmarks on standard PDE families (Burgers, Darcy flow, Navier-Stokes, etc.) demonstrate the performance improvements.

summary_en.result: The PINN predicts up to 2.5 times the training range and extrapolates from subthreshold to inversion region using only subthreshold data.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on Si nanowire TCAD simulations, demonstrating accurate extrapolation beyond the training data range.

title: Nonlocal Attention Operator: Materializing Hidden Knowledge Towards Interpretable Physics Discovery

summary_en.motivation: To develop an interpretable neural operator for discovering physical laws from data, addressing ill-posed PDE inverse problems.
summary_en.method: Proposes Nonlocal Attention Operator (NAO) that leverages the attention mechanism as a double integral operator with a data-dependent kernel.
summary_en.result: NAO demonstrates superior generalizability to unseen resolutions and system states compared to baseline neural models.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on benchmark PDE problems validate the approach.

title: Quantification of total uncertainty in the physics-informed reconstruction of CVSim-6 physiology

summary_en.motivation: To quantify total uncertainty from multiple sources in physics-informed reconstruction of physiological models, improving predictive performance for digital twins.

title: Comparing ceramic Fischer-Koch-S and gyroid TPMS scaffolds for potential in bone tissue engineering

title: Towards aerodynamic surrogate modeling based on $β$-variational autoencoders

summary_zh.motivation: 减少高昂计算流体动力学数据需求，构建高效空气动力学代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 结合β-VAE、PCA降维与高斯过程回归预测翼型压力分布。
summary_zh.result: 高精度、低成本的代理模型，有效预测未探索飞行条件。
summary_zh.validation: 基于高保真CFD数据对比验证模型精度。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the need for costly high-fidelity CFD data by developing efficient aerodynamic surrogate models.
summary_en.method: The proposed surrogate combines a β-VAE with PCA preprocessing for dimensionality reduction and Gaussian Process Regression for latent space prediction.
summary_en.result: The method achieves accurate and efficient pressure field predictions for transonic wings under varying flight conditions.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated against high-fidelity CFD simulation data, demonstrating robust performance.

title: High dimensional Bayesian Optimization via Condensing-Expansion Projection
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的高维贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计优化，但缺乏约束处理和具体应用验证。
why_not_core: The paper does not handle constraints, lacks validation on engineering design problems, and has no direct application to implant or biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高维空间中贝叶斯优化昂贵且不可行的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出Condensing-Expansion投影贝叶斯优化，无需有效子空间假设
summary_zh.result: 在多种高维优化基准上超越现有随机嵌入方法
summary_zh.validation: 基于高斯和哈希投影矩阵的数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the inefficiency and infeasibility of Bayesian optimization in high-dimensional spaces.
summary_en.method: Proposes Condensing-Expansion Projection Bayesian optimization (CEPBO) using random projection matrices without relying on the effective subspace assumption.
summary_en.result: The algorithms with Gaussian and hashing projection matrices outperform existing random embedding methods on most high-dimensional benchmark problems.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on numerical benchmarks with comparison to state-of-the-art random embedding algorithms.

title: Zero-Shot Uncertainty Quantification using Diffusion Probabilistic Models
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的扩散模型集成方法可用于不确定性量化，但未在有限元代理模型或生物力学植入物设计中进行验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the UQ method to finite element surrogate modeling, nor does it address biomechanical implant design or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索扩散模型在回归问题中的集成预测用于零样本不确定性量化
summary_zh.method: 使用扩散模型进行集成预测，无需显式不确定性训练即可获得不确定性估计
summary_zh.result: 集成方法持续提高预测精度，自回归预测中增益更大，且预测误差与方差存在统计相关性
summary_zh.validation: 在1D和2D合成数据集上进行了广泛实验

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the use of ensemble predictions from diffusion probabilistic models for zero-shot uncertainty quantification in regression tasks.
summary_en.method: Diffusion models generate ensembles of predictions, enabling uncertainty estimation without explicit training for uncertainty.
summary_en.result: Ensemble methods consistently improve prediction accuracy, with larger gains in auto-regressive tasks, and a correlation between ensemble error and variance is observed.
summary_en.validation: Extensive experiments on synthetic 1D and 2D datasets.

title: R-adaptive DeepONet: Learning Solution Operators for PDEs with Discontinuous Solutions Using an R-adaptive Strategy
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过自适应网格策略改进了DeepONet对间断解的逼近能力，可迁移至生物力学中具有梯度突变的代理模型问题。
why_not_core: It does not handle constraints, lacks uncertainty quantification beyond theoretical bounds, and is not validated on biomechanics or implant design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准DeepONet逼近间断PDE解存在固有误差下界
summary_zh.method: 提出R-自适应DeepONet，将输出变换至计算域并学习坐标变换
summary_zh.result: 数值实验表明对间断解问题误差衰减快于线性
summary_zh.validation: 通过线性对流、Burgers和Euler方程验证

summary_en.motivation: Standard DeepONet has a fundamental approximation lower bound for PDEs with discontinuous solutions due to its linear reconstruction property.
summary_en.method: The proposed R-adaptive DeepONet transforms output data to a computational domain using the equidistribution principle and learns both the solution and coordinate transformation with separate DeepONets.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments on advection, Burgers', and Euler equations demonstrate that the error decays at a superlinear rate with respect to trunk basis size, outperforming vanilla DeepONet.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using numerical benchmarks on three prototypical PDEs with sharp gradients or discontinuities.

title: Modelling parametric uncertainty in PDEs models via Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的PINN-UQ方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型中的不确定性量化，但未涉及植入物设计或约束处理。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no implant design, and no constraint handling in optimization; validation is only on a groundwater reactive transport simulation.

summary_zh.motivation: 为缺乏观测数据的PDE模型提供不确定性量化方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出PINN-UU，整合时空域和不确定参数空间，通过迁移学习训练。
summary_zh.result: 在反应输运场景中展示了可靠性和效率。
summary_zh.validation: 数值模拟案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enable uncertainty quantification for PDE models with scarce or missing observations.
summary_en.method: Proposes PINN-UU integrating spatiotemporal and uncertain parameter domains with transfer learning for high-dimensional solution spaces.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates reliability and efficiency on a reactive transport scenario in porous media.
summary_en.validation: Simulation case of reactive transport in porous media.

title: Simplifying FFT-based methods for solid mechanics with automatic differentiation
relevance_to_user: 该论文通过自动微分简化FFT方法，可用于不确定性量化和拓扑优化，对代理建模有借鉴意义。
why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modelling or optimization constrained to implant/biomechanics design, and lacks FEA-based validation or specific biomechanical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决FFT方法在复杂材料模型和耦合问题中的实现复杂问题。
summary_zh.method: 将自动微分嵌入FFT框架，自动推导应力和切线刚度。
summary_zh.result: 简化了均质化计算，并扩展至不确定性量化和拓扑优化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值算例验证了方法的模块化和扩展性。

summary_en.motivation: Current FFT-based methods suffer from manual implementation of constitutive laws and complex algorithms, limiting their applicability to intricate material models and multiscale problems.
summary_en.method: An automatic differentiation (AD) framework is integrated into FFT-based methods to directly obtain stress and tangent stiffness from energy density functionals.
summary_en.result: The AD-enhanced FFT method simplifies homogenization, enables uncertainty quantification, and facilitates topology optimization through efficient sensitivity computation.
summary_en.validation: Numerical examples demonstrate the modularity and extensibility of the method for complex multiscale and multiphysics problems.

key_terms.zh: 基于快速傅里叶变换的方法

title: Neural active manifolds: nonlinear dimensionality reduction for uncertainty quantification
relevance_to_user: 该方法可用于降低生物力学有限元模型的采样维度并量化不确定性，但未直接应用于植入物设计或应力分析。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA-based implant mechanics, structural optimization, or any biomedical context; it is a general dimensionality reduction method for UQ.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低昂贵计算模型的不确定性量化成本
summary_zh.method: 通过自编码器学习一维神经活性流形并同时构建代理模型
summary_zh.result: 在多保真采样中实现方差缩减，提升效率
summary_zh.validation: 理论证明与数值测试案例

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational burden of uncertainty quantification in expensive mathematical models by discovering a low-dimensional active manifold.
summary_en.method: A neural active manifold is learned using autoencoders that simultaneously train a surrogate model on the discovered one-dimensional input subspace.
summary_en.result: The method enables multifidelity sampling with reduced variance, demonstrated on several numerical examples.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical analysis under idealized conditions and numerical benchmarks against existing methods.

title: Maximum a Posteriori Estimation for Linear Structural Dynamics Models Using Bayesian Optimization with Rational Polynomial Chaos Expansions
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过代理模型和贝叶斯优化降低计算成本，可迁移至植入物力学中的参数估计问题。
why_not_core: Does not directly address implant biomechanics or constraint handling; applied to structural dynamics (timber plate) rather than biomedical FEA surrogate.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少结构动力学中MAP估计的高计算成本
summary_zh.method: 使用理性多项式混沌展开代理模型，结合稀疏贝叶斯学习和贝叶斯优化进行适应性实验设计
summary_zh.result: 在二自由度系统和木结构FEM中有效减少了模型调用次数
summary_zh.validation: 数值案例验证

summary_en.motivation: Reduce the high computational cost of MAP estimation in structural dynamics.
summary_en.method: Use rational polynomial chaos expansion surrogate with sparse Bayesian learning and Bayesian optimization for adaptive experimental design.
summary_en.result: Effectively reduced number of model evaluations in two-degree-of-freedom and timber plate FEM cases.
summary_en.validation: Numerical simulation cases.

title: Probabilistic Surrogate Model for Accelerating the Design of Electric Vehicle Battery Enclosures for Crash Performance
relevance_to_user: 该方法的高斯过程回归代理模型和不确定性量化技术可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计的仿真加速。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constrained multi-objective optimization and is applied to automotive crash, not implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速电动汽车电池箱碰撞性能设计，需高效代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 基于高斯过程回归构建代理模型，输入材料与工艺参数，预测碰撞参数。
summary_zh.result: 预测误差低于8.08%，蒙特卡洛传播量化输入不确定性影响。
summary_zh.validation: 通过新仿真数据验证预测精度与不确定性估计。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate the design optimization of electric vehicle battery enclosures for crash performance using a probabilistic surrogate model.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian Process Regression surrogate model is trained on high-throughput finite element simulations of thermoforming and crash processes.
summary_en.result: The surrogate predicts crash parameters with mean absolute percentage errors within 8.08% and quantifies input uncertainty impact via Monte Carlo propagation.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using new simulation data, confirming predictive accuracy and uncertainty estimates.

title: Data-Driven Stochastic Closure Modeling via Conditional Diffusion Model and Neural Operator
relevance_to_user: 该方法基于扩散模型和神经算子的随机闭合建模框架有望迁移到植入物设计的代理模型构建中，但论文未涉及生物力学或约束处理。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no constraint handling, and no validation on structural mechanics or implant design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 多尺度动力系统直接数值模拟计算成本高昂，需要高效随机闭合模型。
summary_zh.method: 利用条件扩散模型结合傅里叶神经算子构建数据驱动的随机非局部闭合模型。
summary_zh.result: 生成的随机闭合模型具有良好的泛化能力，加速采样方法提高了效率。
summary_zh.validation: 通过偏微分方程数值算例验证模型性能。

summary_en.motivation: Direct numerical simulation of multiscale dynamical systems is computationally prohibitive, motivating efficient stochastic closure models.
summary_en.method: A data-driven stochastic closure model is constructed by integrating a conditional diffusion model with a Fourier neural operator.
summary_en.result: The proposed generative approach yields stochastic closures with improved generalization and efficiency via accelerated sampling.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on benchmark PDE systems demonstrate the model's effectiveness.

title: Bayesian learning with Gaussian processes for low-dimensional representations of time-dependent nonlinear systems
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出了一种结合高斯过程的贝叶斯学习框架用于构建低维代理模型，具有不确定性量化能力，可迁移至生物力学代理模型。
why_not_core: Does not address constraints or multi-objective optimization, and has no validation on biomechanical or implant surrogate problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 提出一种能够处理噪声和稀疏数据并自带不确定性量化的低维代理模型方法。
summary_zh.method: 将高斯过程代理整合到算子推断框架中，通过广义最小二乘回归得到概率化降阶模型。
summary_zh.result: 在非线性PDE和流行病学ODE上验证了方法的有效性，成功传播数据不确定性至预测。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个非线性偏微分方程和常微分方程系统的数值算例进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop low-dimensional surrogate models that handle noisy and sparse time-series data while providing uncertainty estimates.
summary_en.method: Integrate Gaussian process surrogates into the operator inference framework, using generalized least-squares regression for probabilistic reduced-order models.
summary_en.result: The method effectively constructs low-dimensional models for compressible flow and diffusion-reaction PDEs, and estimates parameters in compartmental ODEs.
summary_en.validation: Validated on two nonlinear PDE benchmarks and an ODE epidemic model.

title: Active Learning for Level Set Estimation Using Randomized Straddle Algorithms
relevance_to_user: 该方法虽聚焦于水平集估计，但其主动学习策略可迁移至昂贵仿真采样中的约束边界识别问题
why_not_core: Does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling in optimization, or implant biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高水平集估计的采样效率并保证理论收敛性
summary_zh.method: 用卡方分布随机采样替代确定性的置信参数
summary_zh.result: 无需手动调整参数且理论保证不保守
summary_zh.validation: 合成与真实数据集上的数值实验

summary_en.motivation: to improve sampling efficiency for level set estimation while providing theoretical guarantees.
summary_en.method: replaces the deterministic confidence parameter in the straddle algorithm with a random sample from a chi-squared distribution.
summary_en.result: achieves theoretical guarantees without conservative parameter tuning and demonstrates practical performance.
summary_en.validation: numerical experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets.

title: A PINN approach for the online identification and control of unknown PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该方法在解决部分未知PDE的在线识别与最优控制方面具有潜力，有望转移到植入物设计中的多目标优化与参数识别问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modeling for expensive FEA sampling, does not handle constraints beyond optimality conditions, lacks uncertainty quantification, and provides no biomechanics or implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 处理不完全信息下的最优控制问题
summary_zh.method: 将状态、伴随和控制变量整合到单一PINN中，结合Lagrangian乘子推导最优性条件
summary_zh.result: 即使数据稀疏且部分未知，方法仍有效
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值算例验证了所提方法

summary_en.motivation: To solve open-loop optimal control problems under incomplete information, including sparse data and partially unknown PDE parameters.
summary_en.method: A single physics-informed neural network simultaneously predicts state, adjoint, and control variables, derived from optimality conditions via Lagrangian multipliers, with a two-in-series architecture for online identification.
summary_en.result: The proposed PINN approach successfully controls and identifies unknown PDEs even with considerable data scarcity.
summary_en.validation: Numerical examples demonstrate effectiveness across scenarios with varying degrees of missing information.

title: Synergistic Learning with Multi-Task DeepONet for Efficient PDE Problem Solving
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了多任务DeepONet，可同时学习多种PDE场景，对于解决生物力学代理建模中的采样效率问题具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification or constraint handling; validated only on benchmark PDEs, not on implant or biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 多任务学习减少神经算子训练成本，统一求解不同PDE场景。
summary_zh.method: 在分支网络引入参数编码和二值掩码，实现多源项和多几何同时学习。
summary_zh.result: 在Fisher、达西流和传热问题上展示了泛化能力，降低整体训练开销。
summary_zh.validation: 基于三个标准PDE基准问题的数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Multi-task learning reduces training cost of neural operators by jointly solving PDEs with varying source terms and geometries.
summary_en.method: A multi-task DeepONet with a modified branch network encoding parameterized functions and a binary mask for variable geometries, trained on multiple tasks concurrently.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves competitive accuracy on Fisher, Darcy flow, and heat transfer benchmarks, demonstrating transfer learning to unseen geometries.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on three canonical PDE problems, including extrapolation to new geometry tasks.

title: Applications of Scientific Machine Learning for the Analysis of Functionally Graded Porous Beams
relevance_to_user: 该方法展示了神经网络算子作为结构力学代理模型的有效性，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的有限元替代建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address 3D contact mechanics of implants, multi-objective constraints, or uncertainty quantification, and validation is limited to beam benchmarks without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索科学机器学习方法在功能梯度多孔梁分析中的应用。
summary_zh.method: 使用PINN、深度能量法和神经算子三种方法求解梁的位移场。
summary_zh.result: 神经算子能预测任意孔隙率和任意载荷下的梁响应。
summary_zh.validation: 与解析解和数值解对比验证准确性。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate and compare different scientific machine learning approaches for analyzing functionally graded porous beams.
summary_en.method: Implemented physics-informed neural networks, deep energy method, and neural operators to approximate displacement fields governed by continuum beam theory.
summary_en.result: The trained neural operator successfully predicts beam response under arbitrary porosity distributions and traction conditions.
summary_en.validation: Validated against analytical and numerical reference solutions.

title: Neural Network Emulator for Atmospheric Chemical ODE
relevance_to_user: 该论文的方法（FNO、物理信息损失）具有迁移潜力，但应用于大气化学而非生物力学设计。
why_not_core: No biomedical implant context, no uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速大气化学ODE计算
summary_zh.method: 基于注意力和FNO的神经网络仿真器，加入时间嵌入和物理信息损失
summary_zh.result: 在精度和速度上达到最优
summary_zh.validation: 在大型化学数据集上数值实验

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate computationally expensive atmospheric chemistry ordinary differential equation simulations.
summary_en.method: Proposes ChemNNE, an attention-based neural network emulator with sinusoidal time embedding and Fourier neural operator, trained with three physics-informed losses.
summary_en.result: Achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and computational speed on a large-scale chemical dataset.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical experiments on a newly proposed large-scale chemical dataset.

title: Batch Active Learning in Gaussian Process Regression using Derivatives
relevance_to_user: 提出利用导数信息的批量主动学习，可提高高斯过程回归的采样效率，适用于替代模型构建，但未针对约束处理或生物力学设计验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not handle constraints, does not test on biomechanics/implant design, and does not include FEA-based validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高高斯过程回归的采样效率
summary_zh.method: 利用导数信息和预测协方差矩阵进行批量主动学习
summary_zh.result: 在多个应用中验证了方法的有效性
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: To improve the sampling efficiency of Gaussian process regression by incorporating derivative information in batch active learning.
summary_en.method: The proposed method selects data batches using the predictive covariance matrix, exploiting derivative information to enhance sampling.
summary_en.result: Empirical comparisons demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach across diverse applications.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark experiments on various datasets.

title: Huge Ensembles Part II: Properties of a Huge Ensemble of Hindcasts Generated with Spherical Fourier Neural Operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了使用神经算子和集成方法进行不确定性量化的框架，可迁移到生物力学有限元代理建模中的采样效率问题，但未涉及约束处理或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No direct application to FEA surrogate modelling for implant design, no constraint handling, and no biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 以极少计算资源生成大规模集合预报以改进极端天气采样。
summary_zh.method: 利用球面傅里叶神经算子结合初值扰动和模型多样性生成7424成员集合。
summary_zh.result: 集合预报在物理保真度和极端事件采样上与业务系统相当。
summary_zh.validation: 基于2023年夏季每日再分析资料与业务预报对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To generate huge ensembles for weather forecasting with orders-of-magnitude lower computational cost while maintaining operational-level performance.
summary_en.method: Spherical Fourier Neural Operators are employed with bred vectors for initial perturbations and multiple checkpoints for model perturbations to create a 7,424-member ensemble.
summary_en.result: The huge ensemble (HENS) achieves comparable physical fidelity to operational systems, samples extreme events up to 4σ, and improves uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using daily summer 2023 reanalysis data and comparisons against operational ensemble forecasts.

title: Frequency-Explicit Shape Holomorphy in Uncertainty Quantification for Acoustic Scattering
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了频率显式的形状全纯性方法，可用于高维不确定性量化代理模型构建，有望迁移至植入物形状设计中的替代模型。
why_not_core: This paper does not address any biomechanical or implant design application, nor does it provide specific numerical benchmarks for structural mechanics FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 考虑声学散射中的形状不确定性，高效构建代理模型
summary_zh.method: 基于Helmholtz传输问题的频率显式稳定性，建立散射场对形状参数的全纯依赖
summary_zh.result: 得到频率显式的形状全纯性，支撑高维代理模型构建
summary_zh.validation: 纯理论分析，无数值实验

summary_en.motivation: Efficient construction of surrogate models for acoustic scattering with shape uncertainty.
summary_en.method: Using wavenumber-explicit stability results for Helmholtz transmission problems to prove holomorphic dependence of scattered field on shape parameters.
summary_en.result: Frequency-explicit shape holomorphy enabling efficient high-dimensional surrogate modeling.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical derivation without numerical or experimental validation.

title: Active Learning for Neural PDE Solvers
relevance_to_user: 该论文的主动学习策略可用于减少生物力学代理模型所需的训练数据，但未直接应用于植入物设计。
why_not_core: Does not include implant design or biomechanics validation, no experimental or clinical validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少神经PDE求解器所需的大量训练数据
summary_zh.method: 提出AL4PDE基准测试，评估批量主动学习算法
summary_zh.result: 主动学习将平均误差降低高达71%
summary_zh.validation: 在参数化PDE基准上进行数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the large amount of training data required for neural PDE solvers via active learning.
summary_en.method: Proposes AL4PDE, a modular benchmark for evaluating batch active learning algorithms with surrogate models and parametric PDEs.
summary_en.result: Active learning reduces average error by up to 71% and generates reusable datasets with consistent parameter distributions.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on multiple parametric PDEs using state-of-the-art surrogate models in a solver-in-the-loop setting.

title: Optimizing the selective laser melting molding process for TC4 spatial mesh structures
venue: Journal of Mechanical Science and Technology
first_author_affiliation: School of Smart Manufacturing, Jianghan University, Wuhan, 430056, China

corresponding_authors.name: Liang Xuan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Smart Manufacturing, Jianghan University, Wuhan, 430056, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文针对TC4空间网状结构优化SLM工艺，直接关联增材制造生物医用植入体的多孔结构制造与力学性能匹配。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on process optimization without explicit mention of fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化选区激光熔化工艺以制备性能优良的TC4空间网状结构。
summary_zh.method: 通过调整激光功率、扫描速度等参数成型网状结构并测试力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 确定了最优工艺参数，获得了高致密度和良好力学性能的网状结构。
summary_zh.validation: 通过密度测量和压缩试验验证了工艺优化效果。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize the selective laser melting process for fabricating TC4 spatial mesh structures with improved mechanical performance.
summary_en.method: The study varies laser power and scanning speed to produce mesh structures and evaluates their densification and mechanical properties.
summary_en.result: Optimal processing parameters are identified, yielding high-density spatial meshes with enhanced compressive strength.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via density measurements and compression testing on printed specimens.

why_not_core: This paper focuses on flexural properties of lattice structures, not on stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration in hip implants.

summary_zh.method: 实验力学测试与有限元模拟结合
summary_zh.result: 揭示了两种材料点阵的弯曲变形机制
summary_zh.validation: 实验与数值模拟对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the flexural behavior of SLM-fabricated lattice structures for potential biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: Combined experimental three-point bending tests with finite element simulations.
summary_en.result: The deformation mechanisms and stiffness of lattices differ between Ti-6Al-4V and Inconel 625.
summary_en.validation: Experimental results validated against numerical predictions.

title: Gaussian Processes Sampling with Sparse Grids under Additive Schwarz Preconditioner
relevance_to_user: 该方法提高了高斯过程采样的效率，可用于替代模型中不确定性量化的计算加速。
why_not_core: Does not apply to FEA surrogate modelling directly, lacks constraint handling, and is not validated on biomechanical or implant design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高斯过程采样计算效率低的问题。
summary_zh.method: 利用稀疏网格的诱导点近似和加性 Schwarz 预条件子加速采样。
summary_zh.result: 方法在数值实验中展示了高效率和准确性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值基准实验验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: Efficient sampling from Gaussian process priors and posteriors is computationally demanding for large datasets.
summary_en.method: Proposes a scalable GP sampling algorithm using inducing points approximation on sparse grids combined with an additive Schwarz preconditioner.
summary_en.result: The method achieves faster convergence and accuracy compared to direct methods and recent alternatives.
summary_en.validation: Validation involves numerical experiments on benchmark functions and comparison with existing sampling techniques.

title: Alpha-VI DeepONet: A prior-robust variational Bayesian approach for enhancing DeepONets with uncertainty quantification
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过贝叶斯DeepONet和Rényi散度实现不确定性量化，可迁移至植入物生物力学代理建模，但未直接处理约束优化。
why_not_core: The paper does not address constraint handling or multi-objective optimization, and its validation is on generic PDE systems rather than implant-specific biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 针对标准变分贝叶斯DeepONet先验误设定的问题，提出鲁棒性更强的算子学习框架。
summary_zh.method: 基于Rényi α散度的广义变分推理结合贝叶斯神经网络构建DeepONet。
summary_zh.result: 在力学系统上比确定性和KLD方法预测更准，不确定性量化更优。
summary_zh.validation: 在重力摆、对流扩散和扩散反应等数值算例上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard variational Bayesian DeepONets suffer from prior misspecification; this work aims to improve robustness by using generalized variational inference with Rényi α-divergence.
summary_en.method: A prior-robust variational Bayesian DeepONet framework is developed by integrating Bayesian neural networks and optimizing Rényi α-divergence instead of KL divergence.
summary_en.result: The proposed approach achieves lower mean squared error and better negative log-likelihood on test sets compared to deterministic and KLD-based VI DeepONets across multiple mechanics problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks including gravity pendulum, advection-diffusion, and diffusion-reaction systems.

title: Aggregation Models with Optimal Weights for Distributed Gaussian Processes
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种分布式高斯过程的聚合方法，可提高代理模型的预测效率，但未直接应用于有限元或生物力学设计，需自行转化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on methodological improvements for distributed GP aggregation without addressing FEA surrogate-specific challenges such as constraint handling, multi-objective optimization, or biomechanical design transfer.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决大规模高斯过程计算负担，提高聚合预测的准确性和稳定性。
summary_zh.method: 提出带最优权重的聚合模型，融合专家间的相关性，适用于精确和稀疏变分高斯过程。
summary_zh.result: 比现有方法更稳定、更准确的预测，且计算时间更短。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数据集上进行实证研究，与传统聚合模型对比。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the prediction accuracy and computational efficiency of aggregated Gaussian processes for large-scale datasets.
summary_en.method: Proposes an aggregation model with optimal weights incorporating correlations among GP experts, applicable to both exact and sparse variational GPs.
summary_en.result: The method achieves more stable and accurate predictions with lower computational cost compared to state-of-the-art consistent aggregation models.
summary_en.validation: Validated through empirical studies on benchmark datasets, demonstrating improved performance over existing methods.

relevance_to_user: 该论文虽涉及3D打印多孔假体与骨整合，但集中于临床疗效评估，未包含LPBF制造工艺、力学测试或疲劳分析。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on clinical outcomes of 3D-printed hemipelvic implants, but does not include LPBF fabrication details, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), stress shielding analysis, or surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估3D打印定制半骨盆假体在骨盆肿瘤切除后重建的长期疗效。
summary_zh.method: 对96名患者进行回顾性研究，使用3D打印定制假体重建，随访中位48个月。
summary_zh.result: 72.9%无病生存，MSTS功能评分从12.2提升至23.8，并发症率13.5%。
summary_zh.validation: 临床随访及影像学T-SMART评估骨整合。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the long-term efficacy of 3D-printed custom hemipelvic endoprostheses for pelvic girdle reconstruction after tumor resection.
summary_en.method: A retrospective study of 96 patients who received 3D-printed custom hemipelvic implants, with a median follow-up of 48 months.
summary_en.result: 72.9% of patients remained disease-free, MSTS-93 functional score improved from 12.2 to 23.8, and complications occurred in 13.5% of cases.
summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up and T-SMART imaging were used to assess osseointegration.

title: Regime-Aware Time Weighting for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出基于Lyapunov指数的PINN时间加权策略，可提升求解动态系统的代理模型精度，但未涉及生物力学约束或不确定性量化，需进一步验证在植入物设计中的可迁移性。
why_not_core: It does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on time weighting for PINNs on general PDEs.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升物理信息神经网络求解含时微分方程的精度与收敛速度
summary_zh.method: 基于Lyapunov指数自动调整时间采样权重，适配系统稳定性（混沌/周期/稳定）
summary_zh.result: 在混沌Lorenz系统和Burgers方程上收敛更快、精度更高且无需超参数调优
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准上验证有效性

summary_en.motivation: To improve the convergence and accuracy of physics-informed neural networks for time-dependent differential equations by adapting time sampling and weighting.
summary_en.method: A principled weighting scheme based on Lyapunov exponents that automatically adjusts weights according to the stability regime (chaotic, periodic, stable) of the system.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves faster convergence and higher accuracy on challenging benchmarks like the chaotic Lorenz system and Burgers' equation without additional hyperparameter tuning.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard benchmark problems demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness.

title: Fisher-Rao distance between truncated distributions and robustness analysis in uncertainty quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于Fisher-Rao距离的截断分布鲁棒性分析方法，可迁移至生物力学不确定性量化问题。
why_not_core: Does not address surrogate model construction, does not reduce FEA sampling cost, and lacks application to implant or biomechanics scenarios.

summary_zh.motivation: 为不确定性量化中的鲁棒性分析提供通用方法，考虑截断分布的情况。
summary_zh.method: 利用Fisher-Rao距离在黎曼流形上定义分布变差类，计算输出量边界。
summary_zh.result: 在简化工业案例中验证了该方法对截断分布的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 基于简化工业模型的数值案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a generic framework for robustness analysis in uncertainty quantification that accounts for truncated input distributions commonly found in applications.
summary_en.method: Defines variational classes of parametric distributions using the Fisher-Rao geodesic distance on the Riemannian manifold, then computes boundary values for quantities of interest.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates feasibility on a simplified industrial case study, showing that the method can handle truncation constraints.
summary_en.validation: Validated through a numerical simulation case on a simplified industrial model.

title: Machine learning surrogates for efficient hydrologic modeling: Insights from stochastic simulations of managed aquifer recharge
relevance_to_user: 该论文演示了机器学习代理模型在水文建模中的应用，其方法可迁移到生物力学设计中的代理建模，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraints, uncertainty quantification in the surrogate itself, or biomechanics/implant design applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决水文模型计算昂贵，无法进行不确定性分析和优化的问题
summary_zh.method: 用过程模型生成训练数据，训练CNN、RNN、ViT等机器学习代理模型
summary_zh.result: 代理模型预测误差低于10%，计算速度提升一个数量级
summary_zh.validation: 与过程模型数值模拟结果对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the computational expense of process-based hydrologic models for uncertainty quantification and optimization.
summary_en.method: A hybrid workflow using process-based models to generate training data for ML surrogate models, including CNN, RNN, ViT, and Fourier networks.
summary_en.result: ML surrogates achieve under 10% mean absolute percentage error and order-of-magnitude runtime savings.
summary_en.validation: Validation against the process-based hydrologic model on a managed aquifer recharge case study.

title: Invariant deep neural networks under the finite group for solving partial differential equations
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过群对称性增强神经网络结构，提高了PINN在采样域内外求解PDE的精度和泛化能力，可迁移至代理模型以提升采样效率，但未涉及不确定性量化或约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address uncertainty quantification, constraint handling, or transfer to implant/biomechanics design; validation is limited to PDE benchmarks without FEA or biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升PINN在采样域内外的预测精度和泛化能力。
summary_zh.method: 通过扩展权重矩阵和偏置维度，构建有限群不变深度神经网络sDNN。
summary_zh.result: sDNN在采样域内外预测能力远优于原PINN，且参数量更少。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个PDE基准问题上的数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and extrapolation capability of PINNs for solving PDEs both inside and outside the training domain.
summary_en.method: A symmetry-enhanced DNN (sDNN) is designed by expanding weight matrices and bias vectors according to the order of a finite group to enforce invariance under group actions.
summary_en.result: The sDNN achieves significantly better predictive performance than vanilla PINN with fewer training points and simpler architecture, both in-domain and out-of-domain.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard PDE benchmarks validate the improved accuracy and generalization.

key_terms.zh: 对称增强深度神经网络

title: Improving PINNs By Algebraic Inclusion of Boundary and Initial Conditions
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过代数方式强制边界条件提升了PINN的稳定性和精度，可迁移到生物力学代理模型中提高训练效率。
why_not_core: This paper lacks validation on implant/biomechanics FE problems, does not address multi-objective constraints or uncertainty quantification, and focuses only on PDE benchmark problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升PINN训练的稳定性与精度
summary_zh.method: 通过代数变换将边界/初始条件强制集成到网络输出中
summary_zh.result: 在多个PDE基准上实现了数量级更低的相对误差
summary_zh.validation: 在多个线性和非线性PDE精确解场景下进行数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the training instability of physics-informed neural networks by algebraically enforcing boundary and initial conditions.
summary_en.method: The neural network output is transformed through a non-linear algebraic expression that inherently satisfies boundary/initial conditions, reducing the loss function complexity.
summary_en.result: Orders of magnitude reduction in fractional errors compared to standard PINNs on multiple linear and nonlinear PDE benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Empirically validated on a set of linear and nonlinear PDEs with known analytical solutions, using hundreds of unsupervised experiments.

title: DKL-KAN: Scalable Deep Kernel Learning using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的DKL-KAN方法可迁移到生物力学代理模型和不确定性量化中，但未涉及具体植入物或FEA场景。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to FEA or biomechanics problems, and lacks validation on implant design or surrogate modeling tasks.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升深度核学习在大数据集上的可扩展性与表达能力
summary_zh.method: 用KAN替代MLP构建深度核，结合KISS-GP实现大规模高斯过程
summary_zh.result: 小样本性能优于DKL-MLP，但大样本扩展性和精度不如
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准回归数据集上对比训练时间和预测精度

summary_en.motivation: The need for scalable and expressive deep kernel methods that combine structural depth with non-parametric flexibility motivates this work.
summary_en.method: The authors propose DKL-KAN, which replaces the MLP feature extractor in deep kernel learning with a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network and uses KISS-GP for scalability.
summary_en.result: DKL-KAN achieves better accuracy on small datasets but underperforms DKL-MLP on large datasets in terms of scalability and test accuracy.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on multiple benchmark regression datasets, comparing computational time and prediction accuracy against DKL-MLP.

key_terms.zh: 柯尔莫戈罗夫-阿诺德网络

title: Improved physics-informed neural network in mitigating gradient related failures
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过改进PINN架构克服梯度失效，可迁移至生物力学代理模型但尚未验证约束处理与UQ。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or any implant/biomechanics application, and only validates on standard PDE benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN训练中梯度相关失效导致精度和收敛性不足的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出改进的PINN架构，结合自适应权重的上界策略
summary_zh.result: 在不增加计算复杂度下精度提升一个数量级并加速收敛
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准数值基准上验证精度和泛化能力

summary_en.motivation: To overcome gradient-related failures in physics-informed neural networks that degrade predictive accuracy and convergence.
summary_en.method: An improved PINN architecture is proposed that combines network enhancements with adaptive upper-bound weights.
summary_en.result: The method achieves at least one order of magnitude accuracy improvement and faster convergence without extra computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a variety of standard PDE benchmark problems.

title: Comparison of femoral bone remodeling after total hip arthroplasty with cementless short-tapered wedge stem and fully hydroxyapatite-coated stem
venue: Archives of Orthopaedic and Trauma Surgery

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Mie University Graduate School of Medicine, 2-174, Edobashi, 514- 8507, Tsu, Mie, Japan

why_not_core: No micromotion quantification, no contact/friction modeling, no finite element analysis; provides only clinical bone remodeling outcomes.

summary_zh.motivation: 对比两种无骨水泥股骨柄对股骨骨重塑的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过临床随访和影像学评估骨密度变化。
summary_zh.result: 短锥形柄与全HA涂层柄在骨重塑模式上存在差异。
