summary_en.motivation: To compare femoral bone remodeling patterns between two cementless stem designs after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Clinical follow-up with radiographic evaluation of bone mineral density changes in Gruen zones.
summary_en.result: Different bone remodeling patterns were observed between the short-tapered wedge stem and fully HA-coated stem.
summary_en.validation: Validated using patient cohort data with DXA or radiographic analysis.

title: Fatigue fracture of 316L steel manufactured by selective laser melting method
first_author_affiliation: A. A. Baikov Institute of Metallurgy and Materials Science of Russian Academy of Sciences

corresponding_authors.name: Liudmila Botvina
corresponding_authors.affiliation: A. A. Baikov Institute of Metallurgy and Materials Science of Russian Academy of Sciences

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了选区激光熔化316L钢的疲劳断裂行为，对理解激光粉末床熔融生物植入物的疲劳性能有参考价值，但未涉及应力遮挡或骨整合。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures for stress shielding mitigation, nor does it evaluate surface roughness for osseointegration, and it lacks a biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究选区激光熔化316L钢的疲劳裂纹行为
summary_zh.method: 通过疲劳实验和断口分析研究短裂纹扩展动力学
summary_zh.result: 发现裂纹沿熔合边界扩展，疲劳曲线低于传统制造钢，但优化工艺和热处理可提升性能
summary_zh.validation: 与文献中传统和增材制造材料的疲劳曲线对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the fatigue crack growth behavior of 316L steel fabricated by selective laser melting, focusing on short crack kinetics.
summary_en.method: Fatigue experiments and fractography were conducted to study short crack propagation and the Paris equation parameters.
summary_en.result: Short cracks initiate at technological defects and propagate along fusion boundaries, with the fatigue curve lying below that of traditionally manufactured steel, but optimal processing and heat treatment can improve fatigue properties.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed by comparing the fatigue curve with literature data for both additive and conventionally manufactured steels.

title: Bayesian meta learning for trustworthy uncertainty quantification
relevance_to_user: 提出了可信不确定性量化的贝叶斯元学习方法，可用于代理模型的不确定性评估，但未涉及有限元或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No application to FEA surrogate modeling, no constraint handling, and no demonstration on implant/biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现无需强先验假设的可信贝叶斯回归不确定性量化。
summary_zh.method: 提出Trust-Bayes优化框架，通过元学习保证预测区间覆盖真实值的概率。
summary_zh.result: 证明了覆盖概率的下界和样本复杂度，高斯过程回归案例验证了方法有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过蒙特卡洛模拟的高斯过程回归案例进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To achieve trustworthy uncertainty quantification in Bayesian regression without strong prior assumptions on the function distribution.
summary_en.method: Proposes Trust-Bayes, an optimization framework for Bayesian meta-learning that guarantees a pre-specified probability of ground truth being captured by predictive intervals.
summary_en.result: Establishes lower bounds on coverage probability and analyzes sample complexity; verified through Monte Carlo simulation of Gaussian process regression.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark via Monte Carlo simulation of a Gaussian process regression case study.

title: Towards Robust Hemolysis Modeling with Uncertainty Quantification: A Universal Approach to Address Experimental Variance
relevance_to_user: 该论文针对数值模型中的不确定性量化，方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但与植入体设计无直接关联。
why_not_core: Does not address structural FEA, implant biomechanics, or multi-objective optimization; focuses on hemolysis in fluid devices.

summary_zh.motivation: 数值溶血模型缺乏不确定性量化，需提升预测鲁棒性。
summary_zh.method: 采用MCMC方法拟合溶血幂律模型参数，得到随机分布并传递给降阶模型。
summary_zh.result: MCMC揭示了多局部最优，参数对数正态分布，较好匹配实验均值和方差。
summary_zh.validation: 通过FDA基准泵的实验溶血数据集验证模型预测的不确定性。

summary_en.motivation: Numerical hemolysis models lack uncertainty quantification, limiting their predictive robustness for medical device evaluation.
summary_en.method: Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) was applied to experimental hemolysis data to derive stochastic distributions for Power Law model parameters, which were then propagated through a reduced order model of the FDA benchmark pump.
summary_en.result: The MCMC analysis revealed multiple local minima in the fitting, yielding lognormal distributions for α and β, and closely matching the mean and variance of experimental hemolysis measurements.
summary_en.validation: The approach was validated against experimental hemolysis data from the FDA benchmark pump, demonstrating improved ability to capture experimental variation compared to deterministic models.

title: Multi-Scenario and Stochastic Thermo-Electro-Mechanical Modeling of Failure in Power Transmission Lines
relevance_to_user: 本文采用概率配置法进行多物理场不确定性量化，其随机建模和灵敏度分析方法可迁移至生物力学或植入物设计的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper addresses power transmission line failure, not biomedical implant or biomechanics, and does not involve surrogate modeling for expensive finite element simulations of implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 输电线路在恶劣环境下面临失效风险，需要多物理场模型评估可靠性。
summary_zh.method: 构建热电-力学耦合相场模型，并采用概率配置法进行不确定性量化。
summary_zh.result: 确定性分析揭示了温度与损伤演化，随机分析给出了失效概率和灵敏度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过概率配置法对比确定性基准案例进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Transmission lines are subject to catastrophic failures under extreme environmental conditions, necessitating a comprehensive multiphysics model to assess long-term reliability.
summary_en.method: A coupled thermo-electro-mechanical phase-field model is developed, and the Probabilistic Collocation Method is employed for forward uncertainty propagation and sensitivity analysis.
summary_en.result: Deterministic scenario studies reveal temperature and damage evolution, while stochastic analysis provides failure probability and identifies key risk factors.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated numerically by comparing probabilistic results with deterministic baseline scenarios.

title: Compressive Behavior of Novel Additively Manufactured Ti-6Al-4V Lattice Structures: Experimental and Numerical Studies.

relevance_to_user: 该论文通过SLM制备钛合金点阵结构并测试其压缩性能，直接关联应力屏蔽和刚度匹配，但缺乏疲劳和表面形貌分析。
why_not_core: No fatigue testing, no surface morphology or osseointegration characterization, only static compression.

summary_zh.motivation: 设计新型点阵结构以匹配骨组织刚度，减少应力屏蔽
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备钛合金螺旋、椭圆及金字塔点阵，进行压缩实验和有限元分析

summary_zh.validation: 通过万能试验机压缩测试验证力学性能

summary_en.motivation: To design novel lattice structures that match bone stiffness and reduce stress shielding for biomedical implants.
summary_en.method: Ti-6Al-4V lattice structures with helical, elliptic, pyramid, and functionally graded designs were fabricated via selective laser melting and tested under compression with finite element analysis.
summary_en.result: Elliptic and functionally graded elliptic lattices exhibited elastic moduli of 0.76 and 0.67 GPa, suitable for cancellous bone, while other designs offered higher strengths for cortical bone applications.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests using a universal testing machine and numerical simulations validated the mechanical performance.

title: Biomineralization Induction for 3D Bioprinted Osteogenic Structures Informed by Bioimaging-Biomodelling Techniques Through Geometrical Efficiency, and Hydrogel Optimization

summary_zh.motivation: 利用AI生成设计与水凝胶优化制造仿生矿化骨结构。
summary_zh.method: 结合深度学习生成模型（CNN、扩散模型、Transformer）与水凝胶合成及矿化实验。
summary_zh.result: 实现具有增强性能的矿化结构，扩散模型在生成设计上优于CNN。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM、力学测试验证水凝胶矿化能力与结构性能。

summary_en.motivation: To design and fabricate mineralized biomimetic bone structures by combining AI generative design with optimized hydrogel formulations.
summary_en.method: Deep learning generative models (CNN, diffusion, transformers) were coupled with calcium phosphate-enhanced hydrogel synthesis and biomineralization induction.
summary_en.result: Mineralized bone-like structures with improved mechanical properties were obtained; diffusion models outperformed CNNs in generating biomimetic designs from μ-CT data.
summary_en.validation: The hydrogel's mineralization potential and mechanical performance were experimentally validated via SEM, rheology, and compression testing.

title: Amortized Active Learning for Nonparametric Functions
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过预训练神经网络实现零样本主动学习，有望迁移至生物力学代理模型的主动采样问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or biomechanical implant design; it focuses on generic nonparametric function learning with synthetic data.

summary_zh.motivation: 主动学习训练成本高，尤其是高斯过程复杂度为三次方。
summary_zh.method: 提出摊销主动学习，用预训练神经网络零样本建议新数据点。
summary_zh.result: 实现实时数据选择，性能与耗时基线方法相当。
summary_zh.validation: 在模拟函数上验证零样本泛化能力。

summary_en.motivation: Active learning with Gaussian processes suffers from high computational cost due to cubic complexity and repeated optimization.
summary_en.method: An amortized active learning method is proposed, training a neural network policy on simulated GP priors to suggest new data points without retraining.
summary_en.result: The method achieves real-time data selection with comparable learning performance to expensive baseline methods.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic nonparametric functions, demonstrating zero-shot generalization from simulation to real tasks.

title: Pretraining a Neural Operator in Lower Dimensions
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种在低维PDE上预训练神经算子的方法，可迁移至高维PDE求解，对构建FEA替代模型有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not handle constraints or uncertainty quantification, and lacks validation on implant/biomechanics design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低高维PDE数据收集成本，提高神经算子训练效率。
summary_zh.method: 基于因子化傅里叶神经算子在低维PDE上预训练，再微调至更高维PDE。
summary_zh.result: 预训练策略能提升高维PDE求解精度，且参数可复用。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE数值基准上验证迁移效果。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the expensive data generation cost for high-dimensional PDE solvers by pretraining on lower-dimensional PDEs.
summary_en.method: Pretrain a Factorized Fourier Neural Operator on low-dimensional PDEs and fine-tune it for higher-dimensional PDEs using parameter reuse.
summary_en.result: The pretraining strategy improves accuracy on higher-dimensional PDEs and allows parameter reuse across dimensions.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks comparing performance of pretrained vs. from-scratch models.

title: Effect of Particle Size on Mechanical Properties of CoCrMo-Ni@Al2O3 Composites Prepared by Selective Laser Melting

summary_zh.motivation: 研究颗粒尺寸对SLM制备的CoCrMo-Ni@Al2O3复合材料力学性能的影响。

summary_zh.result: 发现颗粒尺寸影响硬度和强度等力学性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Investigate the effect of particle size on mechanical properties of CoCrMo-Ni@Al2O3 composites fabricated by selective laser melting.

summary_en.result: Particle size significantly influences hardness and strength.

title: Sobolev neural network with residual weighting as a surrogate in linear and non-linear mechanics
relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对计算力学中的代理建模，通过Sobolev训练利用灵敏度信息提高采样效率，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not handle constraints, uncertainty quantification, or explicit transfer to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高计算力学中代理模型的训练效率和泛化能力
summary_zh.method: 在损失函数中加入灵敏度损失项并使用自适应残差权重调整
summary_zh.result: 在线性和非线性材料算例中展示出更低的泛化误差和更快收敛
summary_zh.validation: 通过线性和非线性材料数值算例验证方法有效性

summary_en.motivation: To improve the training efficiency and generalization of neural network surrogates in computational mechanics by incorporating sensitivity information.
summary_en.method: Sobolev training expands the loss function with derivative-based terms, where residual weights are adaptively optimized to balance response and sensitivity losses.
summary_en.result: The proposed method demonstrates lower generalization error and faster convergence on linear and nonlinear material behavior examples.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks of linear and nonlinear material models.

title: A spatiotemporal deep learning framework for prediction of crack dynamics in heterogeneous solids: efficient mapping of concrete microstructures to its fracture properties
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的时空深度学习框架可用于替代昂贵断裂模拟，方法可迁移至植入物力学分析，但缺乏生物力学验证。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no implant or biomechanics validation, no uncertainty quantification, and only demonstrated on concrete fracture.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效预测非均质材料断裂过程，避免昂贵相场模拟。
summary_zh.method: 以UNet预测断裂历史，将不规则有限元数据转换为规则网格作为输入。
summary_zh.result: UNet能准确预测未见混凝土细观结构的损伤演化和应力-应变曲线。
summary_zh.validation: 基于470组高保真相场模拟数据训练，在测试集上验证预测精度。

summary_en.motivation: To enable efficient full-field prediction of crack initiation and propagation in heterogeneous solids without costly phase-field simulations.
summary_en.method: A UNet-based spatiotemporal framework predicts sequential damage and stress fields from material property maps, converting irregular FE data to regular grids.
summary_en.result: The surrogate accurately predicts damage evolution and stress-strain curves for unseen concrete mesostructures using only 470 training datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validated against high-fidelity cohesive phase-field fracture simulations of 2D concrete mesostructures with varying aggregate geometries.

title: XI-DeepONet: An operator learning method for elliptic interface problems

summary_zh.motivation: 解决椭圆界面问题中复杂几何的求解效率问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出XI-DeepONet，将界面几何作为额外输入，无需网格和数据对。
summary_zh.result: 数值实验证明了方法的准确性和鲁棒性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准数值基准测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve parametric elliptic interface problems without meshing.
summary_en.method: Proposed XI-DeepONet incorporating interface geometry as input and training without data pairs.
summary_en.result: Demonstrated accuracy and robustness on numerical benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard numerical benchmark problems.

title: Separable DeepONet: Breaking the Curse of Dimensionality in Physics-Informed Machine Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效的神经算子架构，可潜在用于生物力学有限元代理模型，但尚未在植入物设计或生物医学场景中验证。
why_not_core: It does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or any biomedical application; validation is limited to benchmark PDEs without experimental or clinical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决DeepONet在高维PDE中的维度灾难问题
summary_zh.method: 提出可分离架构，每个子网络处理一维坐标，结合前向自动微分
summary_zh.result: 计算成本从指数降为线性，精度相当或更好
summary_zh.validation: 在Burgers方程、Biot固结理论和参数化热方程上验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the curse of dimensionality in physics-informed DeepONet for high-dimensional PDEs.
summary_en.method: A separable architecture factorizes the operator network into sub-networks for each coordinate, combined with forward-mode automatic differentiation to reduce Jacobian cost.
summary_en.result: Computational cost scales linearly with discretization density, and accuracy is comparable or improved.
summary_en.validation: Tested on viscous Burgers equation, Biot's consolidation theory, and a parametrized heat equation.

title: Practical multi-fidelity machine learning: fusion of deterministic and Bayesian models
relevance_to_user: 该方法提供了通用的多保真机器学习框架，可用于生物力学和植入物设计的代理建模，但未直接应用于该领域。

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多保真数据融合中精度与效率的权衡问题

summary_zh.result: 在数据稀缺场景下显著减少训练时间，且性能与最先进方法相当
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值算例和两个工程问题验证方法有效性和效率

summary_en.motivation: To address the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in multi-fidelity data fusion by proposing a practical strategy that integrates deterministic and Bayesian models.
summary_en.method: A three-model strategy is introduced: a deterministic low-fidelity model, a transfer-learned model, and a Bayesian residual model, trained in a staggered scheme.
summary_en.result: The proposed approach achieves comparable mean and uncertainty estimation while significantly reducing training time in data-scarce scenarios and mitigating overfitting in data-rich settings.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through numerical examples and two engineering problems, demonstrating effectiveness and efficiency.

title: Gaussian Process Model with Tensorial Inputs and Its Application to the Design of 3D Printed Antennas

summary_zh.result: 数值算例表明该方法有效提升了代理模型精度

summary_en.motivation: To incorporate spatial information from freeform 3D printed designs into Gaussian process surrogates for simulation-based optimization.

summary_en.validation: Performance is demonstrated on several numerical examples of 3D printed antenna designs using publicly available datasets.

title: Conformal Thresholded Intervals for Efficient Regression

summary_zh.method: 使用多输出分位数回归估计条件概率密度，通过阈值化间隔长度构建预测集
summary_zh.result: 在多个数据集上实现了比现有方法更小的预测集并维持期望覆盖率

summary_en.motivation: To produce the smallest possible prediction sets with guaranteed coverage in regression tasks.
summary_en.method: Estimates conditional probability density via multi-output quantile regression and constructs prediction sets by thresholding interquantile intervals based on length.
summary_en.result: Achieves smaller prediction sets than state-of-the-art conformal regression methods while maintaining desired coverage across various datasets.
summary_en.validation: Empirically validated on multiple benchmark datasets against existing conformal regression approaches.

title: Temperature Distribution Prediction in Laser Powder Bed Fusion using Transferable and Scalable Graph Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用图神经网络作为有限元热模拟的替代模型，可转移至生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真加速。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling, and no application to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低激光粉末床熔融过程热模拟的计算成本。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of thermal simulation in laser powder bed fusion processes.
summary_en.method: Developed single-laser and multi-laser Graph Neural Network surrogates that learn thermal dynamics from finite element simulations.
summary_en.result: The single-laser model achieved a mean absolute percentage error of 3.77%, and the multi-laser model showed a 46.4% improvement over baseline.
summary_en.validation: Validated by comparing predictions against high-fidelity finite element simulation results.

title: Non-Asymptotic Uncertainty Quantification in High-Dimensional Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的不确定性量化方法可迁移至代理模型，但未涉及仿真采样效率或工程约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or biomechanics/implant design; it is a purely theoretical UQ method for high-dimensional regression.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有去偏LASSO方法在有限样本下置信区间过窄，需要非渐近修正。
summary_zh.method: 利用高维集中现象估计偏差项的均值和方差，调整置信区间。
summary_zh.result: 得到非渐近置信区间，避免高维问题中不确定性被低估。
summary_zh.validation: 理论推导和数值示例（MRI诊断），无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: The debiased LASSO yields overly narrow confidence intervals in finite samples due to non-negligible bias, motivating a non-asymptotic adjustment.
summary_en.method: A data-driven correction that estimates bias means and variances from training data using high-dimensional concentration phenomena is proposed.
summary_en.result: Non-asymptotic confidence intervals are derived, improving UQ reliability for LASSO and neural networks in regression tasks.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated theoretically and illustrated on MRI diagnosis examples without experimental or simulation benchmarks.

summary_en.motivation: To develop an accurate analytical model for predicting compressive strengths of micro-lattice structures
summary_en.method: A new analytical model based on limit analysis in plasticity theory was developed and validated with finite element simulations and experimental compression tests on SLM-fabricated AlSi10Mg and WE43 lattices
summary_en.result: Analytical, FE, and experimental results showed good agreement, and shear band formation was evaluated using Rudnicki-Rice criterion
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests on additively manufactured lattice specimens

title: A Resolution Independent Neural Operator
relevance_to_user: 该方法可处理任意采样的输入输出数据，为解决生物力学代理建模中传感器位置不规则问题提供思路。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no uncertainty quantification, and no multi-objective constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决操作学习中对固定输入采样位置的依赖问题
summary_zh.method: 提出RINO框架，使用字典学习和隐式神经表示学习连续基函数
summary_zh.result: 在任意采样条件下保持精度，优于标准DeepONet
summary_zh.validation: 多个数值算例验证，包括不同分辨率输入输出

summary_en.motivation: To enable operator learning from arbitrarily sampled input-output data without requiring fixed sensor locations.
summary_en.method: Proposes the Resolution Independent Neural Operator (RINO) using dictionary learning and implicit neural representations to learn continuous basis functions.
summary_en.result: RINO maintains accuracy across varying sensor resolutions and outperforms standard DeepONet on benchmark problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on multiple numerical examples including solutions of partial differential equations with arbitrary sensor placements.

title: Global Optimisation of Black-Box Functions with Generative Models in the Wasserstein Space
relevance_to_user: 该方法利用生成式代理模型进行黑箱优化，并引入Wasserstein不确定性估计，虽未直接应用于FEA，但可迁移到生物力学仿真优化中。
why_not_core: The paper does not validate on FEA or biomechanics problems, does not handle explicit design constraints, and lacks any implant or biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高黑箱模拟器在随机响应和高维情况下的优化鲁棒性。
summary_zh.method: 利用生成式代理模型建模响应面，基于Wasserstein距离估计不确定性指导搜索。
summary_zh.result: 该方法在多种黑箱函数和随机响应上优于深度高斯过程等基线方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值测试函数上验证，未涉及真实工程或生物医学问题。

summary_en.motivation: We aim to improve the robustness of black-box optimization for stochastic simulators and high-dimensional parameter spaces.
summary_en.method: A deep generative surrogate models the entire parameter space response, and a Wasserstein distance-based uncertainty estimator drives a regret-minimizing gradient-free optimization.
summary_en.result: The proposed method demonstrates superior robustness to function shape and stochasticity compared to state-of-the-art methods like deep Gaussian process-based efficient global optimization.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic benchmark functions; no real-world FEA or biomedical simulations are used.

title: Dilated convolution neural operator for multiscale partial differential equations
relevance_to_user: 该方法可作为多尺度PDE的代理模型，但未在生物力学或植入物设计中进行验证。
why_not_core: No application to implant biomechanics or biomedical FEA; no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification demonstrated.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升多尺度PDE代理模型对高频信息的捕捉能力
summary_zh.method: 结合膨胀卷积与傅里叶层的混合神经网络算子(DCNO)
summary_zh.result: 在保持精度的同时降低计算成本，优于现有方法
summary_zh.validation: 在多尺度椭圆、Navier-Stokes等基准PDE上验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve operator learning for multiscale PDEs by preserving high-frequency information that is often lost in standard methods.
summary_en.method: Proposes the Dilated Convolutional Neural Operator (DCNO) combining dilated convolution and Fourier layers to capture both low- and high-frequency features efficiently.
summary_en.result: DCNO achieves optimal trade-off between accuracy and computational cost on multiscale elliptic, Navier-Stokes, and Helmholtz equations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on benchmark PDE datasets including multiscale elliptic, its inverse problem, Navier-Stokes, and Helmholtz equations.

title: Separable Operator Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效的算子网络方法，可直接迁移用于生物力学有限元代理模型，但缺少不确定性量化和约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics-specific applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升物理信息算子网络训练效率，解决数据匮乏问题
summary_zh.method: 提出可分算子网络(SepONet)，分离坐标轴学习基函数并采用前向模式自动微分
summary_zh.result: 比PI-DeepONet训练速度提升112倍，GPU内存减少82倍
summary_zh.validation: 在1D时间依赖和2D非线性扩散PDE基准上验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the inefficiency of physics-informed DeepONet training due to high computational cost and memory usage.
summary_en.method: SepONet employs independent trunk networks for each coordinate axis and forward-mode automatic differentiation for faster and more memory-efficient training.
summary_en.result: Achieves up to 112x faster training and 82x reduction in GPU memory compared to PI-DeepONet while maintaining comparable accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Tested on 1D time-dependent and 2D nonlinear diffusion PDE problems, demonstrating superior performance with increasing complexity.

title: Improved Uncertainty Estimation of Graph Neural Network Potentials Using Engineered Latent Space Distances
relevance_to_user: 论文提出了基于潜空间距离的不确定性量化方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的预测不确定性问题，但未涉及有限元或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on molecular property prediction with GNNs, and does not address structural mechanics, finite element surrogate modeling, or implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高图神经网络预测分子弛豫能量的不确定性量化精度，这对材料发现至关重要。
summary_zh.method: 基于潜空间距离的分布式不确定性预测方法，结合无分布重新校准。
summary_zh.result: 潜空间距离方法在校准精度和计算效率上均优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在Open Catalyst数据集上构建弛豫能量任务，对比多种不确定性方法。

summary_en.motivation: To improve uncertainty quantification for graph neural network predictions of relaxed molecular energy, which is critical for materials discovery.
summary_en.method: A distribution-free recalibration approach using engineered latent space distances to estimate predictive uncertainty for equivariant GNNs.
summary_en.result: The proposed latent distance method achieves the best calibration and computational efficiency among compared methods on the relaxed energy task.
summary_en.validation: Benchmark on the Open Catalyst Project dataset with a novel relaxed energy task, including calibration curve analysis and out-of-distribution examples.

title: Heterogenous Multi-Source Data Fusion Through Input Mapping and Latent Variable Gaussian Process
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出异构多源数据融合方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但未直接处理约束或验证于植入物设计。
why_not_core: The paper does not address constraint handling in optimization, nor does it validate on biomedical implant FEA or biomechanical design problems; it focuses on heterogeneous input fusion on simple structural and material cases.

summary_zh.motivation: 为融合不同输入空间的异构多源数据，提高代理模型精度。
summary_zh.method: 提出输入映射校准与隐变量高斯过程两阶段融合框架。
summary_zh.result: 在三个工程案例中较单源模型精度提升。
summary_zh.validation: 通过悬臂梁、椭球孔及Ti6Al4V建模案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: This work aims to build unified surrogate models from heterogeneous data sources that differ in input parameter spaces, improving predictive accuracy and knowledge transfer.
summary_en.method: A two-stage framework is proposed: first, input mapping calibration transforms heterogeneous input spaces into a common reference space; second, a latent variable Gaussian process fuses multi-source data on the transformed space.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves higher predictive accuracy than single-source and source-unaware models on three engineering case studies.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on computational case studies of a cantilever beam, an ellipsoidal void, and Ti6Al4V alloy property modeling.

title: On the role of nanocrystallization and cavitation to early damage of VHCF in selective laser melting Ti-6Al-4 V alloy
first_author_affiliation: School of Materials Science and Engineering, Beihang University, Beijing 100191, China

corresponding_authors.name: Zihua Zhao
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Materials Science and Engineering, Beihang University, Beijing 100191, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了选区激光熔化Ti-6Al-4V合金的超高周疲劳损伤机制，对理解增材制造植入物的疲劳性能有参考价值，但未涉及多孔结构或应力屏蔽。
why_not_core: No porous structure design, no stress shielding analysis, no surface morphology or osseointegration assessment, despite covering LPBF fabrication and fatigue testing.

summary_zh.motivation: 揭示选区激光熔化Ti-6Al-4V合金超高周疲劳的早期损伤机制
summary_zh.method: 利用微观表征分析纳米晶化和孔洞对疲劳裂纹萌生的影响
summary_zh.result: 明确了纳米晶化和空化在裂纹萌生中的关键作用
summary_zh.validation: 通过超高周疲劳试验和显微组织观察验证

summary_en.motivation: To elucidate the early damage mechanisms leading to crack initiation in very high cycle fatigue of selective laser melted Ti-6Al-4V alloy.
summary_en.method: Microstructural characterization, including transmission electron microscopy and electron backscatter diffraction, was employed to analyze nanocrystallization and cavitation near the fracture surface.
summary_en.result: Nanocrystallization and cavitation were identified as key precursors to crack initiation, with sub-surface voids acting as preferential sites.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical fatigue testing up to 10^9 cycles combined with post-fracture microstructural analysis.

title: Neural Operator-Based Proxy for Reservoir Simulations Considering Varying Well Settings, Locations, and Permeability Fields
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了基于FNO的替代模型用于油藏模拟，其方法可迁移至生物力学代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: Does not apply surrogate modeling to solid mechanics or implant design; focuses on porous Darcy flow without considering constraints or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速油藏模拟中替代传统数值模拟器
summary_zh.method: 使用FNO与二进制输入张量预测压力和饱和度
summary_zh.result: 95%预测误差小于5%，数据集减少75%
summary_zh.validation: 与传统模拟器对比数值误差

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate reservoir simulations by replacing traditional numerical simulators with a fast machine learning model.
summary_en.method: A Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) surrogate with binary input tensors and data augmentation predicts pressure and saturation fields under varying permeability, well locations, and controls.
summary_en.result: 95% of predictions achieve less than 5% relative error while reducing dataset size by 75%.
summary_en.validation: Comparison against numerical reservoir simulator as ground truth.

title: Active Learning for Derivative-Based Global Sensitivity Analysis with Gaussian Processes
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于高斯过程的主动学习方法用于全局灵敏度分析，其样本效率优化思想可直接迁移到生物力学有限元代理建模中，但未涉及约束处理或植入物设计的具体应用。
why_not_core: Does not address constraints in optimization nor apply to implant/biomechanics design; focuses only on sensitivity analysis without demonstrating transfer to the target domain.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效估计昂贵黑箱函数的全局灵敏度
summary_zh.method: 基于高斯过程代理模型的主动学习，直接针对导数全局灵敏度量设计采集函数
summary_zh.result: 显著提高了DGSM估计的样本效率，尤其在有限评估预算下
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和实际工程问题（车辆安全）上评估

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently estimate global sensitivity of expensive black-box functions using active learning.
summary_en.method: Novel acquisition functions targeting derivative-based global sensitivity measures under Gaussian process surrogates.
summary_en.result: Substantially improved sample efficiency for DGSM estimation, particularly with limited budgets.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on synthetic and real-world engineering problems (vehicle safety).

key_terms.zh: 基于导数的全局灵敏度度量

title: Subgroup-Specific Risk-Controlled Dose Estimation in Radiotherapy
relevance_to_user: 该论文在深度学习和不确定性量化方面的框架可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的风险评估。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on radiotherapy dose estimation without mechanical constraints or optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 放疗剂量计算需要快速且具不确定量化；现有深度学习方法未能保证多亚组风险控制。
summary_zh.method: 提出亚组风险控制预测区间算法（SG-RCPS），对多亚组联合控制风险。
summary_zh.result: 在五个解剖区域上，该方法在关键射线束体素上显著优于传统RCPS。
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床规划体积数据验证，包括多个解剖区域。

summary_en.motivation: Radiotherapy dose estimation requires fast and uncertainty-quantified predictions; existing deep learning methods lack guarantees for multiple subgroups.
summary_en.method: A subgroup risk-controlling prediction set (SG-RCPS) algorithm is proposed to provide prediction intervals with joint risk control for multiple subgroups.
summary_en.result: On five anatomical regions, the method outperforms conventional RCPS, especially for critical voxels along the radiation beam.
summary_en.validation: Validation uses real clinical planning volumes from five anatomical regions.

key_terms.zh: 磁共振引导直线加速器

title: PINN-Ray: A Physics-Informed Neural Network to Model Soft Robotic Fin Ray Fingers
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的PINN方法可用于结构力学建模，但软体机器人应用与生物力学植入物设计差距较大。
why_not_core: Does not address implant biomechanics, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; the geometry and material are specific to soft robotics, not biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效建模软体机器人鳍射线手指的复杂变形。
summary_zh.method: 结合弹性力学最小势能原理和实验数据训练物理信息神经网络。
summary_zh.result: 与有限元相比，模型精度提升且对数据稀缺具有鲁棒性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过视觉跟踪实验验证变形预测。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently model the complex deformation of soft robotic Fin Ray fingers, which is challenging due to nonlinearities and the reality gap.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network (PINN) is proposed that embeds the minimum potential energy principle and experimental data into the loss function.
summary_en.result: The proposed PINN-Ray achieves improved accuracy over finite element modeling and shows robustness to data scarcity.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation is performed via visual tracking of the finger deformation under actuation.

title: MgFNO: Multi-grid Architecture Fourier Neural Operator for Parametric Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该方法作为神经网络算子可直接用于替代生物力学中的昂贵有限元模拟，但当前仅在标准PDE基准上验证，未涉及植入物设计与约束优化。
why_not_core: No application to implant biomechanics, no constraint handling, and no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升傅里叶神经算子求解高频PDE的效率与精度
summary_zh.method: 提出三层次多网格架构与解耦训练策略，融合频率原则
summary_zh.result: 在Burgers、Darcy、Navier-Stokes方程上相对误差降低71%-89%
summary_zh.validation: 标准PDE数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate training and improve accuracy of Fourier neural operators for PDEs dominated by high-frequency dynamics.
summary_en.method: A three-level hierarchical architecture is proposed with a decoupled training strategy that combines coarse, intermediate, and fine networks.
summary_en.result: Relative errors of 0.17%, 0.28%, and 0.22% are achieved on Burgers, Darcy, and Navier-Stokes equations, significantly outperforming standard FNO.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on three canonical PDEs with comparison to baseline FNO.

title: Gaussian process interpolation with conformal prediction: methods and comparative analysis
relevance_to_user: 该方法可转移至FEA代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及约束处理或采样效率。
why_not_core: The paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or transfer to implant/biomechanics design, and lacks validation on engineering applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 改善高斯过程回归预测区间校准性
summary_zh.method: 结合保形预测调整预测区间
summary_zh.result: 提高校准性而不牺牲精度
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准实验对比不同变体

summary_en.motivation: To improve the calibration of prediction intervals in Gaussian process interpolation.
summary_en.method: Conformal prediction methods are applied to adjust GP prediction intervals, including a novel asymmetric score variant.
summary_en.result: Conformal prediction effectively enhances calibration without compromising predictive accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic and benchmark datasets compare multiple CP variants.

title: SGM-PINN: Sampling Graphical Models for Faster Training of Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过图模型改进PINN训练效率，可迁移用于生物力学代理模型的加速，但未涉及植入物设计或约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraints, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics applications; it focuses solely on training acceleration for PINNs on generic PDEs.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速参数化问题中PINN的训练过程。
summary_zh.method: 基于概率图模型的节点聚类进行重要性采样。
summary_zh.result: 收敛速度比最先进方法提升3倍。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准PDE基准上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate training of Physics-Informed Neural Networks for parameterized problems by improving sampling efficiency.
summary_en.method: A graph-based importance sampling framework that clusters training samples using a probabilistic graphical model and biases sampling toward important clusters.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves 3× faster convergence compared to prior state-of-the-art sampling methods on benchmark PDEs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard PDE benchmarks (e.g., Burgers', Helmholtz) demonstrate the performance gains.

title: Machine learning of discrete field theories with guaranteed convergence and uncertainty quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了具有收敛保证和不确定量化的高斯过程回归方法用于离散场理论，可迁移至有限元替代建模与生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address solid mechanics or implant biomechanics, lacks constraint handling, and is validated only on abstract PDE benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 从场论观测数据中学习离散变分原理，保证收敛性并量化模型不确定性。
summary_zh.method: 采用高斯过程回归识别离散拉格朗日密度，保持变分结构。
summary_zh.result: 在离散波动方程和薛定谔方程上验证了收敛性和不确定性量化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证方法性能。

summary_en.motivation: To learn discrete variational principles from observed field theory solutions with guaranteed convergence and model uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: The method uses Gaussian process regression to identify a discrete Lagrangian density while preserving the variational structure of the true field theory.
summary_en.result: Convergence and uncertainty quantification are demonstrated on the discrete wave equation and Schrödinger equation.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated on numerical benchmarks for standard PDEs.

title: Feasibility Study on Active Learning of Smart Surrogates for Scientific Simulations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的主动学习策略可减少代理模型训练所需的仿真数据，对提高植入物设计中的仿真效率有潜在借鉴价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not handle constraints in optimization, does not include uncertainty quantification of surrogate predictions, and is not applied to biomedical or implant design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索主动学习以减少生成仿真数据的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 在扩散方程代理模型中应用多样性和不确定性采样策略
summary_zh.result: 主动学习有效降低了对预定义仿真数据的依赖并提升了代理模型效率
summary_zh.validation: 在扩散方程数值基准测试上验证策略有效性

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of generating simulation data for training deep neural network surrogates by employing active learning.
summary_en.method: Active learning strategies based on diversity and uncertainty sampling are applied to select training simulations for DNN surrogates solving diffusion equations.
summary_en.result: Active learning effectively reduces the number of required high-fidelity simulations while maintaining surrogate accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on diffusion equations with sources validate the approach.

title: 3D Printing and Surface Engineering of Ti6Al4V Scaffolds for Enhanced Osseointegration in an In Vitro Study.

summary_en.method: Additively manufactured porous Ti6Al4V scaffolds were coated with NaOH and dopamine hydrochloride.
summary_en.result: Coated scaffolds promoted higher osteoblast proliferation and viability over 29 days.

title: Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Neural Network for Uncertainty Quantification in Transonic Aerodynamic Loads
relevance_to_user: 该论文的多保真贝叶斯神经网络方法可用于生物力学代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及植入物设计或约束处理。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no constraint handling for optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 结合低保真模型效率和高保真模型精度，实现多保真数据融合与不确定性量化。
summary_zh.method: 采用贝叶斯神经网络通过迁移学习融合不同保真度模型数据。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently combine low- and high-fidelity simulations for accurate predictions with uncertainty quantification in engineering design.
summary_en.method: A multi-fidelity Bayesian neural network that uses transfer learning to fuse data from multiple fidelity levels.
summary_en.result: The proposed model outperforms state-of-the-art Co-Kriging in both accuracy and robustness on unseen aerodynamic data.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a transonic aerodynamic load benchmark against Co-Kriging.

title: Solving forward and inverse PDE problems on unknown manifolds via physics-informed neural operators
relevance_to_user: 本文方法可迁移至生物力学中的代理模型构建，但缺乏约束处理与植入物特定验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not validate on finite element method simulations or implant biomechanics, nor does it address constraint handling in optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 在未知流形上高效求解PDE正反问题。
summary_zh.method: 结合扩散映射等微分近似与物理信息DeepONet框架。
summary_zh.result: 多种扩散系数下均准确，小样本时优于标准DeepONet。

summary_en.motivation: To identify nonlinear convection effects in heat transfer dynamics.

summary_en.motivation: To enable real-time adaptive control of PDEs by replacing expensive kernel computation with neural operator approximations.
