summary_zh.motivation: 评估3D打印生物可吸收颅面植入物的体内降解与骨整合
summary_zh.method: 设计并3D打印nHAp@PLDLLA植入物，用于三个临床病例，并分析取出后的植入物
summary_zh.result: 空间映射显示降解和骨整合不均匀，需个体化设计
summary_zh.validation: 临床试验结合术后植入物分析

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate in vivo degradation and osseointegration of 3D-printed bioresorbable craniofacial implants.
summary_en.method: Design and 3D printing of nHAp@PLDLLA implants, clinical application in three cases, and post-surgical analysis of explanted implants.
summary_en.result: Spatial mapping reveals heterogeneous degradation and osseointegration, highlighting the need for patient-specific design.
summary_en.validation: Clinical trial with post-surgical implant analysis.

key_terms.zh: 纳米羟基磷灰石聚乳酸共聚物

title: Understanding the fatigue behaviour of Ti–6Al–4V manufactured via various additive processes
venue: Journal of Materials Research and Technology
first_author_affiliation: Institute of Structural Materials, Bay Campus, Swansea University, Swansea, SA1 8EN

corresponding_authors.name: R.J. Lancaster
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute of Structural Materials, Bay Campus, Swansea University, Swansea, SA1 8EN

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了不同增材制造工艺下Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳性能，虽未直接针对生物医学植入物，但其疲劳表征方法可用于医用植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not link porous structures to stress shielding, does not cover osseointegration, and does not present biomedical context or implant-specific testing.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究增材制造Ti-6Al-4V中表面粗糙度对疲劳性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过电子束熔炼、激光粉末床熔融和激光金属沉积制备试样，进行疲劳测试与表面形貌分析
summary_zh.result: 表面粗糙度是影响疲劳性能的主要因素，但需结合微观组织与缺陷综合考虑
summary_zh.validation: 疲劳实验结合表面轮廓仪、微观组织及断口分析，并与机加工抛光试样对比

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the role of as-built surface roughness on the fatigue properties of Ti-6Al-4V produced by different additive manufacturing processes.
summary_en.method: Fatigue tests were conducted on specimens fabricated by electron beam melting, laser powder bed fusion, and laser metal deposition with wire, accompanied by surface profilometry, microstructural analysis, and fractography.
summary_en.result: Surface roughness was identified as the primary factor affecting fatigue performance, but its effect cannot be considered in isolation from microstructural features and internal defects.
summary_en.validation: Results were validated through experimental fatigue data, advanced surface characterization, and comparison with machined and polished specimens.

title: Learning the boundary-to-domain mapping using Lifting Product Fourier Neural Operators for partial differential equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种边界到域映射的神经算子方法，可迁移至生物力学FEA代理建模，但未直接应用于植入物设计。
why_not_core: No application to implant design, no biomechanics context, no uncertainty quantification, and no handling of constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子无法高效处理边界到域的函数映射问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种提升乘积傅里叶神经算子（LP-FNO），将低维边界函数提升至高维域。
summary_zh.result: 在2D泊松方程上展示了分辨率无关的有效映射。
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准数值算例（2D泊松方程）验证了方法的精度和分辨率独立性。

summary_en.motivation: Neural operators like FNO have not been applied to learn mappings from boundary data to full-domain solutions of PDEs.
summary_en.method: This paper proposes a Lifting Product FNO (LP-FNO) that lifts two FNOs defined on a lower-dimensional boundary into the higher-dimensional domain via a novel lifting product layer.
summary_en.result: The LP-FNO achieves accurate and resolution-independent boundary-to-domain mapping for the 2D Poisson equation.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on a numerical benchmark (2D Poisson equation) demonstrating its efficacy and resolution independence.

title: Investigation of Compressive Properties of Graded Lattice Structure with Different Porosity Gradient Spans Prepared by Selective Laser Melting
venue: Journal of Materials Engineering and Performance
first_author_affiliation: School of Artificial Intelligence, Beijing Technology and Business University, Beijing, 100048, China

corresponding_authors.name: Xiaoqing Zhang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Artificial Intelligence, Beijing Technology and Business University, Beijing, 100048, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM制备的梯度点阵结构的压缩性能，与生物医学植入体的刚度匹配相关，但未涉及疲劳、表面粗糙度或骨整合。
why_not_core: This paper does not evaluate fatigue behavior, surface roughness, or osseointegration, and does not explicitly link lattice design to stress shielding reduction in biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究梯度多孔结构不同孔隙率跨度对压缩性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过选择性激光熔化制备不同梯度跨度的点阵结构并进行压缩测试
summary_zh.result: 孔隙率跨度影响力学性能，梯度结构可调节刚度
summary_zh.validation: 实验压缩测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of porosity gradient span on the compressive properties of graded lattice structures fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Graded lattice structures with different porosity gradient spans were designed and fabricated using SLM, followed by compressive mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: The porosity gradient span significantly influences the mechanical properties, and graded structures can achieve tailored stiffness.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compressive tests on SLM-fabricated samples.

title: Anvil: An integration of artificial intelligence, sampling techniques, and a combined CAD-CFD tool
relevance_to_user: 该论文提供的CAD-CFD与贝叶斯优化集成工具可迁移至生物力学中的形状优化问题，但未涉及结构有限元或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on CFD-based shape optimization for subsonic flow, lacking structural FEA, implant mechanics, or biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 集成AI采样与CAD-CFD实现形状优化
summary_zh.method: 结合FreeCAD、OpenFOAM和贝叶斯优化构建自动化优化工具
summary_zh.result: 在多种仿真与优化案例中验证了工具有效性
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值仿真案例进行验证

summary_en.motivation: To create an open-source tool integrating CAD-CFD with AI-based optimization and sampling for efficient shape optimization.
summary_en.method: Anvil combines FreeCAD for parametric modeling, OpenFOAM for CFD analysis, and Bayesian optimization with other sampling algorithms for automated design exploration.
summary_en.result: The tool successfully demonstrates its capability in data generation, CFD evaluation, and optimization across multiple subsonic flow test cases.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation examples including airfoil and pipe bend shape optimization.

title: Accelerating Phase Field Simulations Through a Hybrid Adaptive Fourier Neural Operator with U-Net Backbone
relevance_to_user: 该方法使用神经算子加速相场模拟，可转移到生物力学中有限元代理模型的构建。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling, and the application is to corrosion modeling rather than implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 相场模拟时间步长极小，计算耗时，需加速。
summary_zh.method: 提出U形自适应傅里叶神经算子(U-AFNO)，融合U-Net与傅里叶空间Vision Transformer进行时间步跳跃。
summary_zh.result: 模型准确预测场动力学和微观结构统计，与高保真求解器精度相当。
summary_zh.validation: 与高保真数值求解器对比，验证场预测和关键量精度。

summary_en.motivation: Simulating liquid-metal dealloying with phase field models is computationally expensive due to extremely small time steps, motivating surrogate models that can leap forward in time.
summary_en.method: A U-Shaped Adaptive Fourier Neural Operator (U-AFNO) combines U-Net for local feature extraction with a Fourier-space Vision Transformer for global processing, learning the mapping from current to later time steps.
summary_en.result: The U-AFNO surrogate accurately predicts field dynamics and key microstructure statistics, matching the accuracy of high-fidelity solvers.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated by comparing its predictions against a high-fidelity numerical solver for field evolution and quantities of interest.

title: Effect of surface condition on the fatigue characteristics of Ti – 6Al – 4V, titanium alloy produced by selective laser melting
first_author_affiliation: Lobachevsky State University of Nizhny Novgorod

corresponding_authors.name: M. Yu. Gryaznov
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Lobachevsky State University of Nizhny Novgorod

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM制造Ti-6Al-4V合金的疲劳性能与表面后处理的关系，尽管未涉及多孔结构或应力遮挡，但对植入物表面质量和疲劳寿命优化具有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper only evaluates solid specimens without porous structure or stress shielding analysis, and does not link surface condition to osseointegration or implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制备Ti-6Al-4V合金表面后处理对疲劳性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 比较了原始态、车削、水射流和振动研磨处理后的低周疲劳寿命和表面粗糙度
summary_zh.result: 水射流处理使表面纳米硬度增至6.1 GPa，疲劳性能显著提升
summary_zh.validation: 通过低周疲劳测试和表面粗糙度测量验证

summary_en.motivation: The study aims to evaluate the influence of various surface post-treatments on the fatigue behavior of Ti-6Al-4V samples fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Samples in as-built condition and after turning, waterjet, and vibro-grinding treatments were subjected to low-cycle fatigue tests, with surface roughness and nano-hardness characterized.
summary_en.result: Waterjet treatment resulted in the highest fatigue life due to increased subsurface nano-hardness (6.1 GPa) and reduced roughness (Ra 1 μm), outperforming other treatments.
summary_en.validation: Experimental fatigue testing combined with surface roughness and hardness measurements provided quantitative validation.

title: Constructing Boundary-identical Microstructures via Guided Diffusion for Fast Multiscale Topology Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过生成边界一致的微结构加速多尺度拓扑优化，虽未直接应用于生物力学，但其生成式代理建模思路可迁移至植入物设计中的代理模型构建。
why_not_core: This paper does not include uncertainty quantification, patient-specific modeling, or biomechanical implant design; it focuses on general multiscale topology optimization with microstructure generation.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速多尺度拓扑优化中的微观结构生成与属性预测
summary_zh.method: 使用引导扩散模型生成边界一致、弹性模量可调的微观结构，并结合主动学习构建数据集
summary_zh.result: 在机械隐身衣设计中实现一分钟内完成大规模多尺度逆向优化，效率大幅提升
summary_zh.validation: 通过机械隐身衣数值算例验证方法的有效性与普适性

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate multiscale topology optimization by efficiently generating microstructures with consistent boundaries and a wide range of elastic properties.
summary_en.method: A guided diffusion model is trained with active learning to generate microstructures satisfying specified boundary conditions and homogenized elastic tensors.
summary_en.result: The method enables full multiscale optimization of a mechanical cloak in under one minute, demonstrating dramatic efficiency gains.
summary_en.validation: Numerical simulation cases of multiscale design, including a mechanical cloak, demonstrate the approach.

title: Pessimistic asynchronous sampling in high-cost Bayesian optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过悲观异步采样提高贝叶斯优化效率，可转移至昂贵的植入物设计仿真优化。
why_not_core: No constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical/implant application is addressed.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少高成本实验空间中的优化所需实验次数。
summary_zh.method: 在异步贝叶斯优化框架中引入悲观预测策略，扩展了现有采样方法。
summary_zh.result: 悲观异步策略在模拟中更快收敛，且在高维空间不易陷入局部最优。
summary_zh.validation: 通过模拟环境中的基准测试与串行采样对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate optimization in high-cost experimental spaces by reducing the number of required evaluations.
summary_en.method: Extends asynchronous Bayesian optimization with four additional policies that incorporate pessimistic predictions into the training data.
summary_en.result: Under certain conditions, the pessimistic asynchronous policy achieves optimal conditions in significantly fewer experiments and is less prone to local optima at higher dimensions.
summary_en.validation: The policies are validated in a simulated environment benchmarked against serial sampling.

title: Emulation with uncertainty quantification of regional sea-level change caused by the Antarctic Ice Sheet
relevance_to_user: 该论文的方法（神经网络代理模型+不确定性量化）可迁移至生物力学有限元替代模型研究，但并非直接应用于植入物设计或生物制造。
why_not_core: This paper does not involve finite element analysis, implant mechanics, or any biomedical context; it is applied to climate science.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决海平面变化模拟计算昂贵的问题
summary_zh.method: 用神经网络构建代理模型并量化不确定性
summary_zh.result: 代理模型精度高，速度快约100倍，且预测区间校准良好
summary_zh.validation: 与基线机器学习模型及数值求解器对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of simulating sea-level change due to Antarctic ice sheet mass change.
summary_en.method: Neural-network emulators implemented with a linear regression post-processing technique to produce well-calibrated prediction intervals.
summary_en.result: The emulators achieve competitive accuracy with baseline ML models and approximately 100x speedup over the numerical solver.
summary_en.validation: Accuracy evaluated against baseline ML emulators and the numerical solver's outputs.

title: Preferential Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了多目标偏好贝叶斯优化框架，可用于外骨骼个性化优化等任务，间接适用于植入物设计的多目标优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, is not validated on FEA or biomedical simulation benchmarks, and does not focus on implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有偏好贝叶斯优化仅考虑单目标，无法处理多目标权衡。
summary_zh.method: 提出多目标偏好贝叶斯优化框架及DSTS算法。
summary_zh.result: 在合成函数和模拟任务中优于基准方法，且证明一致性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成函数和两个模拟任务（外骨骼、驾驶策略）验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing preferential Bayesian optimization assumes preferences can be encoded by a single objective, failing to capture multi-objective trade-offs.
summary_en.method: We propose the first framework for multi-objective preferential Bayesian optimization and introduce dueling scalarized Thompson sampling (DSTS).
summary_en.result: DSTS outperforms benchmarks on synthetic functions and two simulated tasks, with asymptotic consistency guaranteed.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on four synthetic test functions and two simulation case studies (exoskeleton personalization and driving policy design).

title: An Advanced Physics-Informed Neural Operator for Comprehensive Design Optimization of Highly-Nonlinear Systems: An Aerospace Composites Processing Case Study
relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型，但未涉及植入物或生物医学应用。
why_not_core: Does not address implant-specific biomechanics, lacks experimental validation in biomedical context, and does not include uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高度非线性复合材料加工过程的高效仿真优化。
summary_zh.method: 提出增强的物理信息DeepONet，结合非线性解码器、课程学习和区域分解。
summary_zh.result: 精度比普通物理信息DeepONet提升两个数量级，并实现零样本预测。
summary_zh.validation: 通过复合材料加工仿真案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate design optimization of highly nonlinear aerospace composites processing by developing a surrogate model that can handle multiple input functions.
summary_en.method: Proposed an advanced physics-informed DeepONet with architectural enhancements (nonlinear decoders) and training strategies (curriculum learning, domain decomposition) to map multiple input functions to solution fields.
summary_en.result: The model achieved two orders of magnitude improvement in accuracy over the vanilla physics-informed DeepONet and demonstrated zero-shot prediction across a broad design space.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a numerical simulation case study of aerospace composites processing.

title: SCORE: A 1D Reparameterization Technique to Break Bayesian Optimization's Curse of Dimensionality
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过一维重参数化降低贝叶斯优化在高维空间的计算复杂度，可迁移至昂贵FEA仿真的代理优化问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not validate on FEA problems, does not handle constraints explicitly, and lacks application to biomechanics/implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低高维贝叶斯优化的计算复杂度
summary_zh.method: 提出一维重参数化技巧实现线性时间复杂度
summary_zh.result: 成功找到针尖型函数的全局最小值
summary_zh.validation: 在合成函数和实际数据上验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational curse of dimensionality in Bayesian optimization for high-dimensional search spaces.
summary_en.method: A 1D reparameterization technique is proposed to reduce the surrogate model complexity, achieving linear time scaling.
summary_en.result: SCORE successfully identifies global minima of needle-in-a-haystack functions and fits real-world data without high-performance computing.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic benchmark functions and real-world datasets, demonstrating efficiency and scalability.

title: Contraction rates for conjugate gradient and Lanczos approximate posteriors in Gaussian process regression
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了高效的GP近似后验推断方法，可解决大规模采样效率问题，但未直接应用于FEA或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: No explicit integration with FEA, constraint handling, or biomechanics/implant design applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 高斯过程回归在大规模数据下求解昂贵，需高效近似方法。
summary_zh.method: 利用共轭梯度法和Lanczos近似特征向量实现后验近似。
summary_zh.result: 获得了接近最优的极小化收敛速度，理论结合实验验证。
summary_zh.validation: 数值实验验证理论结果。

summary_en.motivation: Gaussian process regression is computationally prohibitive for large datasets, necessitating efficient approximations.
summary_en.method: Conjugate gradient and Lanczos approximations are used to approximate the posterior mean and eigenstructure of the kernel matrix.
summary_en.result: Minimax contraction rates are derived, showing that these approximations achieve near-optimal accuracy with linear complexity.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical results are complemented by numerical experiments on synthetic data.

title: An extrapolation-driven network architecture for physics-informed deep learning
relevance_to_user: 提出了一种改进PINN时间依赖问题求解的网络架构，可迁移至生物力学仿真代理模型。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, constraint handling, or biomedicine/implants application; validation on standard PDEs only.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服PINN在时间依赖PDEs中顺序学习的局限性。
summary_zh.method: 设计外推驱动网络架构，通过修正项扩展子区间解。
summary_zh.result: 单网络获得全局解，继承先前解并保证连续性光滑性。
summary_zh.validation: 数值实验验证方法在时间区域上的性能。

summary_en.motivation: To address weaknesses of sequential learning in PINNs, such as failure to retain previous solutions and difficulty ensuring continuity at time interval boundaries.
summary_en.method: Proposes an extrapolation-driven network architecture that corrects network parameters from a subinterval to enable single-network solution across full domain.
summary_en.result: The approach preserves local solutions, maintains continuity and smoothness at interval nodes, and respects causality for large-time evolution equations.
summary_en.validation: Performance is validated through numerical experiments on time-dependent PDE benchmarks.

title: A hybrid reduced-order model for segregated fluid-structure interaction solvers in an ALE approach at high Reynolds number
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过混合降阶模型加速高雷诺数流固耦合计算，对生物力学中植入物-血流相互作用的高效仿真具有转移潜力。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on fluid-structure interaction of an airfoil at high Reynolds number, lacking implant-specific mechanics, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发混合降阶模型以加速高雷诺数流固耦合数值模拟
summary_zh.method: 结合POD、Galerkin投影与RBF/LSTM数据驱动方法的混合ROM构建
summary_zh.result: 该ROM能准确捕捉俯仰-沉浮翼型的流致振动响应
summary_zh.validation: 通过高雷诺数（10^7）翼型流固耦合案例验证

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate high-fidelity fluid-structure interaction simulations by developing a hybrid reduced-order model.
summary_en.method: A hybrid ROM combining proper orthogonal decomposition, Galerkin projection, and data-driven techniques (RBF and LSTM) is constructed for segregated FSI solvers in an ALE framework.
summary_en.result: The ROM accurately captures the flow-induced vibration of a pitch-plunge airfoil at Reynolds number 10^7.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via a numerical case study of flow-induced vibration of a pitch-plunge airfoil at high Reynolds number.

title: Viscosity Inference of Hybrid Bioink Using Decision Tree-Based Machine Learning Method
first_author_affiliation: Slippery Rock University , Slippery Rock, Pennsylvania, United States

corresponding_authors.name: Shah Limon
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Slippery Rock University , Slippery Rock, Pennsylvania, United States

relevance_to_user: 本文使用决策树机器学习方法预测混合生物墨水粘度，直接减少了试错实验，对AI辅助生物打印的工艺参数优化有直接参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI into an autonomous bioprinting workflow nor include experimental validation beyond data splitting.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少生物墨水粘度预测所需的试错实验
summary_zh.method: 采用决策树机器学习模型预测混合生物墨水粘度
summary_zh.result: 模型对300种剪切速率和材料组合的粘度预测准确度高
summary_zh.validation: 使用75%数据训练，25%数据测试

summary_en.motivation: To reduce resource-intensive trial-and-error experiments for determining bioink viscosity in extrusion bioprinting.
summary_en.method: A decision tree-based machine learning model predicts viscosity for combinations of shear rate and material composition (alginate, CMC, TO-NFC).
summary_en.result: The model achieves high accuracy on unseen data, demonstrating potential to streamline bioprinting process optimization.
summary_en.validation: Model performance is evaluated by splitting a dataset of 300 viscosity measurements into 75% training and 25% test sets.

key_terms.zh: TEMPO介导的纳米原纤化纤维素

title: Tackling the Curse of Dimensionality in Fractional and Tempered Fractional PDEs with Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文的PINN方法可迁移到生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on fractional PDEs with PINNs, with no connection to FEA surrogate modelling, implant biomechanics, or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维分数阶偏微分方程数值求解面临维度灾难。
summary_zh.method: 将蒙特卡洛分数阶PINN扩展到调和分数阶，并用高斯求积降方差。
summary_zh.result: 新方法在高达十万维问题上收敛更快、精度更高。
summary_zh.validation: 通过正反问题验证，维度最高达100,000。

summary_en.motivation: Fractional and tempered fractional PDEs suffer from the curse of dimensionality when solved by traditional mesh-based methods.
summary_en.method: We extend Monte Carlo fractional PINN to tempered fractional cases and replace 1D Monte Carlo with Gaussian quadrature to reduce variance.
summary_en.result: The improved method consistently outperforms the original in accuracy and convergence speed for problems up to 100,000 dimensions.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on forward and inverse problems of fractional and tempered fractional PDEs in very high dimensions.

title: Physics-Constrained Learning for PDE Systems with Uncertainty Quantified Port-Hamiltonian Models
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于物理约束的高斯过程学习方法具有不确定性量化能力，可迁移至植入物生物力学FEA替代建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanical FEA surrogate problems, does not address contact mechanics or stress shielding, and validates only on soft robotics dynamics.

summary_zh.motivation: 数据驱动模型常忽略物理规律，难以推广至柔性物体动力学建模。
summary_zh.method: 提出结合高斯过程与分布式Port-Hamiltonian模型的物理约束学习方法。
summary_zh.result: 实现系统动力学学习与不确定性量化，保留Port-Hamiltonian系统的组合特性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过柔性物体动力学仿真验证方法的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Data-driven models often neglect physical principles, limiting generalization for complex soft object dynamics.
summary_en.method: We propose a physics-constrained learning method combining Gaussian processes with a distributed Port-Hamiltonian model.
summary_en.result: The approach learns system dynamics with uncertainty quantification and preserves the compositional nature of Port-Hamiltonian systems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on simulated soft robotic dynamics scenarios.

title: Active search for Bifurcations
relevance_to_user: 该方法将贝叶斯优化用于高效探索参数空间，可迁移至植入物设计中的约束优化与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no implant biomechanics context, no contact mechanics or stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 在昂贵采样系统中高效定位分岔点以预防灾难性转变。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于贝叶斯优化的主动学习框架，智能选择向量场观测点。
summary_zh.result: 成功在基准动力学系统中定位鞍结和Hopf分岔，采样效率高。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值例上验证，对比延续法证明优势。

summary_en.motivation: Locating bifurcations in complex, expensive-to-sample dynamical systems is challenging for standard numerical methods.
summary_en.method: Proposes an active learning framework using Bayesian optimization to efficiently select vector field observations for discovering saddle-node or Hopf bifurcations.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates effective identification of bifurcation points with far fewer samples than continuation methods on benchmark systems.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical experiments on standard dynamical systems, including noisy and stochastic cases.

title: Hamilton-Jacobi Based Policy-Iteration via Deep Operator Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的深度算子网络策略迭代方法，可用于加速求解偏微分方程，有潜力迁移至生物力学代理建模中的高效采样问题。
why_not_core: No application to FEA surrogate modeling for biomechanics or implant design, no handling of constraints or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用算子学习高效求解最优控制问题及HJB方程，支持不同终端函数快速推理。
summary_zh.method: 将DeepONet与策略迭代结合，训练后能快速推断不同终端条件下的解。
summary_zh.result: 通过10维线性二次调节器问题验证了方法的准确性和效率。
summary_zh.validation: 基于粘性解比较原理进行数值精度分析，并用多维度算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve optimal control problems and Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equations by leveraging operator learning for rapid inference under varying terminal conditions.
summary_en.method: Incorporates a deep operator network with a policy iteration scheme to learn the solution operator for HJB equations across different terminal functions.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates high accuracy and efficiency on up to 10-dimensional linear quadratic regulator problems with a quantitative error analysis.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical benchmarks of viscosity solutions using comparison principles.

key_terms.zh: 哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼方程

title: Column reduced digital nets
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种用于不确定性量化的准蒙特卡洛积分加速算法，可转移至代理模型中的高效采样。
why_not_core: It does not address surrogate model construction, FEA sampling, constraint handling, or biomechanics applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速不确定性量化中准蒙特卡洛规则的矩阵-向量乘积计算。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于列缩减数字网的新乘法算法，利用重复结构。
summary_zh.result: 新算法便于误差分析，数值测试表明效率提升。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值测试验证算法效率与质量参数上界。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate matrix-vector product computations in quasi-Monte Carlo rules for uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: A new multiplication algorithm exploiting the repetitive structure of column reduced digital nets is proposed.
summary_en.result: The method facilitates error analysis and numerical tests demonstrate its efficiency.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on quasi-Monte Carlo integration nodes validate the algorithm.

title: A Rate-Distortion View of Uncertainty Quantification
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出了一种新的神经网络不确定性量化技术，可迁移至代理模型，但未涉及有限元模拟或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: The paper does not address surrogate modeling for FEA, does not handle constraints, and lacks validation in biomechanical or implant design contexts.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高深度神经网络对输入是否接近训练数据的感知能力，以获得可靠的不确定性估计。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于距离感知瓶颈（DAB）的方法，学习训练输入的压缩码本，并利用新样本与码本的距离作为不确定性度量。
summary_zh.result: 在分布外检测和误分类预测任务上优于现有方法，包括集成方法和深度核高斯过程。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准图像分类数据集上评估分布外检测和误分类预测性能。

summary_en.motivation: To equip deep neural networks with the ability to quantify input proximity to training data for reliable uncertainty estimation.
summary_en.method: Introduces a Distance Aware Bottleneck (DAB) that learns a codebook of compressed training inputs and uses the distance to this codebook as an uncertainty estimate.
summary_en.result: Achieves superior out-of-distribution detection and misclassification prediction compared to ensembles, deep kernel Gaussian Processes, and standard information bottleneck methods.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on standard image classification benchmarks for OOD detection and misclassification prediction tasks.

title: A MgNO Method for Multiphase Flow in Porous Media
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多网格神经算子(MgNO)方法可迁移至生物力学FEA代理建模，但当前仅应用于多孔介质流动。
why_not_core: No biomedical or implant context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and validation is only numerical benchmark on geoscience problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高多孔介质多相流模拟效率，避免传统数值方法的高计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 采用多网格神经算子(MgNO)处理渗透率和孔隙度非均质性，扩展至时变流动问题。
summary_zh.result: MgNO在长期预测稳定性上优于FNO，且大幅节省计算时间。
summary_zh.validation: 与Fourier神经算子(FNO)对比，评估预测误差随时间的累积。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of simulating multiphase flow in heterogeneous porous media by developing an efficient neural operator surrogate.
summary_en.method: Applied the Multigrid Neural Operator (MgNO), inspired by multigrid numerical methods, to time-dependent multiphase flow problems with heterogeneous permeability and porosity.
summary_en.result: MgNO demonstrated superior long-term predictive stability compared to Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) and achieved significant computational speed-ups.
summary_en.validation: Validated against FNO on benchmark porous media flow problems, comparing prediction error accumulation over time.

title: Finite-difference-informed graph network for solving steady-state incompressible flows on block-structured grids
relevance_to_user: 提出了一种基于图网络的物理约束方法求解流体问题，可迁移至固体力学代理模型，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no biomedical or implant context, and only demonstrated on fluid dynamics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低多块网格流体模拟的计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于图卷积的有限差分法，以物理约束方式训练图网络。
summary_zh.result: 速度场预测相对误差10^{-3}，训练成本降低20%。
summary_zh.validation: 与CFD求解器在方腔、圆柱绕流和翼型上对比。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of solving steady incompressible Navier-Stokes equations on multi-block structured grids.
summary_en.method: A graph convolution-based finite difference method (GC-FDM) is proposed to train graph networks in a physics-constrained manner without labeled data.
summary_en.result: The method achieves relative prediction errors on the order of 10^{-3} for velocity fields and reduces training costs by approximately 20% compared to a physics-informed neural network.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed against a CFD solver on benchmark cases including lid-driven cavity flow, flows around single and double cylinders, and a 30P30N airfoil, as well as a 3D cavity.

title: DeltaPhi: Physical States Residual Learning for Neural Operators in Data-Limited PDE Solving
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过残差学习提升数据有限的神经算子性能，可转移到生物力学替代建模，但未涉及约束、不确定量化或植入物设计。
why_not_core: Does not handle constraints, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics-specific problems; validated only on standard PDE benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决神经算子在数据有限下的物理系统求解困难。
summary_zh.method: 提出DeltaPhi框架，学习相似物理状态间的残差而非直接映射。
summary_zh.result: 在多种物理系统和架构上显著提升性能，尤其在数据稀缺场景。
summary_zh.validation: 在规则/不规则域、多种网络架构和跨分辨率场景中验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the challenge of limited training data in data-driven PDE solving by redefining the learning objective.
summary_en.method: Proposes DeltaPhi, a framework that learns residuals between similar physical states instead of direct input-output mappings, enabling implicit data augmentation.
summary_en.result: Achieves consistent improvements across diverse physical systems, neural architectures, and data regimes, demonstrating robustness in data-limited scenarios.
summary_en.validation: Validated on multiple PDE benchmarks including regular and irregular domains, various architectures, and cross-resolution settings.

key_terms.zh: 数据有限的偏微分方程求解

title: Pareto Front-Diverse Batch Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法可用于植入物多目标优化问题，但未涉及生物力学约束或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: The paper does not include FEA validation, constraint handling, or application to implant biomechanics; its experiments are limited to synthetic benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决昂贵黑箱多目标优化中Pareto前沿质量与多样性问题
summary_zh.method: 提出多臂赌博机选择采集函数与行列式点过程选取批次多样解的方法
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准测试中优于现有方法，实现高质量且多样的Pareto前沿
summary_zh.validation: 在多个多目标优化基准函数上进行数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the need for high-quality and diverse Pareto fronts when optimizing expensive black-box multi-objective functions.
summary_en.method: Proposes Pareto front-Diverse Batch Multi-Objective BO (PDBO) using a multi-armed bandit for acquisition function selection and DPPs for batch diversity.
summary_en.result: PDBO outperforms prior methods on multiple MOO benchmarks in terms of both Pareto solution quality and diversity.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard multi-objective optimization benchmarks.

title: Embedding machine-learnt sub-grid variability improves climate model biases
relevance_to_user: 该方法使用高斯过程作为代理模型，其不确定性量化能力可迁移至植入物设计的代理建模中。
why_not_core: This paper addresses climate model bias, not implant or biomechanics design; no contact mechanics, stress shielding, or FEA validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少气候模型中云形成参数化导致的降水偏差。
summary_zh.method: 将训练好的多输出高斯过程嵌入简化气候模型，扰动温度和湿度剖面。
summary_zh.result: 全球降水偏差降低18%，热带地区降低22%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过十年预测和增温实验对比控制与混合模型表现。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce precipitation biases in climate models caused by under-represented cloud formation processes.
summary_en.method: A multi-output Gaussian process trained on high-resolution simulations is coupled in-situ with a simplified climate model to perturb temperature and humidity profiles.
summary_en.result: The hybrid model reduces global precipitation bias by 18% and tropical bias by 22%.
summary_en.validation: Ten-year predictions and a +4K sea-surface temperature experiment validate the physical consistency of improvements.

title: Current trends in additive manufacturing of selective laser melting for biomedical implant applications
venue: Journal of Materials Research and Technology
first_author_affiliation: Faculty of Artificial Intelligent, Universiti Teknologi Malaysia, Jalan Sultan Yahya Petra, 54100, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia

corresponding_authors.name: Mohamad Zaki Hassan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Faculty of Artificial Intelligent, Universiti Teknologi Malaysia, Jalan Sultan Yahya Petra, 54100, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia

relevance_to_user: 该综述直接聚焦于SLM金属植入物的应力遮挡、骨整合和表面形貌，与您的AM生物医用材料方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper is a review without original experimental data, novel implant designs, or quantitative mechanical testing results.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述SLM金属植入物的应力遮挡、骨整合和抗菌性能研究现状。
summary_zh.method: 系统回顾SLM工艺参数、表面形貌改性及力学、化学、生物改性策略。
summary_zh.result: 指出SLM植入物在骨重塑、耐腐蚀和抗菌方面的挑战与未来方向。
summary_zh.validation: 文献综述，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: This review consolidates current knowledge on selective laser melting (SLM) metallic implants, focusing on stress shielding, osseointegration, and antibacterial performance.
summary_en.method: It systematically summarizes SLM parameters, surface morphology modifications, and mechanical, chemical, and biological enhancement strategies.
summary_en.result: Key challenges and future directions are identified for improving bone remodeling, corrosion resistance, and antibacterial properties of SLM implants.
summary_en.validation: The paper is a literature review without original experimental validation.

title: Optimal Gait Design for a Soft Quadruped Robot via Multi-fidelity Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法中的多保真贝叶斯优化技术可迁移至生物力学代理建模，但论文本身未涉及有限元或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过在线学习提高软体四足机器人运动能力
summary_zh.method: 采用多保真贝叶斯优化结合仿真与物理实验优化步态参数
summary_zh.result: 实现了高效的最优行走步态设计，弥合虚实差距
summary_zh.validation: 在实际软体机器人上验证步态性能

summary_en.motivation: To improve locomotion capability of a soft quadruped robot through online adaptive learning of optimal gait parameters.
summary_en.method: Employed multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization combining simulation and physical experiment data to refine gait patterns.
summary_en.result: Achieved efficient optimal walking gait design that bridges the reality gap between simulation and deployment.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a physical tendon-driven soft quadruped robot with real-time edge computing.

title: Boosted Conformal Prediction Intervals
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的提升共形预测区间方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型的预测区间优化，但未直接涉及有限元代理或植入物设计。
why_not_core: Does not address FEA surrogate modeling, expensive simulation sampling, or implant biomechanics; purely a statistical UQ method without any engineering application.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升共形预测区间的条件覆盖率和区间长度。
summary_zh.method: 利用梯度提升优化共形得分函数，后处理模型预测。
summary_zh.result: 相比传统方法，区间长度减小且条件覆盖率更均衡。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准数据集上验证区间性能。

summary_en.motivation: To tailor conformal prediction intervals toward desired properties like conditional coverage and interval length.
summary_en.method: Gradient boosting is used to improve a predefined conformity score function, acting post-training on model predictions.
summary_en.result: The boosted procedure substantially reduces interval length and deviation from target conditional coverage.
summary_en.validation: Systematic experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate improvements over conventional conformal methods.

title: Beyond the Norms: Detecting Prediction Errors in Regression Models
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的回归模型错误检测方法可用于代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及仿真效率提升或约束处理，需转化后应用于植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or any application to implant/biomechanics design; it focuses solely on general regression error detection.

summary_zh.motivation: 检测回归模型中的不可靠行为，区分偶然不确定性和模型不确定性。
summary_zh.method: 估计残差密度并基于统计差异性推导数据驱动的不确定性分数。
summary_zh.result: 在多个回归任务上优于基线方法，提升了错误检测性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准回归数据集上进行数值实验对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To detect unreliable predictions in regression models by distinguishing aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty.
summary_en.method: Estimates the discrepancy density and measures its statistical diversity to derive an uncertainty score for error detection.
summary_en.result: Outperforms popular baselines on multiple regression tasks, improving error detection accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard regression benchmarks with numerical comparisons to existing methods.

title: Active learning for affinity prediction of antibodies
relevance_to_user: 本文提出的主动学习框架可迁移至生物力学领域，用于加速植入物设计的昂贵有限元仿真采样。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant design, does not handle constraints, and lacks uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速抗体亲和力预测以减少昂贵模拟计算
summary_zh.method: 提出主动学习框架，迭代选择有前途的突变序列进行模拟评估
summary_zh.result: 有效加速了高亲和力抗体的搜索过程
summary_zh.validation: 在预计算数据集和全循环设置中验证框架有效性

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate antibody affinity prediction by reducing the number of expensive physics-based simulations.
summary_en.method: An active learning framework is proposed that iteratively proposes promising mutation sequences for simulator evaluation using surrogate models.
summary_en.result: The framework effectively accelerates the search for improved antibody binders.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated on pre-computed data pools and in a realistic full-loop setting.

title: Error Analysis and Numerical Algorithm for PDE Approximation with Hidden-Layer Concatenated Physics Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的隐藏层拼接物理信息神经网络（HLConcPINN）方法可提升长时间模拟的精度，有望迁移至生物力学代理建模中的偏微分方程求解。
why_not_core: The paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design; it only validates on standard PDE benchmarks without biomedical FEA application.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升物理信息神经网络（PINN）在长时间动态模拟中的精度和理论保证
summary_zh.method: 提出隐藏层拼接全连接网络与改进块时间推进策略相结合的HLConcPINN方法
summary_zh.result: 误差分析表明训练损失能有效控制近似误差，数值实验验证了算法的有效性
summary_zh.validation: 通过热方程、Burgers方程、波动方程等标准算例数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and theoretical guarantees of PINNs for long-time dynamic simulations.
summary_en.method: The HLConcPINN method combines hidden-layer concatenated feed-forward neural networks with a modified block time marching strategy.
summary_en.result: Error analysis shows that approximation error is effectively controlled by training loss, and numerical experiments confirm the method's effectiveness.
summary_en.validation: Standard PDE benchmarks including heat, Burgers, wave, and Klein-Gordon equations are used for numerical validation.

title: A local squared Wasserstein-2 method for efficient reconstruction of models with uncertainty
relevance_to_user: 提出了一种UQ方法，可用于FEA代理建模中的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: does not apply the method to FEA or biomechanics problems, only tested on simple benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 无需先验分布信息的UQ方法需求
summary_zh.method: 基于局部平方Wasserstein-2距离，利用经验分布重建模型输出分布
summary_zh.result: 在线性回归、神经网络权重不确定性和ODE重构中有效
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试（线性回归、NN、ODE）

summary_en.motivation: To develop an uncertainty quantification method for inverse problems that does not require prior distribution knowledge.
summary_en.method: A local squared Wasserstein-2 distance is used to reconstruct output distributions from empirical observation data.
summary_en.result: The method is effective on linear regression, neural networks with weight uncertainty, and ODE reconstruction.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on linear regression, neural network, and ODE tasks.

title: Scaling up Probabilistic PDE Simulators with Structured Volumetric Information
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种概率性PDE求解器，结合高斯过程和有限体积法，具有不确定性量化能力，可迁移至生物力学代理建模。
why_not_core: No demonstration on implant/biomechanics design; no constraint handling; application is tsunami simulation, not biomedical.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升概率性PDE求解器的数据效率和可扩展性
summary_zh.method: 将有限体积法与数值线性代数和高斯过程结合
summary_zh.result: 在海啸模拟中缩放行为显著优于基于配置的方法
summary_zh.validation: 时空海啸模拟验证了方法的可扩展性

summary_en.motivation: This paper aims to improve the scalability and data efficiency of probabilistic PDE solvers that use Gaussian process analogues.
summary_en.method: It combines a finite volume discretization scheme with complementary numerical linear algebra techniques within a Gaussian process framework to construct fully probabilistic estimates of uncertainties.
summary_en.result: The proposed approach demonstrates substantially improved scaling behavior over previous collocation-based techniques in a spatiotemporal tsunami simulation.
summary_en.validation: A practical tsunami simulation scenario is used to validate the scaling performance of the method.

key_terms.zh: 概率偏微分方程求解器

title: M2NO: An Efficient Multi-Resolution Operator Framework for Dynamic Multi-Scale PDE Solvers
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出的多尺度神经算子框架可迁移至生物力学有限元替代建模，但未涉及具体骨科植入物或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant design, does not consider constraints or uncertainty quantification, and lacks biomedical or biomechanics validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解多尺度高维偏微分方程
summary_zh.method: 结合多网格与多小波空间的神经算子框架
summary_zh.result: 在多种PDE基准上精度和计算效率均优于现有模型
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准上验证

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve multi-scale high-dimensional PDEs by capturing both low- and high-frequency features.
summary_en.method: M2NO integrates a multigrid structure with predefined multiwavelet spaces to transfer low-frequency errors to coarse grids while preserving high-frequency details.
summary_en.result: The proposed framework outperforms existing models on diverse PDE benchmarks, including super-resolution and preconditioning tasks.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical evaluations on standard PDE benchmarks, demonstrating accuracy and efficiency improvements.

title: Linearization Turns Neural Operators into Function-Valued Gaussian Processes
relevance_to_user: 该论文为神经算子预测提供不确定性量化方法，可迁移至生物力学植入物代理模型的可靠性评估。
why_not_core: No validation on implant or biomechanics FEA, no contact mechanics or stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 量化神经算子替代PDE求解器时的预测误差
summary_zh.method: 通过线性化拉普拉斯逼近将权重不确定性传播至预测
summary_zh.result: 实现与分辨率无关的不确定性量化且计算开销极小
summary_zh.validation: 在傅里叶神经算子上进行数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: Reliable uncertainty quantification is essential for deploying neural operators in high-stakes simulation scenarios.
summary_en.method: LUNO uses model linearization to propagate Gaussian weight-space uncertainty to neural operator predictions, yielding a function-valued Gaussian process.
summary_en.result: The framework is resolution-agnostic, adds minimal overhead, and scales to large models without retraining.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on Fourier neural operators for parametric PDEs, demonstrating accurate uncertainty estimates.

title: FunBO: Discovering Acquisition Functions for Bayesian Optimization with FunSearch
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出一种自动发现贝叶斯优化采集函数的方法，可迁移至代理模型辅助的工程优化问题，但未涉及FEA、约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modelling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification, and is not validated on biomechanical or implant design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统采集函数依赖人工设计，无法适应不同优化问题。
summary_zh.method: 利用大语言模型FunSearch自动发现新的采集函数。
summary_zh.result: 发现的采集函数在多种基准测试中表现优异，泛化能力强。
summary_zh.validation: 在全局优化和超参数调优基准上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional acquisition functions require manual design and may not generalize across different optimization problems.
summary_en.method: Proposes FunBO, an LLM-based method that automatically discovers novel acquisition functions written in computer code.
summary_en.result: Discovered acquisition functions outperform established general-purpose functions and generalize well in and out of training distribution.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on global optimization benchmarks and hyperparameter optimization tasks.

title: Simulating, Fast and Slow: Learning Policies for Black-Box Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过学习主动学习策略训练可微替代模型，可减少黑箱模拟器调用，适用于FEA替代建模中的采样效率提升，但未涉及约束处理、不确定量化及生物力学验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics/implants-specific validation, focusing instead on general unconstrained black-box optimization with synthetic benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少黑箱模拟器优化中昂贵的调用次数。
summary_zh.method: 学习主动学习策略以训练可微替代模型，利用其梯度进行参数优化。
summary_zh.result: 与基线方法相比，昂贵模拟器调用减少约90%。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成基准问题上验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the number of expensive simulator calls when solving classes of similar black-box optimization problems.
summary_en.method: Proposes learning an active learning policy that guides the training of a differentiable surrogate and uses its gradients for gradient descent optimization.
summary_en.result: The approach achieves up to ~90% fewer expensive simulator calls compared to local surrogate-based and Bayesian methods.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic benchmark optimization problems.

title: Physics-Informed Neural Network based inverse framework for time-fractional differential equations for rheology
relevance_to_user: 该论文将PINN应用于分数阶粘弹性反问题，其方法可转移至生物力学代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: Does not address FEA surrogate modelling, constraint handling, or implant-specific design; focuses on inverse PDE problems with fractional derivatives.

summary_zh.motivation: 扩展PINN解决时间分数阶反问题，用于异常扩散和粘弹性。
summary_zh.method: 设计自适应残差损失函数的PINN框架，利用数值和实验数据校准参数。
summary_zh.result: 即使在25%噪声下，相对误差仍低于10%，稳健预测扩散系数和分数阶。
summary_zh.validation: 通过猪组织样本实验数据和数值算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To extend Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) to solve inverse problems involving time-fractional derivatives for anomalous diffusion and viscoelasticity.
summary_en.method: A PINN framework with a tailored residual loss scaled by the standard deviation of observed data, applied to calibrate diffusion coefficients and fractional Maxwell model parameters.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves relative errors below 10% for predictions of generalized diffusion coefficients and fractional derivative orders, even with 25% Gaussian noise.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerically generated datasets and experimental data from pig tissue samples.

title: Latent Neural Operator for Solving Forward and Inverse PDE Problems
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过隐空间降维加速PDE求解，可迁移至生物力学中的昂贵仿真问题。
why_not_core: Does not address constrained optimization or uncertainty quantification, and lacks validation on biomedical or implant-related FEA problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低神经算子求解PDE的高计算成本
summary_zh.method: 通过物理交叉注意力将几何空间映射到隐空间并在其中学习算子
summary_zh.result: GPU内存减少50%，训练加速1.8倍，多个基准达最优
summary_zh.validation: 基于标准PDE基准测试的数值对比

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the high computational cost of neural operators for solving PDEs.
summary_en.method: Propose Physics-Cross-Attention to map geometric space to latent space and learn the operator there.
summary_en.result: Achieves 50% GPU memory reduction, 1.8x training speedup, and state-of-the-art accuracy on multiple benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard PDE problems.

title: Element-wise Multiplication Based Deeper Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该方法改进了PINN的表达能力，可迁移到生物力学代理建模，但未针对采样效率、约束或UQ。
why_not_core: Does not address expensive sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or UQ, and lacks biomechanics/ implant application.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINN在复杂PDE上表达力不足且存在初始化病理。
summary_zh.method: 提出Deeper-PINN，利用逐元素乘法将特征映射到高维非线性空间。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准上缓解了初始化病理并增强了表达力。
summary_zh.validation: 通过典型PDE数值基准验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing PINNs suffer from limited expressive ability and initialization pathology for complex PDEs.
summary_en.method: Deeper-PINN is proposed, adopting element-wise multiplication to transform features into high-dimensional nonlinear spaces.
summary_en.result: The method alleviates initialization pathology and shows strong expressive ability on various benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard PDE numerical benchmarks.

title: Chebyshev Spectral Neural Networks for Solving Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该方法虽未直接应用于生物力学或植入物设计，但其Chebyshev谱神经网络求解PDE的方式有可能转移到代理建模和有限元分析中。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or any biomedical/implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用Chebyshev谱方法提高神经网络求解PDE的精度与效率。
summary_zh.method: 采用满足边界条件的Chebyshev谱神经元构建单层神经网络，用自动微分计算损失。
summary_zh.result: 在椭圆型PDE上，CSNN方法比PINN训练更快、精度更高。
summary_zh.validation: 在椭圆型PDE基准上对比PINN进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and training efficiency of neural network-based PDE solvers by incorporating Chebyshev spectral methods.
summary_en.method: A single-layer neural network with Chebyshev spectral construction of neurons that automatically satisfy boundary conditions, trained by automatic differentiation.
summary_en.result: The Chebyshev Spectral Neural Network (CSNN) achieves superior efficiency and accuracy compared to Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINN) on elliptic PDE benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on elliptic PDEs with comparison to the well-known PINN method.

title: Scanning strategies for the 316L part with lattice structures fabricated by selective laser melting
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology
first_author_affiliation: School of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Jiangxi University of Science and Technology, Ganzhou, 341000, Jiangxi, China

corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Jiangxi University of Science and Technology, Ganzhou, 341000, Jiangxi, China

why_not_core: Does not specifically link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, nor report osseointegration or fatigue behavior.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化316L点阵结构的扫描策略以改善成形质量与力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 对比不同扫描路径与参数组合对致密度、微观组织及压缩性能的影响。
summary_zh.result: 特定扫描策略可显著提高点阵结构的致密度与抗压强度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测试压缩力学性能与显微组织表征验证。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize scanning strategies for 316L lattice structures fabricated by selective laser melting for improved structural integrity and mechanical performance.
summary_en.method: A comparative study of different scanning patterns and process parameters on density, microstructure, and compressive properties of lattice structures.
summary_en.result: Specific scanning strategies significantly enhance density and compressive strength of the lattice structures.

title: Relaxed Quantile Regression: Prediction Intervals for Asymmetric Noise
relevance_to_user: 该方法提供了一种更灵活的分位数回归方式，可用于代理模型的不确定性量化，从而间接支持生物力学设计优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modeling of expensive simulations nor biomechanics/implant design, and lacks any application to FEA or optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有分位数回归区间过于对称，不适应偏态分布。
summary_zh.method: 提出松弛分位数回归（RQR），直接构造区间而不需预设分位数。
summary_zh.result: RQR区间在保持覆盖保证的同时，改善了区间宽度等质量。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个回归基准数据集上验证了覆盖率和区间宽度。

summary_en.motivation: Standard quantile regression produces intervals that are arbitrarily symmetric around the median, which is suboptimal for skewed distributions.
summary_en.method: Relaxed Quantile Regression (RQR) is proposed as a direct alternative that constructs prediction intervals without prespecifying quantiles, allowing asymmetric intervals.
summary_en.result: RQR yields intervals with improved mean width while retaining coverage guarantees compared to standard quantile regression.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation on various regression benchmark datasets demonstrates the effectiveness of RQR in terms of coverage and interval width.

title: Particle Filter Optimization: A Bayesian Approach for Global Stochastic Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法是一种基于贝叶斯推断的全局随机优化算法，可潜在用于植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。

summary_zh.motivation: 提出一种基于粒子滤波的全局优化算法，解决带噪声的黑箱函数优化问题。
summary_zh.method: 将优化问题重构为状态估计，使用协方差椭球传播粒子和无迹变换处理噪声。
summary_zh.result: 在标准随机优化基准测试中表现优于现有算法，提供完全概率化的粒子权重。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准函数上验证算法性能。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a global stochastic optimization algorithm for noisy black-box functions that integrates exploration and exploitation within a Bayesian framework.
summary_en.method: Reformulates optimization as a state estimation problem using particle filters, with a transition model based on covariance ellipsoids and Unscented Transform to handle measurement noise.
summary_en.result: The proposed Particle Filter Optimization (PFO) outperforms existing stochastic optimization algorithms on multi-modal benchmark functions, offering fully probabilistic particle weights.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark functions with noisy evaluations, demonstrating robustness and efficiency.

title: Normalizing Flows for Conformal Regression
relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移至代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及FEA或生物力学设计。

summary_zh.motivation: 提高共形预测区间效率，减少区间宽度。
summary_zh.method: 利用标准化流学习输入相关的最优距离度量进行校准。
summary_zh.result: 获得更紧的预测区间，同时保持覆盖有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准回归数据集上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Improve the efficiency of conformal prediction intervals by localizing them based on input features.
summary_en.method: Use normalizing flows to learn an optimized distance metric that replaces the standard prediction error for calibration.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves tighter intervals while maintaining valid coverage and estimates the gap between nominal and empirical conditional validity.
summary_en.validation: Experimental evaluation on standard regression benchmarks.

title: No-Regret Algorithms for Safe Bayesian Optimization with Monotonicity Constraints
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的安全贝叶斯优化方法可用于植入物设计的约束优化问题，但未直接涉及FEA代理模型。
why_not_core: Does not apply to FEA surrogate modeling or biomechanical implant design; no experimental validation in that domain.

summary_zh.motivation: 安全约束下贝叶斯优化难以同时实现低累积遗憾与安全区域扩展
summary_zh.method: 利用安全函数对单变量的单调性，提出可实现次线性遗憾的算法
summary_zh.result: 算法在合成函数上验证了安全高效优化能力
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: The challenge of balancing regret minimization and safe region expansion in constrained Bayesian optimization is addressed.
summary_en.method: A no-regret algorithm is proposed that exploits monotonicity of the safety function with respect to one variable to achieve sublinear regret.
summary_en.result: The algorithm demonstrates sublinear regret and safe optimization on synthetic functions.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic objective and safety functions.

title: Initialization-enhanced Physics-Informed Neural Network with Domain Decomposition (IDPINN)
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种改进的PINN方法，可迁移用于解决生物力学有限元代理模型中的正向问题，但未涉及约束优化或不确定性量化。

summary_zh.motivation: 提高PINN在正向问题中的预测精度。
summary_zh.method: 通过小数据集训练初始化网络结构，结合域分解和界面光滑条件。
summary_zh.result: 在多个正向问题上展示了精度提升。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准问题上进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the prediction accuracy of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for forward problems.
summary_en.method: Proposes IDPINN, which initializes subdomain PINNs using a pre-trained network and enforces smoothness at interfaces via domain decomposition.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments on several forward problems demonstrate improved accuracy over standard PINNs.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on standard numerical benchmarks (e.g., Poisson, Helmholtz, Burgers' equations) without experimental or real-world data.

title: BEACON: A Bayesian Optimization Strategy for Novelty Search in Expensive Black-Box Systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的BEACON方法基于贝叶斯优化和高斯过程，适用于昂贵黑箱系统的探索，可迁移至生物力学领域的代理建模与不确定性量化，但未直接涉及有限元或植入物设计。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on novelty search for diverse behaviors, not on single-objective optimization, constraint handling, or biomechanical implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有新颖性搜索方法需要密集采样，不适用于昂贵黑箱系统。
summary_zh.method: 提出BEACON，基于多输出高斯过程的贝叶斯优化，通过最大化后验样本的新颖性指标平衡探索与利用。
summary_zh.result: 在多个合成和真实任务中，BEACON在有限评估预算下显著优于现有基线。
summary_zh.validation: 通过十个合成基准和八个真实任务（如材料设计）验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: Existing novelty search methods rely on dense sampling that is impractical for expensive black-box systems.
summary_en.method: BEACON models the input-behavior mapping using multi-output Gaussian processes and selects new inputs by maximizing a novelty metric computed from posterior samples.
summary_en.result: BEACON consistently discovers broader sets of behaviors under tight evaluation budgets across synthetic and real-world tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on ten synthetic benchmarks and eight real-world tasks including materials design for clean energy.

title: The Deep Latent Space Particle Filter for Real-Time Data Assimilation with Uncertainty Quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了带有不确定性量化的潜空间粒子滤波方法，可迁移至FEA代理模型，但未涉及生物力学设计约束。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, biomechanical implant design, or constraint handling; it focuses on data assimilation for fluid dynamics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 数据同化中结合观测与模拟耗时且难以实时，需高效方法。
summary_zh.method: 使用Wasserstein自编码器和Transformer在潜空间进行粒子滤波。
summary_zh.result: 相比高保真滤波速度快数量级，精度高一个量级。

summary_en.motivation: Real-time data assimilation for complex physical systems is computationally prohibitive with traditional particle filters.
summary_en.method: A deep latent space particle filter (D-LSPF) using Wasserstein autoencoders with vision transformer layers for dimensionality reduction and transformers for time stepping.
summary_en.result: The D-LSPF achieves orders of magnitude speedup over high-fidelity filters and 3-5x speedup over alternatives, with up to an order of magnitude higher accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Validated on leak localization in multi-phase pipe flow and seabed identification for nonlinear water waves.

title: System-Aware Neural ODE Processes for Few-Shot Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 本文提出的元学习神经ODE过程框架可用于将贝叶斯优化推广至昂贵仿真场景，虽未直接处理FEA或植入物设计，但其约束处理方法对生物力学优化具有参考价值。
why_not_core: No validation on FEA or biomechanics problems; no explicit uncertainty quantification beyond GP posterior; no application to implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 在昂贵动态系统中高效优化初始条件和终止时间
summary_zh.method: 提出系统感知神经ODE过程结合两阶段贝叶斯优化框架
summary_zh.result: 在多个动态系统上展示了少样本贝叶斯优化的潜力
summary_zh.validation: 基于合成ODE轨迹数据的数值实验

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently optimize initial conditions and termination time in expensive dynamical systems governed by unknown ODEs.
summary_en.method: A system-aware neural ODE process (SANODEP) with a novel context embedding block is integrated into a two-stage Bayesian optimization framework that accommodates search space constraints.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates promising few-shot Bayesian optimization performance across multiple ODE systems, with trade-offs between prior flexibility and accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic ODE trajectory data; no real-world or FEA-based experiments.

title: Solving Partial Differential Equations in Different Domains by Operator Learning method Based on Boundary Integral Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了基于边界积分方程的算子学习方法，可解决不同域上的PDE求解，对代理建模具有直接参考价值。
why_not_core: The paper does not address uncertainty quantification or constraints handling, and lacks application to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.method: 提出基于边界积分方程的BI-DeepONet和BI-TDONet模型。
summary_zh.result: 模型可在任意域上预测PDE解而无需额外训练。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证框架有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the need for retraining operator learning models when solving PDEs on different domains.
summary_en.method: Propose BI-DeepONet and BI-TDONet based on boundary integral equations, using SVD and trigonometric coefficients.
summary_en.result: The trained models can predict PDE solutions on arbitrary domains without further training.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments demonstrate the efficacy of the theoretical framework.

title: Integrating Physics of the Problem into Data-Driven Methods to Enhance Elastic Full-Waveform Inversion with Uncertainty Quantification

summary_zh.motivation: 解决全波形反演中的局部极小问题和不确定性量化挑战

summary_en.motivation: To overcome local minima in elastic full-waveform inversion and quantify uncertainty by integrating physics knowledge into data-driven methods.
summary_en.method: Proposed a probabilistic deep learning framework based on elastic scattering theory and a modified variational autoencoder for time-harmonic FWI.
summary_en.result: The hybrid approach outperformed purely data-driven and physics-based methods in accuracy, while providing uncertainty estimates.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on a comprehensive synthetic dataset designed to mimic realistic conditions.

title: Bayesian Mesh Optimization for Graph Neural Networks to Enhance Engineering Performance Prediction
relevance_to_user: 本文提出基于贝叶斯优化的图神经网络网格代理模型，可提高工程性能预测精度，方法可迁移至植入物力学设计。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification in predictions, no direct implant or biomechanics application, and no constrained multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统代理模型简化CAD几何时丢失关键信息。
summary_zh.method: 用贝叶斯优化确定最优网格尺寸，构建GNN代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 最优网格尺寸显著提升预测精度，优于点云和体素表示。
summary_zh.validation: 对比不同3D表示法和优化方法计算成本。

summary_en.motivation: Surrogate models lose critical geometric information when simplifying CAD models to lower dimensions.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian graph neural network surrogate model is proposed with mesh size optimized via Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.result: Optimal mesh size significantly improves prediction accuracy, outperforming voxel and point cloud representations.
summary_en.validation: Comparative evaluation of 3D representations and computational cost of Monte Carlo and Bayesian optimization.

title: Astral: training physics-informed neural networks with error majorants
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于误差上界的损失函数可提升PINN代理模型的精度与不确定性量化能力，对植入物生物力学设计中的代理建模具有可迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the proposed method to implant or biomechanics design, lacks any experimental or clinical validation, and does not address constraint handling in optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服残差作为间接误差度量的缺陷，提出直接误差上界的PINN损失函数。
summary_zh.method: 基于误差上界设计Astral损失，推导多种PDE的误差上界形式。
summary_zh.result: Astral损失收敛更快、误差更小，误差估计通常紧致（各向异性方程过估1.5倍）。
summary_zh.validation: 在扩散、对流扩散、麦克斯韦等PDE基准上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Residual minimization provides an indirect error measure; this work introduces a loss function based on error majorants that directly upper bounds the solution error for PINNs.
summary_en.method: The Astral loss is derived by constructing error majorants for various PDEs and used to train neural networks without requiring labeled data.
summary_en.result: Astral loss achieves competitive accuracy with residual loss, faster convergence, and reliable error estimation (e.g., average overestimation factor 1.5 for anisotropic diffusion).
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on anisotropic diffusion, convection-diffusion, Maxwell's equations, and nonlinear elastoplasticity problems.

summary_en.result: The workflow achieved up to 6000x speedup compared to conventional simulators and successfully recovered unknown permeability and porosity fields.
summary_en.validation: Validated against a standard black-oil numerical simulator for the Norne field waterflooding case.

title: Physics and geometry informed neural operator network with application to acoustic scattering
relevance_to_user: 该方法具有几何泛化的物理信息算子学习能力，可迁移至植入物力学代理建模，但缺乏生物力学验证与不确定性量化。

summary_en.validation: Clinical validation using DXA scans at multiple time points over five years.

title: CoNO: Complex Neural Operator for Continous Dynamical Physical Systems

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operators struggle with non-stationary signals whose frequency characteristics change over time, motivating a new operator design.
summary_en.method: The Complex Neural Operator (CoNO) parameterizes the integral kernel using the Fractional Fourier Transform to better represent non-stationary signals in a complex-valued domain.
summary_en.result: CoNO achieves an average relative gain of 10.9% over state-of-the-art on seven challenging PDE benchmarks, and shows superior zero-shot super-resolution and noise robustness.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on numerical benchmarks including regular grids, structured meshes, and point clouds for partial differential equations.

title: Uncertainty Quantification for Deep Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一个全面的深度学习不确定性量化框架，可迁移至FEA代理模型，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。

summary_en.motivation: Current uncertainty quantification methods in deep learning are inconsistent and fail to cover all major sources of uncertainty.
summary_en.method: A comprehensive framework based on Bayes' theorem and conditional probability densities is proposed to systematically quantify input, data, weight, and model uncertainties.
summary_en.result: In a cloud autoconversion rate prediction task, training and testing data uncertainty dominates over other sources.
summary_en.validation: The framework is validated on a simple regression problem and a real-world application using aircraft measurements.

title: Physics-enhanced Neural Operator for Simulating Turbulent Transport

summary_en.result: The model accurately reconstructs high-resolution DNS data, maintains physical properties, and generalizes across different resolutions and PDEs.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on 3D turbulent flow datasets and 2D vorticity series from different PDEs, demonstrating accuracy and transferability.

title: Hybrid Reinforcement Learning Framework for Mixed-Variable Problems

summary_en.motivation: Mixed-variable optimization problems pose unique challenges due to complex solution landscapes and inefficient navigation of discrete-continuous spaces.
summary_en.method: A hybrid framework combining reinforcement learning for discrete variable selection and Bayesian optimization for continuous variable refinement is proposed.

summary_zh.result: 信赖域障碍法在高噪声或少配点下优于罚函数法，且用经典数值方法求解。

summary_en.motivation: To discover differential equations from noisy data by formulating the problem as a constrained optimization, overcoming limitations of unconstrained approaches.
summary_en.method: Represent the PDE as a neural network and solve a constrained optimization problem that balances data fitting and PDE satisfaction at collocation points, using penalty and trust-region barrier methods.
summary_en.result: The trust-region barrier method outperforms the penalty method, especially under high noise or few collocation points, and the discovered PDEs are solved with classical finite difference methods.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on Burgers' and Korteweg-De Vries equations compare the two constrained optimization strategies.

summary_zh.result: 在湍流基准上显著提升计算效率和精度
summary_zh.validation: 在Navier-Stokes方程数值基准上验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce training cost and improve accuracy of Fourier Neural Operators for spatiotemporal PDEs.
summary_en.method: Proposes a spectral fine-tuning framework that fine-tunes only the spectral convolution layer using a negative Sobolev norm loss derived from a posteriori error estimator.
summary_en.result: Achieves significant improvements in computational efficiency and accuracy on turbulent flow benchmarks compared to end-to-end training.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks of Navier-Stokes equations for turbulent flows.

title: Gradients of Functions of Large Matrices
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的矩阵函数梯度计算方法可加速高斯过程、贝叶斯神经网络等模型的训练，对代理模型中的不确定性量化有潜在应用价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical design application; it focuses on numerical linear algebra for ML models.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效计算大矩阵函数梯度以优化科学和概率机器学习模型
summary_zh.method: 推导Lanczos和Arnoldi迭代的伴随系统并在JAX中实现
summary_zh.result: 在PDE、高斯过程和贝叶斯神经网络中与现有方法竞争或超越
summary_zh.validation: 在多个基准任务上对比Diffrax、GPyTorch和标准分解方法

summary_en.motivation: Efficiently computing gradients of matrix functions is crucial for tuning scientific and probabilistic ML models such as PDE solvers, Gaussian processes, and Bayesian neural networks.
summary_en.method: This work derives previously unknown adjoint systems for Lanczos and Arnoldi iterations and implements them in JAX to enable automatic differentiation.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves competitive performance with Diffrax for PDE differentiation, GPyTorch for GP model selection, and outperforms standard factorization methods for calibrating Bayesian neural networks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on PDE, Gaussian process, and Bayesian neural network tasks demonstrate the method's efficiency and accuracy.

summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (modulus, strength) and biocompatibility assays.

title: Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种用于物理信息神经网络（PINN）的Kronecker因子近似曲率（KFAC）优化方法，可加速PINN训练并扩展至更大网络，其方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型的训练中。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on optimization of PINNs for general PDEs, not on surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics or design optimization, and lacks validation on biomedical or constraint-handling problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有二阶优化方法计算成本高，难以扩展至大规模PINN网络。
summary_zh.method: 提出Kronecker因子近似曲率（KFAC）方法，利用泰勒模式自动微分处理微分算子，降低计算成本。
summary_zh.result: KFAC优化器在小问题上与昂贵二阶方法相当，在大规模问题上优于一阶方法和LBFGS。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准PDE基准问题上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Second-order optimization methods for PINNs are computationally expensive and do not scale to large networks.
summary_en.method: A Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (KFAC) method is proposed, leveraging Taylor-mode automatic differentiation to handle the differential operator's computation graph with weight sharing.
summary_en.result: KFAC-based optimizers match expensive second-order methods on small problems, scale better to higher-dimensional networks and PDEs, and consistently outperform first-order methods and LBFGS.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard PDE problems demonstrate the method's performance and scalability.

title: RoPINN: Region Optimized Physics-Informed Neural Networks

summary_zh.motivation: 传统PINN在离散点优化导致全局精度不足
summary_zh.method: 将优化从孤立点扩展到连续邻域区域，结合蒙特卡洛采样与信任区域校准
summary_zh.result: RoPINN在多种PDE上一致提升PINN性能，无需额外反向传播
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准PDE基准上数值验证

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINN training on scattered points yields insufficient accuracy for continuous PDE domains.
summary_en.method: Extends optimization from isolated points to continuous neighborhood regions with Monte Carlo sampling and trust-region calibration.
summary_en.result: RoPINN consistently improves PINN performance across diverse PDEs without extra backpropagation.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard PDE problems.

title: Newton Informed Neural Operator for Computing Multiple Solutions of Nonlinear Partials Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出了一种结合牛顿法的神经算子，可高效学习非线性PDE的多解，对代理建模中处理多解问题有借鉴意义。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant FEA problems; no uncertainty quantification; no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经网络方法求解非线性PDE多解时面临不适定问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出牛顿信息神经算子，结合经典牛顿法与神经网络，单次学习多解。
summary_zh.result: 相比现有方法，所需监督数据更少，能高效学习多解。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个非线性PDE基准问题上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Classical neural network methods for nonlinear PDEs struggle with ill-posedness when multiple solutions exist.
summary_en.method: A Newton Informed Neural Operator is proposed, integrating classical Newton methods with neural operators to learn multiple solutions in a single training process.
summary_en.result: The method requires fewer supervised data points and efficiently captures multiple solutions compared to existing approaches.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on several nonlinear PDEs demonstrate the effectiveness.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种贝叶斯自适应校准方法，可提高仿真采样效率，适用于FEA替代建模中的参数校准和实验设计。

summary_en.motivation: Current calibration methods require many simulations and neglect informative correlations across the design space.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian adaptive experimental design is proposed that jointly estimates posterior parameters and optimal designs by maximizing a variational lower bound of expected information gain.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates improved data efficiency over related approaches on synthetic and real-data problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic benchmarks and real physical science problems.

title: Efficient Two-Stage Gaussian Process Regression Via Automatic Kernel Search and Subsampling
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种自动核搜索和子采样策略的两阶段高斯过程回归方法，可提高采样效率和不确定性量化能力，对代理模型构建具有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or implant/biomechanics design, and lacks validation on structural mechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高斯过程回归中均值、核函数和超参数误设问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出两阶段GPR框架分离均值预测与UQ，自动核搜索算法和子采样热启动策略。
summary_zh.result: 在UCI基准和医疗案例上展示了鲁棒性和精度，计算成本更低。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个真实数据集上评估，包括安全关键医疗案例。

summary_en.motivation: To address misspecification of mean, kernel, and hyperparameters in Gaussian Process Regression, which can lead to inaccurate predictions in safety-critical applications.
summary_en.method: Proposes a two-stage GPR framework separating mean prediction and UQ, an automatic kernel search algorithm with theoretical support, and a subsampling-based warm-start strategy for hyperparameter initialization.
summary_en.result: The methods achieve competitive or better performance with lower computational cost on UCI benchmarks and a safety-critical medical case study.
summary_en.validation: Extensive evaluation on real-world datasets including UCI benchmarks and a medical case study.

title: Stochastic Inference of Plate Bending from Heterogeneous Data: Physics-informed Gaussian Processes via Kirchhoff-Love Theory

summary_zh.motivation: 利用异构数据推断板结构状态并量化不确定性
summary_zh.method: 基于Kirchhoff-Love板理论的物理信息高斯过程，通过MCMC采样推断后验
summary_zh.result: 在简支和固支板算例中成功推断弯曲刚度和响应
summary_zh.validation: 数值模拟验证，无实验数据

summary_en.motivation: To integrate mechanical models with probabilistic models for stochastic inference of plate structures from heterogeneous monitoring data.
summary_en.method: A multi-output physics-informed Gaussian process is formulated by placing a GP prior on deflection and deriving covariance functions from Kirchhoff-Love plate differential operators, with posterior inference via MCMC.
summary_en.result: The method accurately infers flexural rigidity and response fields for simply supported and fixed plates under known loads.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on two numerical simulation cases without experimental or real-world data.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统PINN无法处理粗糙表面高频信号，需新方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出可训练傅里叶特征网络，自适应学习多频成分。
summary_zh.result: 与有限元结果高度一致，精度和效率优于固定频率网络。
summary_zh.validation: 与有限元方法对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional PINNs suffer from spectral bias and fail to analyze rough surface lubrication with high-frequency signals.
summary_en.method: A novel multiscale lubrication neural network with trainable Fourier feature embedding is introduced to adaptively capture various frequency components.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves high consistency with FEM results and outperforms fixed-frequency Fourier feature networks in accuracy and efficiency.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing simulation results with finite element method across multiple surface morphologies.

title: Gaussian Measures Conditioned on Nonlinear Observations: Consistency, MAP Estimators, and Simulation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种条件高斯测度的理论框架，可用于贝叶斯推断和不确定性量化，对代理模型中的UQ方法有潜在借鉴意义。

summary_zh.method: 提出条件测度的表示定理、MAP估计的松弛定义及拉普拉斯近似模拟方法
summary_zh.result: 条件测度可分解为无限维高斯部分与有限维非高斯部分，并给出高效模拟方案
summary_zh.validation: 理论推导与数学证明，无数值实验

summary_en.motivation: To establish a rigorous theoretical framework for conditioning Gaussian random variables on nonlinear observations, enabling consistent Bayesian inference and efficient simulation.
summary_en.method: A representer theorem decomposes the conditioned measure into an infinite-dimensional Gaussian and a finite-dimensional non-Gaussian part; a novel mode definition via relaxation and a Laplace approximation for simulation are introduced.
summary_en.result: The conditioned measure admits an analytical Gaussian component, and the proposed Laplace approximation enables efficient sampling for uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical proofs and consistency analysis without numerical benchmarks or experimental validation.

title: Fast meta-solvers for 3D complex-shape scatterers using neural operators trained on a non-scattering problem
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用神经算子加速求解波动方程，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。

summary_en.motivation: To achieve fast and accurate solutions for 3D scattering problems with complex shapes, enabling real-time target identification.
summary_en.method: A deep neural operator (DeepONet) is trained on a non-scattering problem and used as a coarse-scale preconditioner within relaxation or Krylov iterative solvers.
summary_en.result: The resulting meta-solvers are shape-agnostic, robust, and require orders of magnitude fewer iterations than standalone solvers for complex 3D scattering problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on a submarine scattering problem demonstrate the efficiency and robustness of the proposed meta-solvers.

title: Ensemble and Mixture-of-Experts DeepONets For Operator Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的集成DeepONet和混合专家架构可提高算子学习精度，有望迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。

summary_zh.motivation: 提升DeepONet在算子学习中的表达能力和泛化性能。

summary_zh.result: 在2D/3D PDE问题上相对误差降低2-4倍。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE基准和挑战性问题上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the expressivity and generalization of DeepONet for operator learning of PDEs.
summary_en.method: Proposes ensemble DeepONet with multiple trunk networks and a partition-of-unity mixture-of-experts trunk architecture.
summary_en.result: Achieves 2-4x lower relative L2 errors on 2D and 3D PDE problems compared to standard DeepONets.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard PDE benchmarks and challenging new operator learning problems.

title: Discovering Physics-Informed Neural Networks Model for Solving Partial Differential Equations through Evolutionary Computation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出进化计算自动搜索PINNs架构，可迁移至生物力学代理模型设计，但未涉及约束优化或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and no application to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINNs模型依赖人工设计，搜索空间有限，难以发现高性能架构。
