summary_en.method: An evolutionary computation method is proposed to simultaneously search for layer numbers, neuron counts, shortcut connections, and parametric activation functions expressed as binary trees.
summary_en.result: Models discovered by the evolutionary method achieve higher approximation accuracy and faster convergence on Klein-Gordon, Burgers, and Lamé equations compared to Bayesian optimization and random search.
summary_en.validation: Performance is validated on three benchmark PDEs with comparisons to Bayesian optimization and random search.

summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through microstructural analysis (SEM, XRD), tensile tests, hardness measurements, and electrochemical corrosion tests.

title: Active Learning with Fully Bayesian Neural Networks for Discontinuous and Nonstationary Data
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种用于非连续非平稳数据的主动学习方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的采样优化。
why_not_core: No application to FEA surrogate modeling, no implant or biomechanics context, no constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 高斯过程难以处理物理科学中的非连续和非平稳数据，需要更鲁棒的代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 采用全贝叶斯神经网络结合No-U-Turn采样器进行主动学习。
summary_zh.result: 在小数据场景下，FBNN在测试函数上提升了预测精度和可靠性。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准测试函数上进行数值基准验证。

summary_en.motivation: Gaussian processes struggle with discontinuities and non-stationarities common in physical science problems, motivating the exploration of alternative surrogate models for active learning.
summary_en.method: Fully Bayesian Neural Networks with the No-U-Turn Sampler are employed as probabilistic surrogates to guide active learning in low-dimensional small-data regimes.
summary_en.result: The proposed approach demonstrates improved predictive accuracy and reliable uncertainty estimates on test functions relevant to physical sciences.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic test functions with discontinuities and non-stationarities.

visual.caption: Figure 1: Fully Bayesian neural networks can outperform their Gaussian process counterparts on active learning tasks, particularly for systems exhibiting rapid changes in behavior and/or discontinuous transitions between different states. These types of behavior are often encountered in various physical science domains.

title: Positional Knowledge is All You Need: Position-induced Transformer (PiT) for Operator Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于位置注意力的高效算子学习架构，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address multi-objective optimization, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification, and lacks validation on implant/biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低Transformer在算子学习中的计算成本并提升可解释性
summary_zh.method: 提出基于位置注意力的PiT架构，仅依赖采样点空间关系而非函数值
summary_zh.result: 在多个PDE基准任务上超越现有神经算子，并具有更好的离散化收敛性
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE数值基准上测试，无实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce computational cost and improve interpretability of Transformer-based operator learning for PDEs.
summary_en.method: Proposes Position-induced Transformer (PiT) with a position-attention mechanism that depends only on spatial interrelations of sampling points, not input function values.
summary_en.result: PiT outperforms state-of-the-art neural operators on diverse PDE benchmarks and exhibits enhanced discretization convergence.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard numerical PDE benchmarks without experimental or biomedical case studies.

title: Expensive Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization Based on Diffusion Models
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于扩散模型的贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵多目标优化问题，但未涉及生物力学或FEA验证。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no implant mechanics or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 昂贵多目标优化中Pareto解集建模不稳定，需高效采样方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出复合扩散模型CDM-PSL，结合条件与非条件扩散生成高质量样本，并用信息熵加权平衡目标。
summary_zh.result: 在合成基准和实际问题上优于现有MOBO算法。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准多目标基准函数和实际工程问题上进行数值实验对比。

summary_en.motivation: Modeling complex Pareto front distributions with limited evaluations remains unstable in expensive multi-objective optimization.
summary_en.method: A composite diffusion model (CDM-PSL) with unconditional and conditional generation, plus an entropy-based weighting to balance objectives.
summary_en.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art MOBO algorithms on synthetic benchmarks and real-world problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard multi-objective benchmarks and a real-world engineering problem.

title: Accelerated Multi-Objective Alloy Discovery through Efficient Bayesian Methods: Application to the FCC Alloy Space
relevance_to_user: 该论文的贝叶斯多目标优化框架可迁移至植入物设计中的多目标优化问题，但缺乏生物力学约束和不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or FEA surrogate modeling; it focuses on alloy discovery with experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速多目标合金发现，减少实验次数
summary_zh.method: 提出BIRDSHOT贝叶斯框架，结合批量优化与实验循环
summary_zh.result: 仅探索0.15%设计空间即找到三目标Pareto前沿
summary_zh.validation: 通过真空电弧熔炼和力学测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate multi-objective materials discovery by reducing the number of required experiments.
summary_en.method: Proposes BIRDSHOT, a Bayesian optimization framework with batch acquisition for parallel exploration, integrated with experimental synthesis and testing.
summary_en.result: Identified a non-trivial three-objective Pareto set in the CoCrFeNiVAl HEA system by exploring only 0.15% of the feasible design space.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation via vacuum arc melting, tensile testing, and high-strain-rate nanoindentation.

summary_zh.motivation: 去除增材制造Ti6Al4V支架表面未熔颗粒以改善骨整合
summary_zh.method: 采用流动酸蚀刻(FAE)处理完全去除颗粒并构建表面微结构
summary_zh.result: FAE处理使弹性模量接近设计值，表面形貌优化，体内外骨整合效果提升
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试、体外细胞实验和体内动物实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To eliminate unmelted Ti6Al4V particles on additively manufactured scaffolds and improve osseointegration.
summary_en.method: Flowing acid etching (FAE) was applied to fully remove particles and create micron-scale surface topography.
summary_en.result: FAE treatment brought elastic modulus closer to the designed value and enhanced in vitro and in vivo osseointegration.
summary_en.validation: Validation included mechanical testing, in vitro cell assays, and in vivo animal experiments.

title: CAGES: Cost-Aware Gradient Entropy Search for Efficient Local Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种多保真贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification for structural simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维黑箱函数优化中，多保真信息源未被充分利用。
summary_zh.method: 提出成本感知梯度熵搜索（CAGES），利用信息论采集函数选择样本。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和强化学习基准问题上优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准和强化学习问题上验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently optimize expensive black-box functions in high-dimensional spaces by leveraging multiple cheaper approximations of the objective.
summary_en.method: Proposes Cost-Aware Gradient Entropy Search (CAGES), a multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization algorithm with an information-theoretic acquisition function that maximizes gradient information per unit cost.
summary_en.result: CAGES achieves significant performance improvements over state-of-the-art methods on synthetic and reinforcement learning benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks and reinforcement learning problems, demonstrating efficiency gains.

title: Generative flow induced neural architecture search: Towards discovering optimal architecture in wavelet neural operator
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种用于神经算子架构搜索的生成流方法，可迁移至代理模型设计，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on neural architecture search for wavelet neural operators in fluid mechanics, with no validation on FEA surrogate modeling, no uncertainty quantification, and no biomedical or implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 自动搜索神经算子最优架构，避免网格搜索的高成本。
summary_zh.method: 用生成流学习策略，顺序生成小波基和激活函数的超参数序列。
summary_zh.result: 策略能采样到性能更优的架构，提升小波神经算子性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在四个流体力学问题上验证架构搜索效果。

summary_en.motivation: To automate the discovery of optimal neural operator architectures, reducing the computational cost of exhaustive grid search.
summary_en.method: A generative flow-based policy learns to sequentially generate hyperparameters (wavelet basis and activation) for wavelet neural operators, guided by validation loss reward.
summary_en.result: The learned policy samples high-performing architectures, improving the accuracy of the vanilla wavelet neural operator on fluid mechanics benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on four fluid mechanics problems demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed architecture search.

title: Effects of design and manufacturing deviations on compressive properties of glass sponge lattice structures manufactured by selective laser melting
first_author_affiliation: Academy of Arts & Design, Tsinghua University, Beijing 10084, PR China

why_not_core: Does not explicitly link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching for biomedical implants, lacks fatigue testing, and does not report surface roughness or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 受玻璃海绵轻质高强启发，设计高性能点阵结构。
summary_zh.method: 设计五种玻璃海绵点阵结构，采用SLM制造并测试压缩性能。
summary_zh.result: 原始点阵结构因增强对角支柱和异质单元表现出优异的压缩稳定性和逐层断裂机制。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩力学测试验证结构性能。

summary_en.motivation: Inspired by the lightweight and high-strength glass sponge, this study aims to design lattice structures with superior compressive performance.
summary_en.method: Five types of glass sponge lattice structures were designed and fabricated via selective laser melting (SLM) using Ti6Al4V, followed by compressive testing.
summary_en.result: The original GSLS with heterogeneous geometries exhibited outstanding compressive stability and a unique cell-by-cell and layer-by-layer fracture mechanism due to reinforced diagonal struts.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was conducted through uniaxial compression tests to evaluate mechanical properties and failure modes.

title: Conformal Validity Guarantees Exist for Any Data Distribution (and How to Find Them)
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的共形预测方法可推广到任意数据分布，为代理模型的不确定性量化提供了理论基础，但未涉及有限元或生物力学应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any structural/mechanical simulation context.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有共形预测方法依赖数据可交换性假设，无法处理AI自主采集数据导致的分布偏移。
summary_zh.method: 理论上证明共形预测可推广到任意联合分布，并推导出针对协变量偏移的实用算法。
summary_zh.result: 在合成黑箱优化和主动学习任务上验证了所提算法的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成数据集上通过数值实验验证算法性能。

summary_en.motivation: Existing conformal prediction methods rely on exchangeability assumptions, which are violated when AI agents sequentially collect data, limiting their applicability.
summary_en.method: This paper proves that conformal prediction can be extended to any joint data distribution and derives tractable algorithms for covariate shifts induced by AI/ML agents.
summary_en.result: The proposed algorithms are empirically validated on synthetic black-box optimization and active learning tasks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic datasets demonstrate the validity and efficiency of the derived conformal algorithms.

title: Extension of graph-accelerated non-intrusive polynomial chaos to high-dimensional uncertainty quantification through the active subspace method
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的AS-AMTC方法结合主动子空间降维和图加速非侵入式多项式混沌，可解决高维不确定性量化问题，其降维和加速思想可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的高维UQ问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant design problems, lacks FEA surrogate modeling context, and does not handle constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维不确定性量化问题中多项式混沌方法面临维度灾难。
summary_zh.method: 提出AS-AMTC方法，将主动子空间降维与图加速非侵入式多项式混沌结合。
summary_zh.result: 在81维空中出租车轨迹优化问题中，AS-AMTC相对误差降低80%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过81维数值基准问题验证，与现有方法对比相对误差。

summary_en.motivation: High-dimensional uncertainty quantification problems suffer from the curse of dimensionality when using polynomial chaos methods.
summary_en.method: The proposed AS-AMTC method integrates active subspace dimension reduction with graph-accelerated non-intrusive polynomial chaos to efficiently handle high-dimensional UQ.
summary_en.result: On an 81-dimensional air-taxi trajectory optimization problem, AS-AMTC achieves an 80% reduction in relative error compared to existing methods.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a numerical benchmark problem (81D UQ from trajectory optimization) by comparing relative errors with baseline methods.

title: An Uncertainty-aware, Mesh-free Numerical Method for Kolmogorov PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该方法将高斯过程回归与蒙特卡洛结合求解高维PDE，具备不确定性量化能力，可迁移至生物力学代理模型。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on Kolmogorov PDEs without any application to solid mechanics, implant design, or biomechanical FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维Kolmogorov PDE求解困难，传统方法缺乏不确定性评估。
summary_zh.method: 利用高斯过程回归插值蒙特卡洛点解，结合Feynman-Kac公式实现无网格计算。
summary_zh.result: 在三个代表性PDE上验证了高精度和鲁棒性，优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过理论后验方差下界和数值基准测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: Solving high-dimensional Kolmogorov PDEs is challenging, and existing numerical methods lack uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: The method uses Gaussian process regression to interpolate pointwise Monte Carlo solutions obtained via the Feynman-Kac formula, enabling mesh-free computation.
summary_en.result: Extensive tests on three representative PDEs demonstrate high accuracy and robustness compared to existing methods.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through a theoretical lower bound on posterior variance and numerical benchmark tests.

title: Uncertainty quantification in metric spaces
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的度量空间不确定性量化框架可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但未涉及有限元仿真或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no implant mechanics, no surrogate modeling for expensive simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 为度量空间中的回归模型提供高效且具有理论保证的不确定性量化方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出与基模型无关的不确定性量化算法，适用于大规模数据集。
summary_zh.result: 在临床应用中展示了框架对复杂统计对象（如多元数据、图、分布）的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过线性回归模型在数字医学数据集上验证，包括理论一致性和数值实验。

summary_en.motivation: To develop an efficient and theoretically grounded uncertainty quantification framework for regression models with metric-space responses.
summary_en.method: Proposes base-model-agnostic algorithms with asymptotic consistency guarantees, capable of handling large datasets.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates effectiveness on clinical applications involving complex statistical objects such as multivariate data, Laplacian graphs, and probability distributions.
summary_en.validation: Validated via the global Fréchet model on digital medicine datasets, with both asymptotic and non-asymptotic guarantees in homoscedastic cases.

title: Digital Twin Calibration for Biological System-of-Systems: Cell Culture Manufacturing Process
relevance_to_user: 该论文将数字孪生与贝叶斯校准应用于细胞培养过程，其方法可迁移至生物打印中的过程监控与参数优化。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional Design of Experiments methods lack interpretability and sample efficiency, motivating a new optimal learning approach for digital twin calibration.
summary_en.method: A computational approach quantifies the impact of parameter estimation error of sub-models on digital twin prediction accuracy to guide sample-efficient and interpretable DoEs.
summary_en.result: The method enables efficient and interpretable experimental designs, improving digital twin prediction accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation cases of a multi-scale mechanistic cell culture model.

title: Annealed adaptive importance sampling method in PINNs for solving high dimensional partial differential equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的自适应重要性采样方法可提高PINN求解高维PDE的效率，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计应用。

title: WISER: multimodal variational inference for full-waveform inversion without dimensionality reduction
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的半摊销变分推断框架可用于高维反问题的不确定性量化，方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性估计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on geophysical full-waveform inversion, not on biomedical FEA surrogate modeling or implant design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现全波形反演中多模态后验分布的高效不确定性量化。
summary_zh.method: 提出半摊销变分推断框架WISER，结合生成式AI与声波物理进行后验细化。
summary_zh.result: 在不降维的情况下获得全分辨率、计算可行的速度模型不确定性估计。
summary_zh.validation: 通过2D声波案例验证了方法的有效性和可靠性。

summary_en.motivation: To achieve computationally feasible uncertainty quantification for multimodal posterior distributions in full-waveform inversion without dimensionality reduction.
summary_en.method: A semi-amortized variational inference framework (WISER) is proposed, combining generative AI for amortized inference and non-amortized refinements using acoustic wave physics.
summary_en.result: Full-resolution, computationally feasible, and reliable uncertainty estimates of velocity models and imaged reflectivities are obtained.
summary_en.validation: The framework is validated on 2D acoustic wave case studies demonstrating its capability for uncertainty quantification.

title: Introducing a microstructure-embedded autoencoder approach for reconstructing high-resolution solution field data from a reduced parametric space
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种多保真深度学习方法，将低分辨率解映射到高分辨率，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的降阶或超分辨率任务。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on heat transfer in heterogeneous materials, not on implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical FEA surrogate application.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低高保真解的计算成本，同时保留关键细节。
summary_zh.method: 设计微结构嵌入自编码器，将低分辨率解与热导率图拼接后上采样。
summary_zh.result: MEA在计算效率和误差上优于U-Net、插值等方法。
summary_zh.validation: 与有限元方法及多种上采样技术对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of obtaining high-fidelity solution fields while preserving critical details at sharp interfaces.
summary_en.method: A microstructure-embedded autoencoder (MEA) concatenates heat conductivity maps of different resolutions to the decoder to upscale low-fidelity solutions from a neural operator.
summary_en.result: MEA outperforms standard U-Net, interpolation, and feedforward neural networks in both computational efficiency and accuracy on test cases.
summary_en.validation: Comparison with finite element method and multiple upscaling techniques on a 2D steady-state heat transfer problem with heterogeneous microstructure.

title: Discretization Error of Fourier Neural Operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文分析了FNO的离散化误差，对理解神经算子的数值精度有理论价值，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: FNO在连续定义与离散实现之间存在离散化误差，需量化其对模型精度的影响。
summary_zh.method: 理论推导离散化误差的代数收敛率，并设计算法优化训练时间。
summary_zh.result: 获得了离散化误差随网格分辨率收敛的代数率，数值实验验证了理论。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证理论收敛率并分析模型稳定性。

summary_en.motivation: The discretization error between the continuous definition of Fourier Neural Operators and their discrete implementation is analyzed to quantify its impact on model accuracy.
summary_en.method: Algebraic convergence rates of the discretization error are derived as a function of grid resolution and input regularity, and an algorithm leveraging error decomposition is proposed to optimize training time.
summary_en.result: Theoretical convergence rates are obtained and validated numerically, with additional analysis of model stability.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on benchmark problems confirm the theoretical convergence rates and demonstrate model stability.

title: A comparative study of conformal prediction methods for valid uncertainty quantification in machine learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于无分布假设的共形预测方法，可迁移至代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及FEA或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate application, no implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling or optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 机器学习模型缺乏可靠的不确定性量化，共形预测提供无分布假设的解决方案。
summary_zh.method: 系统综述共形预测框架，分析其理论性质和应用方面。
summary_zh.result: 共形预测是唯一无需分布假设即可提供有效不确定性估计的框架。
summary_zh.validation: 理论分析，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Machine learning models often lack reliable uncertainty quantification, and conformal prediction offers a distribution-free framework to address this gap.
summary_en.method: This dissertation provides a comprehensive review and analysis of conformal prediction methods, focusing on their theoretical guarantees and practical aspects.
summary_en.result: Conformal prediction is identified as the only framework that provides valid uncertainty estimates without distributional assumptions or asymptotic approximations.
summary_en.validation: The work is theoretical, with no experimental or simulation-based validation.

title: Polynomial Chaos Expanded Gaussian Process
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的PCEGP方法通过多项式混沌展开实现非平稳高斯过程，可提高代理模型在局部区域的预测精度，对生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真替代建模具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to any FEA or biomechanics design problem, lacks uncertainty quantification for optimization constraints, and provides no validation on engineering surrogate modeling tasks.

summary_zh.motivation: 全局模型在局部区域预测不准，需要局部模型但增加复杂度
summary_zh.method: 提出多项式混沌展开高斯过程，用PCE计算输入依赖的超参数
summary_zh.result: 在回归基准测试中预测误差低，性能优于或媲美现有方法
summary_zh.validation: 在标准回归基准数据集上比较多种算法

summary_en.motivation: Global models often fail to provide accurate predictions in local regions, while local models increase complexity; this work addresses the need for models that effectively represent both global and local experimental spaces.
summary_en.method: A novel Polynomial Chaos Expanded Gaussian Process (PCEGP) is introduced, which uses polynomial chaos expansion to compute input-dependent hyperparameters of the Gaussian process, enabling non-stationary covariance and heteroscedastic noise estimation.
summary_en.result: The PCEGP achieves low prediction errors on benchmark regression tasks, often competitive with or better than previous methods, with interpretable hyperparameters and training/prediction runtimes comparable to standard GP.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated on standard numerical benchmark datasets for regression, comparing against various algorithms.

title: Multivariate Bayesian Last Layer for Regression with Uncertainty Quantification and Decomposition
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯最后一层方法可用于不确定性量化，可迁移至代理模型以提升预测可靠性。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or biomechanics design; it focuses on general regression UQ without application to expensive simulation sampling.

summary_zh.motivation: 为多元异方差回归提供高效的不确定性量化方法
summary_zh.method: 提出贝叶斯最后一层模型，使用EM算法学习参数
summary_zh.result: 能分离偶然与认知不确定性，单次前向传播即可量化
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准上验证不确定性分解效果

summary_en.motivation: To enable efficient uncertainty quantification for multivariate regression with heteroscedastic noise.
summary_en.method: Proposes Bayesian Last Layer models with EM algorithms for parameter learning.
summary_en.result: The framework disentangles aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty with a single forward pass.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks demonstrating uncertainty decomposition.

title: Reduced-order modeling for second-order computational homogenization with applications to geometrically parameterized elastomeric metamaterials
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的降阶建模方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context, no uncertainty quantification, and no constraint handling for optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 二阶计算均匀化微观问题计算成本高，需降阶模型加速。
summary_zh.method: 采用POD和定制超缩减方法构建微观问题降阶模型。
summary_zh.result: 降阶模型与全阶模型吻合良好，相比直接数值模拟加速约100倍。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值算例对比降阶模型、全阶均匀化模型和直接数值模拟。

summary_en.motivation: Second-order computational homogenization is computationally expensive due to repeated microscale RVE solves, motivating a reduced-order model.
summary_en.method: A reduced-order model is developed using proper orthogonal decomposition and a novel hyperreduction method tailored for the second-order homogenization problem.
summary_en.result: The reduced-order model achieves speed-ups of about 100x compared to direct numerical simulations while maintaining good accuracy relative to the full homogenization model.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing the reduced-order model against full second-order homogenization and direct numerical simulations on two numerical examples.

title: Adaptive Gaussian Process Regression for Bayesian inverse problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了自适应高斯过程回归方法，可潜在用于生物力学仿真中的代理模型构建，但未直接涉及植入物设计或约束处理。
why_not_core: The paper does not handle constraints, lacks validation on implant or biomechanics problems, and only demonstrates on simple test cases.

summary_zh.motivation: 为高代价正向模型的贝叶斯逆问题高效构建代理模型
summary_zh.method: 提出自适应GPR方法，基于KL散度进行目标导向的主动学习以优化训练数据
summary_zh.result: 在简单测试问题上展示了计算成本降低和后验保真度的提升
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个数值测试问题验证方法有效性

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently construct surrogate models for Bayesian inverse problems with expensive forward model evaluations.
summary_en.method: An adaptive Gaussian Process Regression framework interleaves goal-oriented active learning based on Kullback-Leibler divergence with MCMC sampling to optimize both training point positions and simulation tolerances.
summary_en.result: The method reduces computational cost while maintaining fidelity of posterior distributions, demonstrated on two simple test problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation via numerical benchmark problems with known posterior distributions.

title: Symmetry group based domain decomposition to enhance physics-informed neural networks for solving partial differential equations
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过对称性改进PINN求解偏微分方程，可迁移到生物力学有限元替代模型中，但未直接用于植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address sampling efficiency, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on enhancing PINN for general PDEs using symmetry.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升PINN在全域求解PDE的准确性和效率。
summary_zh.method: 利用对称群生成已知解信息的划分线，分解区域后分段训练PINN再拼接。
summary_zh.result: 在KdV方程和粘性流体方程上的精度大幅优于标准PINN。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个经典PDE数值算例验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Physics-informed neural networks suffer from accuracy and efficiency issues when solving PDEs over the entire domain.
summary_en.method: A symmetry group is used to generate dividing lines with known solution information, decomposing the domain into non-overlapping sub-domains, where PINN is trained separately and solutions are stitched together.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves significantly higher accuracy than vanilla PINN and extended PINN on Korteweg-de Vries and nonlinear viscous fluid equations.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on two PDE examples demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach.

title: Optimal time sampling in physics-informed neural networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究PINN中的最优时间采样策略，虽不直接用于生物力学代理模型，但可迁移至类似模拟效率问题。
why_not_core: No surrogate modeling for design optimization, no uncertainty quantification, no implant/biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解释PINN中时间采样的最优分布，解决非均匀采样缺乏理论依据的问题。
summary_zh.method: 基于神经网络收敛标准假设，推导出最优采样服从截断指数分布。
summary_zh.result: 说明何时应使用均匀采样，何时需采用指数分布，并在典型方程上验证。
summary_zh.validation: 通过线性方程、Burgers方程和Lorenz系统数值验证理论结果。

summary_en.motivation: To provide a rigorous theoretical justification for non-uniform time sampling in physics-informed neural networks, addressing the lack of explanation for overweighting initial time instants.
summary_en.method: Under standard neural network convergence assumptions, the optimal time sampling distribution is derived as a truncated exponential distribution using prototypical examples.
summary_en.result: Conditions for uniform versus exponential time sampling are clarified, with numerical illustrations on linear, Burgers', and Lorenz equations.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on three standard PDE/ODE systems confirm the theoretical sampling strategy.

title: Fast Adaptive Fourier Integration for Spectral Densities of Gaussian Processes
relevance_to_user: 提出了一种高效计算高斯过程协方差函数的自适应积分方法，可提高代理模型的训练和预测效率。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design; it is a purely numerical method for fast covariance evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效计算任意谱密度对应的协方差函数及其导数。
summary_zh.method: 采用高阶面板积分、非均匀FFT和奈奎斯特启发式选择实现自适应积分。
summary_zh.result: 相比均匀积分加速数个数量级，可在笔记本上秒级计算百万点协方差。
summary_zh.validation: 在长记忆风场数据上验证数值精度与效率。

summary_en.motivation: To enable flexible stationary covariance function design by efficiently evaluating covariance functions from arbitrary continuous, integrable spectral densities.
summary_en.method: An adaptive integration framework using high-order panel quadrature, nonuniform fast Fourier transform, and Nyquist-informed panel selection with novel truncation error bounds.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates orders of magnitude speedup over uniform quadrature, allowing evaluation at millions of locations to user-specified tolerance in seconds on a laptop.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks and gradient-based maximum likelihood estimation on a long-memory spectral model for wind velocities.

key_terms.zh: 非均匀快速傅里叶变换

title: Optimal Initialization of Batch Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法虽不直接针对生物力学或有限元代理模型，但其批量贝叶斯优化思想可迁移至植入物设计的昂贵仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: No direct application to FEA surrogate or implant design; does not handle constraints or provide UQ beyond standard Bayesian optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 改善批量贝叶斯优化中初始批次设计的效率
summary_zh.method: 提出最小终期方差采集函数，基于I-最优性设计初始及后续批次
summary_zh.result: 在测试函数和模拟器上优于其他批量贝叶斯优化方法
summary_zh.validation: 数值实验对比多个函数和模拟器

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency of initial batch design in batch Bayesian optimization for costly simulations.
summary_en.method: Proposes the Minimal Terminal Variance acquisition function based on I-optimality to design informative batches for all iterations.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments on test functions and simulators demonstrate that MTV outperforms other batch Bayesian optimization methods.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical benchmarks on synthetic test functions and simulators.

title: Implicit Generative Prior for Bayesian Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种新的贝叶斯神经网络不确定性量化方法，虽然未直接应用于FEA代理模型，但其方法可迁移到植入物设计中的不确定性评估。
why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, lacks constraints handling, and does not demonstrate application to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决贝叶斯神经网络中先验定义困难与计算效率低的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出神经自适应经验贝叶斯框架，利用隐式生成先验结合变分推断与梯度上升算法
summary_zh.result: 在多个数据集上提高了预测精度与不确定性量化效果
summary_zh.validation: 在螺旋分类、回归、UCI数据集及图像分类任务上验证

summary_en.motivation: Defining meaningful priors and ensuring computational efficiency in Bayesian neural networks remain challenging for complex real-world applications.
summary_en.method: The proposed Neural Adaptive Empirical Bayes (NA-EB) framework integrates implicit generative priors with variational inference and a gradient ascent algorithm for simultaneous hyperparameter selection and posterior approximation.
summary_en.result: Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate superior prediction accuracy and uncertainty quantification compared to existing methods.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on two-spiral problem, regression tasks, 10 UCI datasets, MNIST, and CIFAR-10 classification.

title: Similarity Equivariant Graph Neural Networks for Homogenization of Metamaterials
relevance_to_user: 该方法利用等变图神经网络加速超材料均质化模拟，可迁移至植入物力学性能的代理建模。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, constraint handling, or explicit implant-specific biomechanics validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发高效代理模型加速超材料模拟，避免高计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 提出相似性等变图神经网络，将微观结构作为输入并利用多种对称性。
summary_zh.result: 等变图网络比少对称性模型更准确且数据高效。
summary_zh.validation: 通过有限元模拟数据验证模型预测能量和应力的准确性。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate the simulation of soft porous mechanical metamaterials by developing a machine learning surrogate model that scales favorably compared to conventional finite element methods.
summary_en.method: A similarity equivariant graph neural network is introduced that incorporates Euclidean and scale symmetries, periodic boundary conditions, and takes the microstructure as input to predict global quantities and pattern transformations.
summary_en.result: The proposed equivariant network achieves higher accuracy and data efficiency than graph neural networks with fewer symmetries.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated on numerical simulation cases of metamaterials with various microstructures, demonstrating accurate prediction of energy, stress, and stiffness.

title: Markov Chain Monte Carlo with Gaussian Process Emulation for a 1D Hemodynamics Model of CTEPH
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用高斯过程代理模型和MCMC进行血流动力学模型校准，方法可迁移至生物力学FEA代理建模，但非直接用于植入物设计或结构优化。
why_not_core: No implant design, structural FEA, or contact mechanics; focuses on hemodynamics rather than solid mechanics surrogate modeling for orthopedics.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速CTEPH血流动力学模型的个性化校准
summary_zh.method: 高斯过程代理模型结合马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛进行贝叶斯校准
summary_zh.result: 实现了微血管功能障碍和壁面剪切应力的个性化预测
summary_zh.validation: 大型动物模型回顾性数据验证

summary_en.motivation: Accelerate expensive 1D hemodynamics simulations for subject-specific calibration of chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension models.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process emulator combined with Markov Chain Monte Carlo for Bayesian calibration of a 1D hemodynamics model.
summary_en.result: Subject-specific predictions reveal microvascular dysfunction and arterial wall shear stress changes in CTEPH.
summary_en.validation: Retrospective data from a large animal model of CTEPH are used for calibration and validation.

title: Stability in Training PINNs for Stiff PDEs: Why Initial Conditions Matter
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了刚性PDE中PINN训练的稳定性，但未涉及昂贵仿真采样、约束处理、不确定量化或植入物与生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or direct application to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 揭示刚性PDE中PINN训练不稳定的关键因素
summary_zh.method: 系统消融初始条件强制与损失加权策略
summary_zh.result: 精确强制初始条件对稳定训练至关重要
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个刚性基准PDE验证

summary_en.motivation: To identify the critical factor causing instability in PINN training for stiff time-dependent PDEs.
summary_en.method: Systematic ablation of hard initial-condition constraints and adaptive loss weighting across challenging benchmarks.
summary_en.result: Exact enforcement of initial conditions is found to be essential for stability and efficiency in PINN training.
summary_en.validation: Validated on benchmarks involving sharp transitions, higher-order derivatives, coupled systems, and high-frequency modes.

title: Neural Operators Learn the Local Physics of Magnetohydrodynamics
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学有限元替代建模，但未涉及生物医学或植入物结构力学。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no solid FEA validation; applied to MHD plasma physics only.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速磁流体力学模拟，降低计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 提出改进的Flux傅里叶神经算子逼近理想MHD数值通量。
summary_zh.result: 相比现有神经算子模型，精度更高且能泛化至分布外样本。
summary_zh.validation: 在理想MHD方程标准基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Accelerate computationally expensive magnetohydrodynamics simulations using neural operators as surrogate models.
summary_en.method: Propose a modified Flux Fourier Neural Operator to approximate the numerical flux of ideal MHD equations.
summary_en.result: Outperforms existing neural operator models in accuracy and computational speed, with capability for continuous inference and out-of-distribution generalization.
summary_en.validation: Benchmarked against classical numerical schemes on ideal MHD test cases.

title: Neural Operator induced Gaussian Process framework for probabilistic solution of parametric partial differential equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合神经算子与高斯过程的概率PDE求解框架，具有不确定性量化能力，方法可迁移至生物力学中的代理建模与优化设计。
why_not_core: No biomedical or implant-specific application, no contact mechanics or stress shielding evaluation, and validation limited to benchmark PDEs.

summary_zh.motivation: 提出一种兼具预测精度和不确定度量的神经算子框架。
summary_zh.method: 将神经算子与高斯过程结合，构建概率PDE求解器。
summary_zh.result: 在多个PDE基准上精度优于现有方法，并提供合理不确定性估计。
summary_zh.validation: 基于Burger方程、Darcy流等标准数值算例进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: The paper aims to develop a neural operator framework that not only provides accurate PDE solutions but also quantifies prediction uncertainty, which is critical for data-limited scenarios.
summary_en.method: The proposed Neural Operator-induced Gaussian Process (NOGaP) integrates the representational power of neural operators with the probabilistic nature of Gaussian processes to solve parametric PDEs.
summary_en.result: NOGaP achieves superior accuracy compared to state-of-the-art operator learning methods on multiple PDE benchmarks, while producing well-calibrated uncertainty estimates.
summary_en.validation: The framework is validated on a set of standard parametric PDE problems including Burger's equation, Darcy flow, non-homogeneous Poisson, and wave-advection equations.

title: Mechanical Properties of Selective Laser Melting‐Processed Multihierarchical Lattice Structure Based on Body‐Centered‐Cubic Unit Cell

relevance_to_user: 该方法通过神经网络子空间求解偏微分方程，可转移至生物力学代理模型，但缺乏约束处理和不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No validation on FEA or biomechanics problems, no handling of constraints or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.result: 数值测试中误差可低于1e-10，训练仅需数百至两千epoch
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个标准PDE数值算例验证精度与效率

summary_en.motivation: To achieve high-accuracy solution of partial differential equations with substantially reduced training cost.
summary_en.method: A subspace spanned by neural-network-based basis functions is constructed, and the PDE and boundary conditions are enforced in strong form via collocation or L2 residual minimization.
summary_en.result: Errors below 1e-10 are reached in several numerical tests, requiring only hundreds to two thousand epochs.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard numerical PDE benchmarks, comparing accuracy and computational cost against PINN and DGM.

title: Effect of Hot Isostatic Pressing and Solution Heat Treatment on the Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of Ti-6Al-4V Alloy Manufactured by Selective Laser Melting

summary_zh.motivation: 研究后处理对EBM制造的Ti-6Al-4V合金力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对EBM样品进行固溶热处理和热等静压处理，并表征微观结构和力学性能。

summary_zh.validation: 通过微观结构观察和力学测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of post-fabrication treatments on the mechanical behavior of Ti-6Al-4V alloy produced by electron beam melting.

title: Conformal Prediction via Regression-as-Classification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种将回归转化为分类的共形预测方法，可用于替代模型的置信区间估计，但未涉及有限元分析或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: Does not address computational efficiency of FEA sampling, does not handle constraints, and is not validated on implant biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决回归问题中共形预测的不稳定性
summary_zh.method: 将回归转化为分类问题并设计新损失函数
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准上表现优异
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: To address instability in conformal prediction for regression with heteroscedastic or skewed distributions
summary_en.method: Converts regression to classification using a novel loss function and adapts classification CP techniques
summary_en.result: Achieves surprisingly good performance on many benchmarks
summary_en.validation: Empirical evaluation on multiple standard benchmark datasets

title: PINNACLE: PINN Adaptive ColLocation and Experimental points selection
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的PINN自适应采样方法可迁移至生物力学FEA代理模型，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: No application to biomedical FEA surrogate modeling, no handling of design constraints, and no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高PINN训练效率，现有方法仅单独优化配点或实验点选择。
summary_zh.method: 提出PINNACLE算法，利用神经正切核联合优化所有训练点类型的选择。
summary_zh.result: 在正问题、反问题和迁移学习中均优于现有采样方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准PDE数值算例验证算法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Improving PINN training efficiency by addressing the joint selection of all training point types, which previous methods treated separately.
summary_en.method: PINNACLE leverages Neural Tangent Kernel analysis to adaptively select collocation and experimental points, balancing their proportions during training.
summary_en.result: The method achieves superior accuracy and convergence compared to existing adaptive sampling techniques on forward, inverse, and transfer learning PDE problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks including Burgers' equation, Helmholtz equation, and diffusion-reaction systems.

title: The Tensor-Train Stochastic Finite Volume Method for Uncertainty Quantification
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过张量列分解缓解随机微分方程中的维数灾难，可迁移至生物力学有限元替代建模中的不确定性量化问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on hyperbolic conservation laws and shock-capturing, lacking FEA surrogate modelling for solid mechanics, constraint handling, or biomedical implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服随机有限体积法在高维随机变量下的维数灾难
summary_zh.method: 在张量列框架下引入全局WENO重构的随机有限体积法
summary_zh.result: 首次实现了张量列技术对含激波双曲守恒律的不确定性量化
summary_zh.validation: 通过经典双曲问题数值算例验证精度与效率

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the curse of dimensionality in stochastic finite volume methods for uncertainty quantification in hyperbolic conservation laws with shocks.
summary_en.method: Integrates tensor-train decomposition with global WENO reconstruction into the stochastic finite volume framework.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates effective uncertainty quantification for hyperbolic systems while mitigating the exponential growth of computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Validated on benchmark hyperbolic problems (e.g., Burgers' equation, Euler equations) showing accuracy and computational gains.

title: WaveCatBoost for Probabilistic Forecasting of Regional Air Quality Data
relevance_to_user: 该方法中的CatBoost代理模型和保形预测不确定性量化技术可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但文中未涉及固体力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper addresses air quality forecasting, not finite element analysis, surrogate modeling for structural mechanics, or biomedical implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高空气质量预测的准确性和可靠性
summary_zh.method: 结合最大重叠离散小波变换与CatBoost模型进行混合预测
summary_zh.result: 在真实数据集上优于统计和深度学习方法
summary_zh.validation: 使用中央污染控制委员会传感器网络和低成本空气质量传感器系统数据验证

summary_en.motivation: Accurate and reliable air quality forecasting is crucial for public health and environmental management.
summary_en.method: A hybrid WaveCatBoost model combining maximal overlapping discrete wavelet transform with CatBoost for time-series forecasting.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art statistical and deep learning models on two real-world datasets.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on data from a government sensor network and a low-cost sensor system, with conformal prediction for uncertainty quantification.

key_terms.zh: 最大重叠离散小波变换

title: Fast and Accurate Bayesian Optimization with Pre-trained Transformers for Constrained Engineering Problems
relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移至生物力学中昂贵仿真约束优化问题，但未直接验证植入物设计场景。
why_not_core: This paper does not validate on implant mechanics or biomechanics FEA surrogates, and lacks uncertainty quantification beyond BO's inherent uncertainty.

summary_zh.motivation: 约束工程优化代价高昂，传统方法依赖高斯过程迭代训练。
summary_zh.method: 利用预训练变换器（PFN）替代高斯过程，实现无迭代重训练的贝叶斯优化。
summary_zh.result: 在十五个基准问题上速度和精度均优于传统约束优化方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成、结构和工程设计基准进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Constrained engineering optimization with expensive black-box functions requires efficient methods beyond Gaussian process-based Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.method: We propose PFN4sBO, a Bayesian optimization framework using Prior-data Fitted Networks (PFNs), a type of pre-trained transformer, to infer constraints and optimal solutions without iterative retraining.
summary_en.result: PFN-based BO outperforms Constrained Expected Improvement and penalty-based GP methods by an order of magnitude in speed and achieves higher accuracy in finding feasible optimal solutions.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on a comprehensive benchmark of fifteen test problems including synthetic, structural, and engineering design challenges.

title: Knowledge-Based Convolutional Neural Network for the Simulation and Prediction of Two-Phase Darcy Flows
relevance_to_user: 该方法可转移至生物力学仿真中，用于提高采样效率并整合物理约束。
why_not_core: This paper does not address uncertainty quantification, patient-specific modeling, or implant biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高PINN对间断输入数据的处理能力
summary_zh.method: 将离散化控制方程嵌入神经网络框架
summary_zh.result: 预测精度优于非物理感知模型
summary_zh.validation: 在大规模数据集上比较数值模拟结果

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the accuracy of physics-informed neural networks in handling discontinuous input data for complex flow simulations.
summary_en.method: Incorporating discretized forms of the governing equations into the neural network architecture to enforce physical consistency.
summary_en.result: The proposed model achieves high accuracy in predicting pressure and saturation fields, outperforming non-physically aware models.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on a large-scale dataset of two-phase Darcy flow simulations, comparing against traditional numerical solutions.

title: Universal Functional Regression with Neural Operator Flows
relevance_to_user: 该方法虽未直接应用于FEA代理建模，但其算子学习和不确定量化能力可转移至植入物力学仿真场景。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no handling of expensive simulation sampling, no constraint handling, and no biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 为克服高斯过程先验对函数回归的限制，提出通用函数回归框架。
summary_zh.method: 开发神经算子流（OpFlow），将数据函数空间可逆映射到高斯过程。
summary_zh.result: 实现了非高斯函数空间中的精确似然估计和鲁棒不确定量化。
summary_zh.validation: 基于合成高斯/非高斯数据及真实地震图评估回归与生成性能。

summary_en.motivation: To extend functional regression beyond Gaussian process priors by enabling tractable non-Gaussian priors.
summary_en.method: Neural Operator Flows (OpFlow) are developed as infinite-dimensional normalizing flows that map function spaces to a Gaussian process invertibly.
summary_en.result: OpFlow enables exact likelihood estimation and robust uncertainty quantification through posterior sampling in the data function space.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on synthetic Gaussian and non-Gaussian processes and real-world earthquake seismograms.

title: Space-time parallel scaling of Parareal with a physics-informed Fourier Neural Operator coarse propagator applied to the Black-Scholes equation
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用PINO作为粗求解器加速时空并行计算，方法可迁移至生物力学FEA代理模型构建。
why_not_core: No biomedical or implant design context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, only applied to Black-Scholes equation.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速时间依赖偏微分方程的求解，克服纯空间并行化的扩展限制
summary_zh.method: 将物理信息傅里叶神经算子作为Parareal算法的粗求解器
summary_zh.result: PINO粗求解器实现了与定制数值粗模型相当的收敛速度和更好的整体加速比
summary_zh.validation: 通过Black-Scholes方程数值实验对比PINO与数值粗模型的性能

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate the solution of time-dependent PDEs by overcoming the scaling limits of purely spatial parallelization.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed Fourier Neural Operator (PINO) is employed as the coarse propagator in the Parareal parallel-in-time algorithm.
summary_en.result: PINO-Parareal achieves convergence speed comparable to a bespoke numerical coarse model and yields better overall speedup when combined with spatial domain decomposition.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on the Black-Scholes equation benchmark compare convergence and speedup against a standard numerical coarse solver.

title: MODNO: Multi Operator Learning With Distributed Neural Operators
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过分布式训练实现多算子学习，可推广至生物力学中的多工况代理模型，但未直接涉及约束优化或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: Does not address constrained optimization or uncertainty quantification, and no validation on implant or biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 以较少参数高效解决多算子学习问题，降低平均计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 提出分布式训练策略：各算子独立学习输出基函数，全局共享输入编码。

summary_en.motivation: To enable a single neural operator with fewer parameters to efficiently tackle multi-operator learning problems without additional average costs.
summary_en.method: A distributed training approach that learns output basis functions independently per operator while centralizing the input function encoding.
summary_en.result: Demonstrated enhanced efficiency and satisfactory accuracy across five numerical examples, with improved construction for operators with limited data.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on various operator learning problems.

title: Effect of heat treatment on the microstructure and mechanical properties of biocompatible Ti–Ta–Nb–Zr alloys prepared by selective laser melting

title: Composite Bayesian Optimization In Function Spaces Using NEON -- Neural Epistemic Operator Networks
relevance_to_user: 该方法为算子学习提供了不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学FEA替代模型，但未直接涉及植入物设计或约束处理。

summary_zh.validation: 在玩具和真实场景中与多种方法对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To develop an efficient uncertainty-aware operator learning method for composite Bayesian optimization problems.
summary_en.method: The NEON architecture is proposed, using a single operator network backbone to generate predictions with epistemic uncertainty.
summary_en.result: NEON achieves state-of-the-art performance while requiring orders of magnitude fewer trainable parameters.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing against state-of-the-art methods on both toy and real-world scenarios.

title: Adaptive hp-Polynomial Based Sparse Grid Collocation Algorithms for Piecewise Smooth Functions with Kinks
relevance_to_user: 该方法在处理非光滑响应面的自适应稀疏网格插值方面具有潜力，可迁移至生物力学代理模型构建。
why_not_core: The paper does not involve FEA, implant mechanics, or biomechanics; validation is on numerical benchmarks only.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维非光滑函数插值在UQ中计算代价高，标准稀疏网格收敛慢甚至失败。
summary_zh.method: 构建hp自适应稀疏网格配点算法，结合低阶局部基与变阶全局基，通过层次余量检测非光滑区。
summary_zh.result: 多个数值算例表明新方法比局部线性/二次基函数更高效、准确。
summary_zh.validation: 四个不同维度的数值基准测试，对比不同基函数精度。

summary_en.motivation: High-dimensional interpolation of piecewise smooth functions is computationally expensive and standard sparse grid methods converge slowly or fail near kinks.
summary_en.method: Two hp-adaptive sparse grid collocation algorithms are proposed, combining low-order basis functions with local support in non-smooth regions and variable-order bases elsewhere, with hierarchical surplus as error indicator.
summary_en.result: Numerical benchmarks show the proposed methods achieve higher efficiency and accuracy compared to locally linear, quadratic, and highest-degree basis functions.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on four numerical benchmark examples of varying dimensions, with comparison to standard basis functions.

summary_en.motivation: To develop high entropy alloys with enhanced properties for biomedical implant applications.
summary_en.method: CoCrFeMnNiTix alloys with varying Ti content were fabricated by selective laser melting and characterized for structural, mechanical, and surface properties.

title: Scalable Crystal Structure Relaxation Using an Iteration-Free Deep Generative Model with Uncertainty Quantification

why_not_core: This paper focuses on crystal structure relaxation in materials science, not on structural mechanics FEA, implant design, or biomechanical constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速晶体结构弛豫计算，克服迭代方法在大规模筛选中的瓶颈
summary_zh.method: 提出DeepRelax，一种无迭代的深度生成模型，直接预测平衡结构

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational bottleneck of iterative structure relaxation in large-scale crystal screening by developing an iteration-free method.
summary_en.method: DeepRelax, a deep generative model that predicts equilibrium crystal structures directly from unrelaxed inputs by learning the distribution of relaxed geometries.
summary_en.result: The model achieves millisecond-level relaxation per structure with high accuracy on five diverse crystal databases, validated by density functional theory.
summary_en.validation: Validation using density functional theory calculations on datasets including oxides, 2D materials, and van der Waals crystals, with integrated uncertainty quantification.

title: Mechanical Properties of Unalloyed Titanium Processed by Selective Laser Melting and Rotary Swaging

title: Goal-Oriented Bayesian Optimal Experimental Design for Nonlinear Models using Markov Chain Monte Carlo
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种面向非线性模型预测量的贝叶斯最优实验设计方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的主动学习与传感器布局优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or constraint handling in design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统最优实验设计关注参数估计，但实际更关心非线性预测量的信息增益。
summary_zh.method: 提出嵌套蒙特卡洛估计器，结合MCMC后验采样与核密度估计，最大化预测量的期望信息增益。
summary_zh.result: 在多个测试问题及对流扩散源反演中验证了方法有效性，并与非目标导向OED对比显示差异。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional optimal experimental design focuses on parameter estimation, but often the goal is to maximize information gain on nonlinear predictive quantities of interest.
summary_en.method: A nested Monte Carlo estimator is proposed, using Markov chain Monte Carlo for posterior sampling and kernel density estimation to compute the Kullback-Leibler divergence between posterior-predictive and prior-predictive densities, with Bayesian optimization over the design space.
summary_en.result: The goal-oriented OED method is demonstrated on several test problems and a sensor placement application for source inversion in a convection-diffusion field, showing differences from conventional OED.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks and a convection-diffusion source inversion application.

title: Bridging the Sim-to-Real Gap with Bayesian Inference

summary_zh.result: 在RC赛车上以少于一半的数据实现高动态漂移停车，均值和不确定性估计准确。

summary_en.motivation: To bridge the sim-to-real gap in robot dynamics learning by leveraging low-fidelity physical priors for data-efficient and uncertainty-aware modeling.
summary_en.method: SIM-FSVGD uses implicit physical priors from simulators to regularize neural network training within a Bayesian inference framework.
summary_en.result: The method achieves accurate mean predictions and precise uncertainty quantification, enabling a highly dynamic parking maneuver with drifting on a real RC racecar using less than half the data of state-of-the-art methods.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a real high-performance RC racecar system in a model-based reinforcement learning setting.

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate learning of dynamical systems by incorporating prior domain knowledge into the active learning sampling process.
summary_en.method: An active learning algorithm that guides exploration toward regions with high empirical discrepancy between observed data and an imperfect prior model.
summary_en.result: The proposed strategy explores high-discrepancy regions, accelerates learning, reduces model uncertainty, and provides a consistent estimate with an explicit convergence rate.

title: On Safety in Safe Bayesian Optimization

why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or expensive simulation sampling efficiency; it focuses on safe optimization under unknown constraints with theoretical guarantees.

summary_zh.motivation: 安全关键应用中贝叶斯优化的理论保证与实际实现存在差距。
summary_zh.method: 提出Real-β-SafeOpt和Lipschitz-only安全贝叶斯优化算法，解决安全保证、RKHS假设和离散搜索空间问题。
summary_zh.result: 新算法在保持安全性的同时，性能优于现有方法，并适用于中等高维问题。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个函数类上进行数值基准测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: The gap between theoretical safety guarantees and practical implementations in safe Bayesian optimization hinders real-world deployment in safety-critical applications.
summary_en.method: This work introduces Real-β-SafeOpt with rigorous GP bounds, Lipschitz-only Safe Bayesian Optimization (LoSBO) without RKHS assumption, and LoS-GP-UCB for higher-dimensional problems.
summary_en.result: The proposed algorithms maintain safety guarantees while achieving superior performance on various function classes and extending to moderately high-dimensional search spaces.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic functions demonstrate safety and optimization performance compared to state-of-the-art methods.

relevance_to_user: 该论文通过SLM制备多孔锌基支架并评估其力学与生物学性能，与您关注的增材制造生物医用材料方向相关，但未聚焦应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: It does not quantify stress shielding or implant-bone interface mechanics, lacks fatigue testing, and does not report surface roughness or osseointegration metrics.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发可降解锌基多孔支架用于骨缺损修复。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制备Zn/MgO复合支架，并表征其力学、降解、抗菌及生物学性能。
summary_zh.result: 支架强度接近松质骨，降解均匀，抗菌率>99%，体内12周完全填充骨缺损。
summary_zh.validation: 大鼠颅骨修复实验及力学压缩测试。

summary_en.motivation: To develop biodegradable Zn-based porous scaffolds with enhanced bioactivity for bone defect repair.
summary_en.method: MgO nanoparticles were coated on Zn powders and selective laser melting was used to fabricate porous Zn/MgO scaffolds with a gyroid structure.
summary_en.result: The composite scaffolds exhibited cancellous bone-matching strength, improved degradation uniformity, >99% antibacterial rate, and complete bone defect filling in rat cranium at 12 weeks.
summary_en.validation: In vivo rat cranial defect model and mechanical compression testing.

title: A Comprehensive Review of Latent Space Dynamics Identification Algorithms for Intrusive and Non-Intrusive Reduced-Order-Modeling
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的LaSDI框架可用于构建生物力学有限元分析的代理模型，但未涉及植入物设计或约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on reduced-order modeling for general PDEs without addressing implant-specific constraints, uncertainty quantification in biomechanics, or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低PDE数值求解的计算成本，发展高效降阶模型。
summary_zh.method: 提出LaSDI框架，将高保真数据映射到低维潜空间并学习ODE动力学。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准问题上实现相对误差低于百分之几，加速数千倍。
summary_zh.validation: 在Burgers方程、非线性热传导和等离子体物理问题上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational bottleneck of numerical PDE solvers by developing efficient reduced-order models.
summary_en.method: The LaSDI framework transforms high-fidelity PDE data into low-dimensional latent-space ODEs, with modulable components for thermodynamics, noise robustness, active learning, and uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: LaSDI algorithms achieve relative errors below a few percent and speed-ups of up to thousands of times on benchmark problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on Burgers equation, nonlinear heat conduction, and plasma physics problems.

title: Reconstructing Blood Flow in Data-Poor Regimes: A Vasculature Network Kernel for Gaussian Process Regression
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于物理信息核的高斯过程回归方法，用于数据稀缺条件下的血流重建，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的不确定性量化与约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on blood flow reconstruction in vasculature, not on implant biomechanics or structural FEA surrogate modeling, and lacks validation on mechanical stress/strain problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 临床血流数据稀缺，传统机器学习代理模型难以训练。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于物理信息核的高斯过程回归，在血管网络非欧空间中构建核函数。
summary_zh.result: 在Y型分叉、腹主动脉和Willis环上实现近实时血流重建，且满足质量守恒。
summary_zh.validation: 通过随机一维血流模拟生成数据，在三个测试案例上验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: Clinical blood flow data are often too sparse to train standard machine learning surrogate models, motivating a physics-informed approach for reconstruction.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process regression with a novel kernel constructed on the vasculature network using stochastic 1D blood flow simulations, encoding spatiotemporal and vessel-to-vessel correlations.
summary_en.result: The method enables near-real-time blood flow reconstruction in data-poor regimes, satisfying mass conservation, demonstrated on Y-bifurcation, abdominal aorta, and Circle of Willis.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via simulation cases using stochastic 1D blood flow models, without experimental or clinical data.

title: Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization With Across-Task Transferable Max-Value Entropy Search
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种跨任务多保真贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的多任务优化场景。
why_not_core: No application to FEA surrogate modeling, no implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification beyond acquisition function.

summary_zh.motivation: 多任务优化中高保真评估成本高，需跨任务迁移信息。
summary_zh.method: 提出跨任务最大熵搜索采集函数，结合粒子变分贝叶斯更新。
summary_zh.result: 跨任务迁移显著提升多任务优化效率。
summary_zh.validation: 合成与真实基准测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the cost of multi-task black-box optimization by transferring knowledge across related tasks.
summary_en.method: A novel information-theoretic acquisition function that balances current task information gain with future task transferability, using particle-based variational Bayesian updates.
summary_en.result: The proposed method improves optimization efficiency as the number of tasks increases, demonstrated on synthetic and real-world examples.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic functions and real-world engineering examples.

title: Derivative-informed neural operator acceleration of geometric MCMC for infinite-dimensional Bayesian inverse problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的导数信息神经算子加速几何MCMC方法，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵PDE反问题求解。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on infinite-dimensional Bayesian inverse problems with PDEs, not on implant-specific biomechanics or constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速几何MCMC在无限维贝叶斯反问题中的昂贵梯度与Hessian计算
summary_zh.method: 利用导数信息神经算子代理PtO映射及其雅可比，实现延迟接受几何MCMC
summary_zh.result: 代理驱动MCMC比几何MCMC快3-9倍，训练成本在10-25个有效样本后回本
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试验证了代理精度与采样加速比

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate geometric MCMC for infinite-dimensional Bayesian inverse problems by reducing the cost of repeated gradient and Hessian evaluations of the log-likelihood.
summary_en.method: A delayed-acceptance geometric MCMC method driven by a derivative-informed neural operator surrogate that jointly approximates the parameter-to-observable map and its Jacobian.
summary_en.result: The proposed DINO-driven MCMC generates effective posterior samples 3–9 times faster than geometric MCMC and 60–97 times faster than prior geometry-based MCMC, with training cost breaking even after 10–25 effective samples.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on PDE-based inverse problems demonstrate the accuracy and speedup of the surrogate-driven MCMC approach.

title: Bayesian Optimization that Limits Search Region to Lower Dimensions Utilizing Local GPR
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合局部高斯过程回归的贝叶斯优化方法，可扩展到高维问题，对用户研究中的昂贵仿真优化具有潜在借鉴意义。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化在高维参数下计算成本高、搜索效率低。
summary_zh.method: 提出将搜索区域限制在低维子空间，并利用局部高斯过程回归提高预测精度。
summary_zh.result: 在20维测试函数上效率提升约40%-69%，并在半导体器件设计中取得更好结果。
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准测试函数和半导体设计案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization suffers from exponentially increasing computational cost and reduced search efficiency as the number of parameters grows.
summary_en.method: The proposed method restricts the search region to a lower-dimensional subspace and employs local Gaussian process regression trained on a local data subset to improve prediction accuracy and reduce matrix inversion complexity.
summary_en.result: On 20D Ackley and Rosenbrock functions, search efficiency improved by about 69% and 40% respectively over standard BO, and the method achieved 25% better specific on-resistance in a power semiconductor design task.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic functions and a real-world power semiconductor design optimization case.

title: Scalable Spatiotemporal Prediction with Bayesian Neural Fields
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯神经场方法可用于时空预测与不确定性量化，其框架可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的稀疏数据建模与不确定性传播。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any structural/contact mechanics constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 大规模时空数据需要灵活且可扩展的统计建模方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出贝叶斯神经场，融合深度神经网络与分层贝叶斯推断。
summary_zh.result: 在气候和公共卫生数据上优于主流基线方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个真实数据集上与基线方法对比预测性能。

summary_en.motivation: Large-scale spatiotemporal datasets require flexible and scalable statistical methods for prediction and uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: BayesNF integrates a deep neural network with hierarchical Bayesian inference to model complex spatiotemporal distributions.
summary_en.result: The method outperforms prominent baselines on climate and public health prediction tasks with tens to hundreds of thousands of measurements.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on multiple real-world datasets, comparing predictive accuracy and uncertainty calibration against baselines.

title: PMBO: Enhancing Black-Box Optimization through Multivariate Polynomial Surrogates
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出多项式代理模型结合贝叶斯优化，可迁移至生物力学设计优化，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或具体应用验证。
why_not_core: No constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, no application to implant/biomechanics design, and only tested on low-dimensional analytic functions.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升低维黑箱优化中代理模型的效率与鲁棒性
summary_zh.method: 交替使用多项式近似与高斯过程误差建模的贝叶斯优化
summary_zh.result: 在低维测试函数上优于经典贝叶斯优化，与CMA-ES性能相当
summary_zh.validation: 在多个解析测试函数上对比不同优化方法

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency and robustness of surrogate-based black-box optimization, especially for low-dimensional problems.
summary_en.method: Alternates polynomial approximation with Gaussian process error modeling within a Bayesian optimization framework.
summary_en.result: Outperforms classic Bayesian optimization and matches CMA-ES on low-dimensional analytic test functions.
summary_en.validation: Compared against several optimization methods on a set of analytic test functions.

title: A polynomial chaos approach for uncertainty quantification of Monte Carlo transport codes
relevance_to_user: 该论文的PC方法可用于生物力学有限元代理模型的不确定性量化，但需调整至植入物设计场景。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on radiation transport, not biomedical FEA or implant mechanics, and lacks constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高蒙特卡洛输运代码中多项式混沌代理的效率和准确性。
summary_zh.method: 通过非侵入式谱投影构建PC代理，并改进重采样策略以获取无偏方差估计。
summary_zh.result: 算法改进实现了无偏方差估计和自适应展开，降低了重采样成本。
summary_zh.validation: 在衰减测试案例上验证了方法的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency and accuracy of Polynomial Chaos surrogates for Monte Carlo radiation transport codes by addressing resampling cost and estimator bias.
summary_en.method: Non-intrusive spectral projection is used to construct PC surrogates, with refinements to obtain unbiased variance estimators and adapt the expansion.
summary_en.result: The refinements yield unbiased variance estimates and adaptive expansion, reducing resampling cost.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on an attenuation-only test case.

title: Model-Free Local Recalibration of Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的局部重校准方法可提升神经网络不确定性量化能力，对代理模型在植入物设计中的可靠预测具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or biomechanical implant design; it focuses on general neural network recalibration for uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经网络概率预测常不校准，影响决策可靠性。
summary_zh.method: 利用隐藏层降维表示进行局部重校准，借鉴近似贝叶斯计算。
summary_zh.result: 模拟和实际数据表明方法优于现有校准技术。
summary_zh.validation: 通过仿真实验和钻石价格预测验证。

summary_en.motivation: Neural network probabilistic forecasts are often miscalibrated, limiting their utility in decision-making tasks.
summary_en.method: A localized recalibration method is proposed using dimension-reduced representations from hidden layers, inspired by approximate Bayesian computation.
summary_en.result: Simulation studies and a diamond price prediction application demonstrate improved calibration and uncertainty quantification over existing methods.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation benchmarks and a real-world diamond price prediction task.

title: Enhancing non-intrusive Reduced Order Models with space-dependent aggregation methods
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的空间依赖聚合方法可提高代理模型精度，对生物力学FEA替代建模有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on fluid dynamics ROMs.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高非侵入式降阶模型在参数空间中的预测精度。
summary_zh.method: 通过空间依赖权重组合多个ROM（POD/AE+RBF/GPR/ANN），用随机森林预测权重。
summary_zh.result: 混合ROM在NACA翼型流场预测中优于单一ROM。
summary_zh.validation: 在二维翼型流场数值基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy of non-intrusive reduced order models across the parameter space by combining multiple ROMs with spatially varying weights.
summary_en.method: A mixed-ROM is constructed via convex combination of predictions from several ROMs (POD/AE with RBF/GPR/ANN), where space-dependent weights are learned by a Random Forest regressor.
summary_en.result: The aggregated model achieves higher accuracy than any individual ROM on two NACA airfoil flow test cases.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks of 2D flow past NACA 4412 and transonic flow over NACA 0012 airfoils.

title: An Adaptive Dimension Reduction Estimation Method for High-dimensional Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过降维提高高维贝叶斯优化的效率，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraints, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics/implant design applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维贝叶斯优化效率低，需降维方法提升性能。
summary_zh.method: 先使用MAVE估计有效降维子空间，再在子空间内构建高斯过程并优化。
summary_zh.result: 数值实验验证了该方法在高维挑战场景下的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准数值基准测试验证算法性能。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization struggles in high-dimensional spaces, motivating a dimension reduction approach to improve efficiency.
summary_en.method: The method first estimates the effective dimension reduction subspace via minimum average variance estimation, then builds a Gaussian process model within that subspace and optimizes using expected improvement.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method on challenging high-dimensional benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard numerical benchmark functions.

title: TS-RSR: A provably efficient approach for batch Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种批量贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification in physical simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高批量贝叶斯优化中采样效率，减少冗余并平衡探索与利用。
summary_zh.method: 提出TS-RSR方法，通过最小化Thompson采样近似下的遗憾-不确定性比来协调批量采样。
summary_zh.result: 在多个合成和真实测试函数上达到最先进性能，并提供了理论收敛保证。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准函数上与其他批量BO算法对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve sampling efficiency in batch Bayesian optimization by reducing redundancy and balancing exploration and exploitation.
summary_en.method: Proposes TS-RSR, which coordinates batch sampling by minimizing a Thompson sampling approximation of a regret-to-uncertainty ratio.
summary_en.result: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on synthetic and realistic test functions, with rigorous theoretical convergence guarantees.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard numerical benchmark functions against competitive batch BO algorithms.

title: Explaining Bayesian Optimization by Shapley Values Facilitates Human-AI Collaboration
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出基于Shapley值的贝叶斯优化解释框架，可提升人机协作效率，其方法可迁移至植入物设计中的多目标优化与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on interpretability of BO for human-in-the-loop robotics.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化本身是黑箱，缺乏参数推荐理由，阻碍人机协作。
summary_zh.method: 提出ShapleyBO框架，用Shapley值量化各参数对采集函数的贡献，并分离探索与利用。
summary_zh.result: 在可穿戴机器人个性化中，ShapleyBO辅助的人机团队比无解释团队获得更低遗憾。
summary_zh.validation: 通过辅助背外骨骼的人机闭环优化案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization lacks interpretability for its parameter proposals, hindering human-in-the-loop applications.
summary_en.method: ShapleyBO uses Shapley values to quantify each parameter's contribution to the acquisition function, enabling decomposition of exploration and exploitation.
summary_en.result: Human-BO teams with ShapleyBO achieve lower regret in personalizing wearable robotic devices compared to teams without.
summary_en.validation: Validated via a human-in-the-loop optimization case study for assistive back exosuits.

title: A Model Hierarchy for Predicting the Flow in Stirred Tanks with Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了PINN在流体力学降阶建模中的应用，其方法（如域分解、参数化输入）可迁移至生物力学FEA代理模型，但未涉及固体力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on fluid dynamics in stirred tanks, not solid mechanics or implant biomechanics, and lacks validation on biomedical FEA problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 用PINN作为搅拌槽反应器流场的降阶模型，提高仿真效率。
summary_zh.method: 采用强边界条件、域分解和XPINN方法求解二维稳态Navier-Stokes方程。
summary_zh.result: 最佳模型对压力和速度的l1预测误差低于1%，且可跨雷诺数插值。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多次独立训练跟踪误差，验证模型可靠性。

summary_en.motivation: To develop fast-to-evaluate reduced order models for flow in stirred tank reactors using physics-informed neural networks.
summary_en.method: Imposed Dirichlet boundary conditions strongly, employed domain decomposition (overlapping and non-overlapping), and adapted XPINN to solve different equations in subdomains.
summary_en.result: The best models achieved l1 prediction errors below 1% for both pressure and velocity, and parametric models interpolated across a wide range of Reynolds numbers.
summary_en.validation: Error tracking over repeated independent training runs demonstrated reproducibility and reliability.

title: Targeted Variance Reduction: Robust Bayesian Optimization of Black-Box Simulators with Noise Parameters
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的鲁棒贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的不确定性优化问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant mechanics; it focuses on robust optimization of black-box simulators with noise parameters, lacking biomedical context and constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有鲁棒优化方法未联合优化控制参数与噪声参数，导致优化效率不足。
summary_zh.method: 提出目标方差缩减（TVR）方法，通过联合采集函数同时优化控制与噪声参数。
summary_zh.result: 在数值实验和汽车制动盘设计中优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验和工程案例验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: Existing robust optimization methods treat control and noise parameters separately, failing to exploit their interactions for efficient optimization.
summary_en.method: Proposes Targeted Variance Reduction (TVR), a Bayesian optimization method with a novel joint acquisition function over control and noise parameters.
summary_en.result: TVR outperforms state-of-the-art methods in numerical experiments and an automobile brake disc design application.
summary_en.validation: Validated through synthetic benchmarks and a real-world engineering design case.

title: TGPT-PINN: Nonlinear model reduction with transformed GPT-PINNs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的非线性模型降阶方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no uncertainty quantification, and no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决传输主导PDE的线性模型降阶在间断问题上的局限性
summary_zh.method: 在GPT-PINN中引入激波捕捉损失函数和参数依赖变换层
summary_zh.result: 在多个非平凡参数PDE上实现了非线性模型降阶
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证了方法的有效性

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the limitations of linear model reduction for transport-dominated PDEs with parameter-dependent discontinuities.
summary_en.method: A transformed GPT-PINN framework incorporating a shock-capturing loss function and a parameter-dependent transform layer.
summary_en.result: Demonstrated effective nonlinear model reduction on several nontrivial parametric PDEs.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical benchmarks on parametric PDEs.

title: Accelerating the convergence of Newton's method for nonlinear elliptic PDEs using Fourier neural operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用FNO加速牛顿法求解非线性椭圆PDE，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address multi-objective constraints, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses solely on accelerating Newton's method for elliptic PDEs.

summary_zh.motivation: 牛顿法求解非线性椭圆PDE时对初值敏感，收敛慢。
summary_zh.method: 使用FNO学习PDE参数到解的映射，作为牛顿法初值，损失含数据和物理残差项。
summary_zh.result: FNO初值显著加速牛顿法收敛，尤其对高度非线性和各向异性问题。
summary_zh.validation: 一维和二维数值算例验证，与朴素初值对比收敛速度。

summary_en.motivation: Newton's method for nonlinear elliptic PDEs suffers from sensitivity to initial guesses, leading to slow or failed convergence.
summary_en.method: A Fourier neural operator is trained with a combined data and physics-informed loss to map PDE parameters to approximate solutions, which serve as initial guesses for Newton's method.
summary_en.result: The FNO-based initial guess substantially accelerates Newton's method convergence, especially for highly nonlinear and anisotropic problems on coarse grids.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks in 1D and 2D demonstrate convergence speedup compared to naive initial guesses.

title: On Fractional Moment Estimation from Polynomial Chaos Expansion
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种从多项式混沌展开中解析估计分数阶矩的方法，可用于不确定性量化，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, lacks constraint handling, and does not demonstrate transfer to biomedical design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决昂贵模型分数阶矩估计的采样效率问题
summary_zh.method: 利用PCE系数通过Hölder不等式解析估计任意分数阶矩
summary_zh.result: 在三个数值算例中优于标准拉丁超立方采样
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently estimate fractional statistical moments of computationally expensive models without large experimental designs.
summary_en.method: Proposes an analytical estimation of arbitrary fractional moments from polynomial chaos expansion coefficients using Hölder's inequality.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates superior performance in estimating response distributions compared to Latin hypercube sampling on three numerical examples.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks with increasing complexity.

title: Joint Parameter and Parameterization Inference with Uncertainty Quantification through Differentiable Programming
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的联合参数估计与不确定性量化框架可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的构建与校准。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on subgrid parameterization in fluid dynamics and climate modeling, not on implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or surrogate modeling for FEA in biomedical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决数值模拟中参数化过程的不确定性问题。
summary_zh.method: 利用可微编程实现物理参数与机器学习参数化的联合贝叶斯推断。
summary_zh.result: 在概念验证中展示了联合估计与不确定性量化的可行性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证框架效果。

summary_en.motivation: To jointly estimate physical parameters and machine learning parameterizations with uncertainty quantification in hybrid physics-ML models.
summary_en.method: A framework combining online training and efficient Bayesian inference in high-dimensional parameter space via differentiable programming.
summary_en.result: Proof-of-concept demonstrates the potential of differentiable programming for synergistic hybrid modeling.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks for subgrid parameterization in PDEs.
