title: Effects of selective laser melting process parameters on 3D-printing of Ti6Al4V/ST316L composite material and their optimization using response surface methodology
first_author_affiliation: Al-Nahrain University, Iraq

corresponding_authors.name: Marwa M. Ismaeel
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Al-Nahrain University, Iraq

relevance_to_user: 该论文优化了SLM工艺参数以降低Ti6Al4V/ST316L复合植入物的刚度，与应力屏蔽相关，但缺乏疲劳和表面形貌表征。
why_not_core: This paper does not include fatigue testing, surface roughness or osseointegration assessment, and does not explicitly design porous structures for stress shielding reduction.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化SLM工艺参数以降低钛钢复合植入物的刚度，匹配自然骨。
summary_zh.method: 采用响应面法优化激光功率、扫描间距、扫描速度和ST316L含量。
summary_zh.result: ST316L含量显著影响力学性能，复合材料可用于膝关节假体。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩力学测试验证优化效果。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize SLM process parameters for Ti6Al4V/ST316L composite implants to achieve lower stiffness matching natural bone, thereby reducing stress shielding.
summary_en.method: Response surface methodology was employed to optimize laser power, hatch distance, scanning velocity, and ST316L weight percentage on compressive strength and Young's modulus.
summary_en.result: ST316L composition significantly influences the mechanical properties, and the optimized Ti6Al4V/ST316L composite is suitable for knee joint prostheses.
summary_en.validation: The optimization was validated by mechanical compression tests on SLM-fabricated samples.

title: Unexpected early loosening of rectangular straight femoral Zweymüller stems with an alumina-reduced surface after total hip arthroplasty-a prospective, double-blind, randomized controlled trial.
venue: Journal of orthopaedics and traumatology : official journal of the Italian Society of Orthopaedics and Traumatology
first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery and Traumatology, Kantonsspital Baselland, CH-4101, Bruderholz, Switzerland. celines.moret@gmail.com.

corresponding_authors.name: Céline S Moret
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery and Traumatology, Kantonsspital Baselland, CH-4101, Bruderholz, Switzerland. celines.moret@gmail.com.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提供了Zweymüller柄早期无菌性松动的临床证据，但未进行力学建模或应力遮挡量化。
why_not_core: This paper reports clinical outcomes and BMD changes, but does not include finite element analysis, stress shielding quantification, micromotion modeling, or patient-specific FE boundary conditions.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究减少氧化铝颗粒的柄表面处理是否能改善骨整合和减少松动。
summary_zh.method: 前瞻性随机对照试验，比较标准柄和新技术柄，随访2年并测量BMD和临床评分。
summary_zh.result: 新技术柄在50个月内无菌性松动失败率达41%，显著差于标准柄。
summary_zh.validation: 临床随机对照试验，含DEXA和影像学评估。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether an alumina-reduced stem surface improves osseointegration and reduces aseptic loosening compared to standard stems.
summary_en.method: A prospective double-blind randomized trial comparing standard and experimental stems, with BMD measurements by DEXA and clinical follow-up at 12 and 24 months.
summary_en.result: The experimental stems exhibited a catastrophic 41% revision rate due to early aseptic loosening within 50 months, with poorer radiographic and clinical outcomes.
summary_en.validation: Clinical RCT with DEXA, radiographic, and outcome score validations.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Shizuoka University, 3-5-1, Johoku, Naka-ku, Hamamatsu, 432-8561, Japan. Electronic address: fujii.tomoyuki@shizuoka.ac.jp.

summary_zh.method: 采用空间 holder 技术制备单向钛纤维增强多孔钛，孔隙率40%-58%，纤维体积分数3%-33%。

title: Quantifying the immediate post-implantation strain field of cadaveric tibiae implanted with cementless tibial trays: A time-elapsed micro-CT and digital volume correlation analysis during stair descent.
venue: Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials
first_author_affiliation: Medical Device Research Institute, College of Science and Engineering, Flinders University, Adelaide, South Australia, Australia.

corresponding_authors.name: Egon Perilli
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Medical Device Research Institute, College of Science and Engineering, Flinders University, Adelaide, South Australia, Australia. Electronic address: egon.perilli@flinders.edu.au.

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究胫骨托植入后的应变场，方法与髋关节假体应力遮挡研究高度相关，但对象为胫骨而非股骨。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on tibial trays, not femoral stems, and does not quantify stress shielding or micromotion in the proximal femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 量化胫骨托植入后内部应变分布，理解骨-植入物力学相互作用。
summary_zh.method: 对5具尸体胫骨施加模拟下楼梯的阶梯载荷，结合显微CT与数字体积相关分析。
summary_zh.result: 后部区域应变最高，残余应变局限于界面3.14毫米内，超过屈服应变。
summary_zh.validation: 尸体实验验证，与临床初始迁移数据对比。

summary_en.motivation: To quantify the internal strain field of cadaveric tibiae immediately after cementless tibial tray implantation under stair descent loading.
summary_en.method: Five cadaveric tibiae implanted with a cementless titanium tray were subjected to a five-step stair descent loading sequence (0-2.5 BW) with concurrent time-elapsed micro-CT imaging and digital volume correlation.
summary_en.result: The highest compressive strains occurred directly under the posterior tray region and dissipated with distance; residual strains were confined within 3.14 mm of the interface and exceeded yield strain.
summary_en.validation: Ex vivo cadaveric experiment with micro-CT and DVC, compared qualitatively to clinical migration data.

title: Epsilon-Greedy Thompson Sampling to Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种改进贝叶斯优化中探索-利用平衡的方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or biomechanics/implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升贝叶斯优化中汤普森采样的利用能力
summary_zh.method: 引入ε-贪婪策略在通用TS和样本平均TS之间随机切换
summary_zh.result: ε-贪婪TS在基准函数和悬臂梁反问题中表现更鲁棒
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个基准函数和一个钢悬臂梁反问题验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve the exploitation capability of Thompson sampling in Bayesian optimization for simulation-based engineering problems.
summary_en.method: Incorporate the ε-greedy policy to randomly switch between generic Thompson sampling and sample-average Thompson sampling.
summary_en.result: The ε-greedy Thompson sampling with appropriate ε is more robust than its two extremes, matching or outperforming the better of them.
summary_en.validation: Validated on two benchmark functions and an inverse problem of a steel cantilever beam.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Locomotive and Rolling Stock Engineering, Dalian Jiaotong University, Dalian 116028, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了选择性激光熔化制备的功能梯度TPMS结构的能量吸收性能，与生物医学植入物中的应力屏蔽和刚度匹配设计有一定关联，但未涉及生物医学背景。
why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding or stiffness matching in the context of biomedical implants, nor does it include fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究功能梯度TPMS结构不同填充形式和方向梯度对能量吸收的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过选择性激光熔化制备多种形式的功能梯度Gyroid和Diamond TPMS结构，并进行压缩实验和数值模拟。
summary_zh.result: 片状Diamond TPMS结构沿压缩方向梯度设计可降低初始峰值力32%，提升能量吸收能力。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩实验验证了不同填充形式和方向梯度对变形和能量吸收的影响。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of filling forms and directional gradients on the energy absorption of functionally graded triply periodic minimal surface structures.
summary_en.method: Functionally graded Gyroid and Diamond TPMS cellular structures with multiple forms were designed, fabricated via selective laser melting, and characterized experimentally and numerically under compression.
summary_en.result: Functionally graded sheet Diamond TPMS structures along the compression direction showed a 32% reduction in initial peak force and improved energy absorption capacity.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through experimental compression tests and finite element simulations.

title: A Comparison of the Structure and Selected Mechanical Properties of Cr/Co Alloys Obtained by Casting and Selective Laser Melting

why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, stiffness matching, or osseointegration; it focuses on solid bars of CoCr alloy.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较铸造与SLM制备的CoCr合金组织与力学性能，特别是疲劳强度
summary_zh.method: 制备铸造与SLM试样，进行硬度、冲击、拉伸、弯曲及疲劳测试，并用SEM分析断口
summary_zh.result: SLM试样硬度及抗拉强度更高，铸造试样疲劳强度略高，SLM组织更细密

summary_en.motivation: To compare the microstructure and selected mechanical properties, especially fatigue strength, of Cr/Co alloys fabricated by casting and selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Twenty Cr/Co alloy bars were produced by casting or SLM; samples were subjected to hardness, impact, tensile, bending, and fatigue tests, with fracture surfaces analyzed by SEM.
summary_en.result: SLM samples exhibited higher hardness and tensile strength, while cast samples showed slightly higher fatigue strength; SLM microstructure was finer and more uniform.
summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing and fractography were used to validate the findings.

title: Efficiently Computable Safety Bounds for Gaussian Processes in Active Learning
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过高斯过程提供可证明的安全边界，减少主动学习中的采样成本，可迁移至植入物设计中的约束优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or multi-objective constrained optimization with UQ.

summary_zh.motivation: 主动学习中安全约束导致高计算成本，需高效评估安全边界。
summary_zh.method: 基于自适应采样的后验GP上确界中位数，提供可证明的安全边界。
summary_zh.result: 显著减少高安全概率估计所需样本数，保持精度和探索速度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过仿真和真实发动机案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Active learning under safety constraints requires efficient evaluation of high quantiles, which is computationally expensive with Monte Carlo sampling.
summary_en.method: The method provides provable safety bounds using the adaptively sampled median of the supremum of the posterior Gaussian Process.
summary_en.result: It significantly reduces the number of samples needed for high safety probability estimation without sacrificing accuracy or exploration speed.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through extensive simulations and a real-world engine example.

title: Towards a Digital Twin Framework in Additive Manufacturing: Machine Learning and Bayesian Optimization for Time Series Process Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了用于增材制造的数字孪生框架，结合LSTM和贝叶斯优化进行实时过程控制，其方法可迁移至生物打印中的过程优化和质量控制。
why_not_core: This paper does not involve bioprinting, lacks experimental validation on biological materials, and does not address cell viability or tissue-specific requirements.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决DED增材制造中热积累导致材料性能不一致的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出数字孪生框架，使用LSTM-Bayesian代理模型预测温度，结合贝叶斯优化动态调整激光功率
summary_zh.result: 实现了实时温度预测和工艺参数优化，有望提升零件性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值模拟验证预测和优化效果

summary_en.motivation: To address heat accumulation and material inconsistency in laser-directed energy deposition additive manufacturing.
summary_en.method: A digital twin framework integrating LSTM-based surrogate model with Bayesian inference for temperature prediction and Bayesian Optimization for time series process optimization (BOTSPO) to dynamically adjust laser power profiles.
summary_en.result: The framework enables real-time temperature prediction and optimal process parameter identification, potentially improving part quality.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation case studies demonstrating predictive accuracy and optimization effectiveness.

title: Enhanced Bayesian Optimization via Preferential Modeling of Abstract Properties
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合专家偏好的贝叶斯优化框架，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomechanics or implant design context, no uncertainty quantification beyond point predictions.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化从零学习，未利用专家对抽象属性的偏好。
summary_zh.method: 提出人机协作贝叶斯框架，将专家对未测量抽象属性的偏好融入代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 在合成函数和真实数据集上优于基线方法。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试和真实数据集验证。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization learns from scratch and does not leverage expert preferences about abstract properties.
summary_en.method: A human-AI collaborative Bayesian framework incorporates expert preferences on unmeasured abstract properties into surrogate modeling.
summary_en.result: The method outperforms baselines on synthetic functions and real-world datasets.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks and real-world dataset experiments.

title: Neural Operators with Localized Integral and Differential Kernels
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的局部化神经算子方法可提高FEA替代模型的精度，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计应用。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no FEA validation on structural problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 全局傅里叶卷积导致过平滑，无法捕捉局部细节。
summary_zh.method: 通过学习微分算子和局部支撑积分算子改进FNO。
summary_zh.result: 在2D湍流和球面浅水方程上相对L2误差降低34-72%。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试（Navier-Stokes和浅水方程）。

summary_en.motivation: Global Fourier convolutions in neural operators cause over-smoothing and fail to capture local features.
summary_en.method: Proposes learning differential operators and locally supported integral operators via stencil-inspired CNN scaling and discrete-continuous convolutions.
summary_en.result: Reduces relative L2 error by 34-72% on turbulent 2D Navier-Stokes and spherical shallow water equations.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard PDE test cases.

title: Preparation and Performance Study of Titanium‐Based Nanocomposites in Selective Laser Melting: Microstructure Regulation and Optimization of Mechanical Properties

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Jiangsu Key Laboratory of Advanced Food Manufacturing Equipment & Technology School of Mechanical Engineering Jiangnan University  Wuxi 214122 P. R. China

summary_zh.motivation: 通过纳米增强相改善SLM钛合金的微观结构和力学性能

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the microstructure and mechanical properties of titanium alloys fabricated by selective laser melting through incorporation of nanoreinforcements.
summary_en.method: Graphene oxide (0.5 wt%) and nanoscale molybdenum (7.0%) were added to Ti-6Al-4V powder and processed by selective laser melting.

title: Information-Theoretic Safe Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种信息论安全贝叶斯优化方法，可应用于植入物设计中的约束优化问题，但未涉及有限元仿真或生物力学场景。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, biomechanics, or implant design; it focuses on safe Bayesian optimization for general unknown functions with safety constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有安全贝叶斯优化方法依赖离散化且需额外超参数，限制了连续域应用。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于信息论的安全探索准则，结合GP后验与贝叶斯优化采集函数。
summary_zh.result: 方法在连续域自然适用，无需额外超参数，且保证安全约束高概率满足。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证数据效率和可扩展性。

summary_en.motivation: Current safe Bayesian optimization methods rely on domain discretization and introduce critical hyperparameters, limiting their applicability to continuous domains.
summary_en.method: We propose an information-theoretic safe exploration criterion that leverages the GP posterior to identify the most informative safe parameters, combined with a standard Bayesian optimization acquisition function.
summary_en.result: The method naturally handles continuous domains without additional hyperparameters, guarantees safety with high probability, and learns the safe optimum to arbitrary precision.
summary_en.validation: Empirical evaluations on numerical benchmarks demonstrate improved data efficiency and scalability.

title: Generative Modelling with Tensor Train approximations of Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于张量列格式求解HJB方程的无采样生成建模方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的高维不确定性量化问题。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no implant mechanics, and no constraint handling demonstrated.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高维概率密度采样中的维数灾难问题
summary_zh.method: 用张量列格式压缩多项式离散HJB方程，直接时间积分求解
summary_zh.result: 在20维非线性采样任务上验证了方法的有效性
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the curse of dimensionality in sampling from high-dimensional probability densities for uncertainty quantification and generative modelling.
summary_en.method: Proposes a direct time integration of the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation using compressed polynomials in the Tensor Train format for spatial discretization.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates sample-free, normalization-agnostic sampling on a 20-dimensional nonlinear task with adaptive time-step, rank, and degree.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark on a synthetic nonlinear sampling problem.

title: Uncertainty quantification in the Henry problem using the multilevel Monte Carlo method
relevance_to_user: 该论文将多层级蒙特卡洛方法应用于地下水流动问题的不确定性量化，其方法可迁移至植入物力学仿真中的高效不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or constraint handling in optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低密度驱动流问题中不确定性量化的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 采用多层级蒙特卡洛方法，在空间和时间多层级网格上求解随机Henry问题
summary_zh.result: MLMC方法显著降低了计算和存储成本，并行化进一步加速
summary_zh.validation: 通过经典Henry盐侵入问题的数值模拟验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of uncertainty quantification in density-driven flow problems, which are nonlinear and time-consuming.
summary_en.method: Apply the multilevel Monte Carlo method to solve the stochastic Henry problem on multi-level spatial and temporal meshes, with parallelization in both physical and stochastic spaces.
summary_en.result: The MLMC method significantly reduces overall computational and storage costs compared to standard Monte Carlo, and parallelization further accelerates the process.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical simulation of the classical Henry saltwater intrusion problem.

title: Grouped approximate control variate estimators
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的分组近似控制变量方法可用于多保真度不确定性量化，可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的代理模型构建。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or implant/biomechanics design, and lacks experimental validation in biomedical contexts.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高多保真度不确定性量化中方差缩减的效率。
summary_zh.method: 提出分组近似控制变量估计器，允许任意加权样本组合。
summary_zh.result: 非独立分组可带来比独立分组更好的方差缩减。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证方差缩减效果。

summary_en.motivation: To improve variance reduction in multifidelity uncertainty quantification by generalizing approximate control variate estimators.
summary_en.method: A grouped approximate control variate estimator is proposed that allows arbitrary weighted sample combinations, unifying with ML-BLUE.
summary_en.result: Non-independent groups can achieve better variance reduction than independent groups used in ML-BLUE.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks demonstrate the variance reduction performance of the proposed estimator.

key_terms.zh: 多保真度不确定性量化

title: Global Safe Sequential Learning via Efficient Knowledge Transfer
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过迁移学习加速安全序列学习，可应用于植入物设计中的约束优化问题。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomechanics context, no implant design application.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有安全学习方法局限于局部探索，无法发现与初始数据不连通的全局安全区域。
summary_zh.method: 提出安全迁移序列学习，利用源任务离线数据指导目标任务探索，并给出理论分析。
summary_zh.result: 相比单任务方法，该方法在更低数据消耗下实现全局探索，覆盖多个不连通安全区域。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准测试上验证，与最先进方法比较计算效率和探索能力。

summary_en.motivation: Existing safe learning methods are limited to local exploration around initial seed data and cannot discover safe regions disconnected from the seed set.
summary_en.method: This paper proposes safe transfer sequential learning that leverages abundant offline data from a related source task to guide exploration in the target task, with a computationally efficient approximation.
summary_en.result: The method achieves global exploration across multiple disjoint safe regions with lower data consumption compared to state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining comparable computational efficiency.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks, comparing exploration capability and runtime against baseline methods.

title: Towards accelerating physical discovery via non-interactive and interactive multi-fidelity Bayesian Optimization: Current challenges and future opportunities
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多保真贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题，但未涉及生物力学或约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification beyond point predictions, or implant/biomechanics design applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速昂贵仿真或实验中的参数空间探索
summary_zh.method: 提出交互式多保真贝叶斯优化框架，融合数据驱动、物理驱动和人在回路
summary_zh.result: 在Ising模型上验证了物理知识注入和实时人类决策可改善探索效率
summary_zh.validation: 基于Ising模型的多保真仿真数据验证

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate exploration of expensive multidimensional parameter spaces in computational and experimental material discovery.
summary_en.method: Proposes interactive multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization (iMFBO) that integrates data-driven, physics-driven, and human-in-the-loop strategies.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates that physics knowledge injection and real-time human decisions improve exploration efficiency on Ising model simulations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on multi-fidelity simulation data from an Ising model with spin-spin interactions and lattice size fidelities.

title: Inverse design of spinodoid structures using Bayesian optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用贝叶斯优化进行逆设计，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no implant mechanics or constraints handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统逆设计方法需要大量数据，难以应用于非弹性场景。
summary_zh.method: 采用贝叶斯优化，从小初始数据集迭代生成数据，直至找到目标结构。
summary_zh.result: 成功设计了具有目标弹性性能的spinodoid结构。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值模拟生成数据验证框架有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional inverse design methods require large datasets, hindering application to inelasticity problems.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian optimization framework is proposed that iteratively augments a small initial dataset with in silico data until a structure with desired properties is found.
summary_en.result: The framework successfully designs spinodoid structures with targeted elastic properties.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via in silico generation of data for the inverse design task.

title: Bayesian Neural Networks with Domain Knowledge Priors
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种将领域知识（如物理规则）整合到贝叶斯神经网络先验中的框架，可用于代理建模中的不确定性量化，但未直接应用于有限元或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or implant biomechanics; it only demonstrates on simple physics examples and healthcare data without mechanical or implant-specific constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯神经网络先验难以整合领域知识，导致预测性能受限。
summary_zh.method: 提出通过变分推断将任意损失函数表示的领域知识编码为网络权重的先验分布。
summary_zh.result: 该方法在公平性、物理规则和医疗知识等任务上优于标准先验。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个基准数据集上对比预测性能与不确定性校准。

summary_en.motivation: Standard priors in Bayesian neural networks fail to incorporate diverse domain knowledge, limiting predictive performance and uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: A variational inference framework that encodes domain knowledge (represented as a loss function) into a prior over network weights, enabling efficient posterior inference.
summary_en.result: The proposed domain knowledge priors outperform isotropic Gaussian and Gaussian process priors on fairness, physics, and healthcare tasks.
summary_en.validation: Empirical evaluation on benchmark datasets with comparisons to standard priors and ablation studies.

title: Manufacturability and deformation studies on a novel metallic lattice structure fabricated by Selective Laser Melting
first_author_affiliation: Department of Production Engineering, National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli, 620 015, Tamil Nadu, India

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Production Engineering, National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli, 620 015, Tamil Nadu, India

why_not_core: The paper does not address biomedical applications, stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究新型金属晶格结构的可制造性和变形行为
summary_zh.method: 采用激光选区熔化制备样品并进行力学测试
summary_zh.result: 揭示了晶格结构的变形机制和制造缺陷
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学实验验证了结构性能

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the manufacturability and deformation behavior of a novel metallic lattice structure fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated via selective laser melting and subjected to mechanical testing to assess their deformation response.
summary_en.result: The study characterized the deformation mechanisms and manufacturing defects of the lattice structure.
summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing was employed to validate the structural performance.

title: Machine Learning approaches for the design of biomechanically compatible bone tissue engineering scaffolds
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
first_author_affiliation: Dipartimento di Informatica, Università degli Studi di Milano, Milan, Italy

corresponding_authors.name: Pasquale Vena
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Chemistry, Materials and Chemical Engineering “Giulio Natta”, Laboratory of Biological Structure Mechanics (LaBS) - Politecnico di Milano, Piazza Leonardo da Vinci 32, 20133, Milano, Italy

relevance_to_user: 该方法利用机器学习设计TPMS支架，可用于匹配骨组织力学性能，但缺乏植入物级别的应力遮挡分析和增材制造实验验证。
why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (only FEA), no fatigue analysis, no surface roughness or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: TPMS解析公式无法直接关联输入参数与力学性能，需ML辅助设计。
summary_zh.method: 建立上千个TPMS支架数据集，训练线性和非线性ML模型预测输入参数。
summary_zh.result: 结合用户选择和非线性ML模型的中位误差低于3%，决定系数高于0.89。
summary_zh.validation: 通过有限元模拟和图像分析对支架进行表征。

summary_en.motivation: The lack of direct correlation between analytical input parameters and mechanical properties of TPMS scaffolds motivates ML-based design.
summary_en.method: A dataset of over 1000 TPMS scaffolds was created and three ML models (linear and nonlinear) were trained to predict input parameters from morphological and mechanical features.
summary_en.result: The hybrid feature selection combined with a nonlinear ML model achieved a median error below 3% and determination coefficient above 0.89 for all selected features.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed using finite element modeling and image analysis on a real trabecular-like hydroxyapatite scaffold.

title: Uncertainty Quantification of Graph Convolution Neural Network Models of Evolving Processes
relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于图卷积神经网络在时空过程建模中的不确定性量化方法，其方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性评估。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant design, or biomechanics; it focuses on general spatial-temporal process modeling without constraint handling or optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经网络模型在科学机器学习中缺乏可靠的不确定性量化方法。
summary_zh.method: 比较哈密顿蒙特卡洛和斯坦变分梯度下降在图卷积网络中的不确定性量化效果。
summary_zh.result: 斯坦变分推断在复杂模型中与蒙特卡洛方法不确定性分布相似，但方差更大。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证不确定性量化方法的性能。

summary_en.motivation: Neural network models for scientific machine learning lack reliable uncertainty quantification methods for complex spatial-temporal processes.
summary_en.method: Compare Hamiltonian Monte Carlo and Stein variational gradient descent (including projected variant) for parametric uncertainty quantification in graph convolutional neural networks with recurrent and neural ODE architectures.
summary_en.result: Stein variational inference yields similar uncertainty profiles to Hamiltonian Monte Carlo but with generally larger variance, and projected Stein variational gradient descent reduces active weight space at the cost of prediction stability.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks of evolving spatial-temporal processes.

title: Gauss-Newton Natural Gradient Descent for Physics-Informed Computational Fluid Dynamics
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种用于物理信息神经网络的高斯-牛顿自然梯度下降优化方法，在计算流体动力学中实现了高精度，其优化策略可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on fluid dynamics (Navier-Stokes) rather than solid mechanics or implant biomechanics, and does not address uncertainty quantification or constraint handling in design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高物理信息神经网络求解纳维-斯托克斯方程的精度和效率。
summary_zh.method: 提出函数空间中的高斯-牛顿法，离散化后得到自然梯度下降法。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准问题上达到接近单精度的相对L2范数精度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准问题验证，与参数空间高斯-牛顿法一致。

summary_en.motivation: To achieve high accuracy in solving Navier-Stokes equations using physics-informed neural networks by improving optimization efficiency.
summary_en.method: Proposes Gauss-Newton's method in function space, which upon discretization yields a natural gradient descent method that mimics function space dynamics.
summary_en.result: Achieves close to single-precision accuracy in relative L2 norm on benchmark problems, marking the first PINN solution of Navier-Stokes to this degree of accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks and shown to agree with Gauss-Newton in parameter space under suitable integral discretization.

title: Enhancement of fatigue properties of selective laser melting fabricated TC4 alloy by multiple shot peening treatments

why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, osseointegration, or any biomedical context; it focuses solely on post-processing to enhance fatigue of bulk material.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高选区激光熔化TC4合金的疲劳性能
summary_zh.method: 采用多次喷丸处理
summary_zh.result: 多次喷丸显著提高了疲劳寿命
summary_zh.validation: 通过疲劳测试进行验证

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the fatigue properties of selective laser melted TC4 alloy through post-processing.
summary_en.method: Multiple shot peening treatments were applied to the as-built material.
summary_en.result: The fatigue life was significantly increased after multiple shot peening.
summary_en.validation: Fatigue testing was conducted to evaluate the improvement.

title: Bioactive gelatin-sheets as novel biopapers to support prevascularization organized by laser-assisted bioprinting for bone tissue engineering.

why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI into any bioprinting workflow stage; it focuses on material optimization and biological characterization without machine learning or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发适合激光辅助生物打印的支撑性生物纸以促进骨组织工程中的预血管化。
summary_zh.method: 制备含生物活性玻璃的明胶片，通过冷冻和交联参数优化，并用多标准分析筛选最佳配方。
summary_zh.result: 筛选出的生物纸具有高孔隙率、良好力学性能和生物活性，支持内皮细胞形成微血管网络。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外单培养和共培养实验验证细胞相容性、成骨和血管生成能力。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a novel biopaper that mechanically and biologically supports prevascularization organized by laser-assisted bioprinting for bone tissue engineering.
summary_en.method: Gelatin-based sheets incorporating bioactive glasses were fabricated with varying freezing methods and crosslinking parameters, and a rank scoring method was used to select the optimal formulation.
summary_en.result: The selected biopaper exhibited high porosity, suitable mechanical properties, and supported microvascular network formation by human umbilical vein endothelial cells.
summary_en.validation: In vitro monoculture and coculture assays confirmed cytocompatibility, osteogenesis, and vasculogenesis, along with in vivo degradability assessment.

title: Physics-Informed Neural Network Policy Iteration: Algorithms, Convergence, and Verification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于PINN的策略迭代算法可用于解决高维非线性最优控制问题，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的约束优化和不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant design, lacks biomedical context, and does not handle multi-objective constraints or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高维非线性最优控制问题的求解困难。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于PINN的策略迭代算法，包括ELM和PINN两种变体。
summary_zh.result: 算法在精度和效率上显著优于传统Galerkin方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证收敛性和控制器的稳定性。

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of solving high-dimensional nonlinear optimal control problems efficiently.
summary_en.method: Proposes two variants of model-based policy iteration algorithms using neural approximations (ELM and PINN) to solve linear PDEs iteratively.
summary_en.result: Both algorithms outperform traditional Galerkin methods significantly in accuracy and efficiency.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks demonstrate convergence and formal verification confirms controller stability.

title: Exact Enforcement of Temporal Continuity in Sequential Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的硬约束时序连续方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的瞬态问题求解，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, constraint handling in optimization, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准PINN难以准确预测时间依赖问题的动态行为。
summary_zh.method: 提出硬约束时序PINN，通过解的形式精确强制时间连续性。
summary_zh.result: 在多个线性和非线性PDE基准上收敛性和精度优于传统PINN。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试，包括对流、Allen-Cahn、KdV、波动和混沌Jerky动力学方程。

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINNs struggle to accurately predict the dynamic behavior of time-dependent problems due to temporal continuity errors.
summary_en.method: A hard-constrained sequential PINN (HCS-PINN) is introduced that exactly enforces continuity between successive time segments via a solution ansatz, eliminating temporal continuity loss terms.
summary_en.result: The proposed method demonstrates superior convergence and accuracy over traditional PINNs and soft-constrained counterparts on multiple linear and nonlinear PDE benchmarks, including chaotic dynamics.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on first-order (advection, Allen-Cahn, KdV), second-order (wave), and third-order (Jerky dynamics) time-dependent PDEs.

title: Parametric Learning of Time-Advancement Operators for Unstable Flame Evolution
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用FNO和CNN学习参数化PDE的时间推进算子，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, no biomedical or implant mechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速参数化偏微分方程的时间推进模拟，降低计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 基于FNO和CNN学习参数依赖的PDE时间推进算子。
summary_zh.result: 两种方法均能准确预测短期解和长期统计特性。
summary_zh.validation: 在一维PDE和真实火焰面数据上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate parametric PDE time-marching simulations by learning unified time-advancement operators that reduce computational cost.
summary_en.method: Developed parametric learning methods using Fourier Neural Operator and Convolutional Neural Network to map PDE parameters to solution time-advancement operators.
summary_en.result: Both FNO and CNN accurately predicted short-term solutions and captured long-term statistics under varying parameters.
summary_en.validation: Validated on one-dimensional PDE benchmarks and realistic flame front data from direct numerical simulations of Navier-Stokes equations.

title: Uncertainty Quantification via Stable Distribution Propagation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种通过神经网络传播稳定分布以量化不确定性的方法，可迁移至FEA代理模型中的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or biomechanical implant design, and lacks validation on engineering simulation tasks.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经网络不确定性传播方法效率低或精度不足，需更优方案。
summary_zh.method: 基于局部线性化近似，实现稳定分布（高斯、柯西）通过ReLU网络的传播。
summary_zh.result: 在置信区间校准和分布外检测上优于矩匹配等方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准分类数据集上验证校准误差和分布外检测性能。

summary_en.motivation: Efficient and accurate propagation of input uncertainties through neural networks remains challenging, especially for heavy-tailed distributions.
summary_en.method: A local linearization approach is proposed to propagate stable distributions (Gaussian and Cauchy) through ReLU networks, with theoretical optimality in total variation distance.
summary_en.result: The method yields better calibrated confidence intervals and improved out-of-distribution detection compared to moment matching and other baselines.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation on image classification datasets using expected calibration error and AUROC for OOD detection.

title: Transition Constrained Bayesian Optimization via Markov Decision Processes
relevance_to_user: 该方法将贝叶斯优化扩展到具有过渡约束的序列决策问题，可迁移到植入物设计中的多步优化场景。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification for expensive simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统贝叶斯优化假设可任意查询，但实际物理问题存在过渡约束。
summary_zh.method: 将贝叶斯优化扩展为马尔可夫决策过程，用强化学习求解线性化效用函数得到策略。
summary_zh.result: 所得策略可规划整个优化路径，处理历史依赖和非马尔可夫性。
summary_zh.validation: 在化学反应器优化、路径规划等仿真案例上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Classical Bayesian optimization assumes arbitrary querying, but real-world problems impose transition constraints that require planning.
summary_en.method: This work extends Bayesian optimization to a Markov decision process framework, solving a linearized utility function via reinforcement learning to obtain a policy that plans over the entire horizon.
summary_en.result: The resulting policy can be history-dependent and non-Markovian, enabling optimization under transition constraints.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on synthetic examples and applications including chemical reactor optimization and informative path planning.

title: Transductive Active Learning: Theory and Applications
relevance_to_user: 该论文的主动学习方法可迁移至FEA代理模型的采样效率优化，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or constraint handling in design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决实际中采样受限但预测目标在可访问区域外的主动学习问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于不确定性最小化的自适应采样决策规则族。
summary_zh.result: 理论上证明规则一致收敛到最小不确定性，并在主动微调和安全贝叶斯优化中取得最优性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在神经网络微调和安全贝叶斯优化基准上验证采样效率。

summary_en.motivation: To generalize active learning to settings where sampling is restricted to an accessible region but prediction targets may lie outside it.
summary_en.method: A family of decision rules that adaptively sample to minimize uncertainty about prediction targets is analyzed.
summary_en.result: The rules are shown to converge uniformly to the smallest possible uncertainty, achieving state-of-the-art sample efficiency in active fine-tuning and safe Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.validation: Validated on benchmarks for active fine-tuning of large neural networks and safe Bayesian optimization.

title: RBF-PINN: Non-Fourier Positional Embedding in Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种改进PINN位置编码的方法，可提高求解PDE的精度，对构建FEA替代模型有潜在价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address multi-objective optimization, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINN中傅里叶位置编码存在局限性，需改进。
summary_zh.method: 提出使用径向基函数作为位置编码，替代傅里叶特征映射。
summary_zh.result: 在多个正反问题案例中验证了方法的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: Fourier-based feature mapping in PINNs has limitations that hinder performance in certain scenarios.
summary_en.method: This work proposes using conditionally positive definite radial basis functions as positional embeddings to replace Fourier features.
summary_en.result: The proposed RBF-PINN demonstrates improved accuracy across various forward and inverse PDE problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmark problems including Poisson, Helmholtz, and Burgers' equations.

title: Learning time-dependent PDE via graph neural networks and deep operator network for robust accuracy on irregular grids
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的GraphDeepONet方法可处理不规则网格上的时变PDE，对生物力学有限元代理模型具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not include any biomedical or implant mechanics application, no FEA validation, and no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有GNN代理模型在不规则网格上精度不足，且难以处理时变PDE。
summary_zh.method: 提出GraphDeepONet，结合GNN与DeepONet实现自回归时域外推。
summary_zh.result: 在不规则网格上保持鲁棒精度，并支持时间外推。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个数值基准PDE上验证，并与现有GNN模型对比。

summary_en.motivation: Existing GNN-based surrogate models suffer from accuracy degradation on irregular grids and lack temporal extrapolation for time-dependent PDEs.
summary_en.method: GraphDeepONet integrates graph neural networks with DeepONet in an autoregressive framework to enable operator learning on arbitrary grids with temporal extrapolation.
summary_en.result: The model achieves robust accuracy on irregular grids and outperforms existing GNN-based PDE solvers, with theoretical guarantees for universal approximation.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard time-dependent PDE benchmarks (e.g., Burgers' equation, advection-diffusion) demonstrate accuracy and grid flexibility.

title: Deep learning enhanced cost-aware multi-fidelity uncertainty quantification of a computational model for radiotherapy
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的深度学习增强多保真度不确定性量化方法可迁移至植入物力学仿真中的高效UQ，但未涉及接触力学或结构优化。
why_not_core: No implant mechanics, no contact mechanics, no structural optimization, and the application domain is radiotherapy rather than biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低多尺度微循环计算模型不确定性量化的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 结合全阶模型与深度学习增强降阶模型的多保真度蒙特卡洛方法
summary_zh.result: 相比经典蒙特卡洛方法显著加速并降低计算成本
summary_zh.validation: 通过氧传输和放疗结果仿真案例验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of forward uncertainty quantification for a multiscale microcirculation model.
summary_en.method: A deep learning enhanced multi-fidelity Monte Carlo method integrating a full-order model with a POD-based reduced order model corrected by mesh-informed neural networks.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves remarkable speed-ups and substantial computational cost reduction compared to classical Monte Carlo.
summary_en.validation: Validated on simulation cases of oxygen transfer and radiotherapy outcomes.

title: Hyper-differential sensitivity analysis with respect to model discrepancy: Posterior Optimal Solution Sampling
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种利用有限高保真仿真更新低保真优化解并量化不确定性的框架，可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的代理模型优化。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant design problems, and does not address contact mechanics or stress shielding.

summary_zh.motivation: 高保真模型优化计算昂贵，需利用低保真模型与有限高保真数据更新解。
summary_zh.method: 通过贝叶斯反问题估计模型差异，并传播后验分布至最优性灵敏度算子。
summary_zh.result: 在三个算例中展示了算法有效更新最优解并量化不确定性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值算例验证，包括不同低保真与高保真模型差异类型。

summary_en.motivation: Optimization with high-fidelity models is computationally prohibitive, motivating the use of low-fidelity models updated with limited high-fidelity simulations.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian inverse problem is formulated to estimate model discrepancy, and the posterior distribution is propagated through a post-optimality sensitivity operator to update the low-fidelity optimal solution.
summary_en.result: The algorithm is demonstrated on three examples, showing effective solution updates and uncertainty quantification under various discrepancy types.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via simulation cases with synthetic low- and high-fidelity model pairs.

title: Conformal Predictive Programming for Chance Constrained Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的共形预测规划框架可处理机会约束优化问题，其量化约束满足保证方法可迁移至生物力学设计中的不确定性优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or implant biomechanics design; it focuses on general chance-constrained optimization without physical simulation or biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决机会约束优化中随机变量约束的量化保证问题
summary_zh.method: 利用共形预测的分位数引理将机会约束转化为确定性分位数重构
summary_zh.result: 提出多种求解策略并验证了约束满足的先验和后验保证
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值案例比较不同求解方法并展示优势

summary_en.motivation: To provide a framework for chance-constrained optimization with a priori and a posteriori guarantees on constraint satisfaction.
summary_en.method: The conformal predictive programming (CPP) framework transforms chance constraints into deterministic quantile reformulations using the quantile lemma from conformal prediction.
summary_en.result: CPP supports multiple conformal prediction variants and offers tractable solution strategies including mixed-integer programming, bilevel optimization, and sampling-and-discarding.
summary_en.validation: Numerical case studies demonstrate the validity of CPP approaches and compare their performance against the scenario approach.

title: Boundary Exploration for Bayesian Optimization With Unknown Physical Constraints
relevance_to_user: 该方法处理未知物理约束下的贝叶斯优化，可迁移至植入物设计中的约束优化问题。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate, no biomechanics context, no uncertainty quantification beyond ensemble variance.

summary_zh.motivation: 未知物理约束下最优解常在可行域边界，需高效探索边界。
summary_zh.method: 提出BE-CBO，用神经网络集成学习约束边界，结合贝叶斯优化。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实基准上优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Optimal solutions under unknown physical constraints often lie on the feasibility boundary, requiring efficient boundary exploration.
summary_en.method: Proposes BE-CBO, which learns constraint boundaries using an ensemble of neural networks and integrates them into Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art methods on synthetic and real-world benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic and real-world problems.

title: Self-Calibrating Conformal Prediction
relevance_to_user: 该方法提供了结合校准和共形预测的框架，可迁移到代理模型的不确定性量化中。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, expensive simulation sampling, or biomechanical design constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 结合点预测和区间预测，提供可靠的不确定性量化。
summary_zh.method: 扩展Venn-Abers校准到回归，并与共形预测结合。
summary_zh.result: 方法在真实数据上提高了区间效率，可作为特征条件有效性的实用替代。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个真实数据集上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To combine calibrated point predictions with valid prediction intervals for reliable uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: Extends Venn-Abers calibration from binary classification to regression and integrates it with conformal prediction.
summary_en.result: The method improves interval efficiency on real-world data and offers a practical alternative to feature-conditional validity.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical experiments on multiple real-world datasets.

title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Hard Linear Equality Constraints
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种通过KKT条件投影层严格满足线性等式约束的PINN方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中处理约束问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address uncertainty quantification, multi-objective optimization, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on chemical engineering systems with linear equality constraints only.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINN无法严格满足物理约束，影响预测精度。
summary_zh.method: 提出KKT-hPINN，通过KKT条件推导投影层，将线性等式约束硬编码到网络输出。
summary_zh.result: 在三个化工过程模型上，该方法相比标准PINN提高了预测精度。
summary_zh.validation: 在CSTR、萃取精馏和化工厂的Aspen模型上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINNs cannot strictly enforce physical constraints, leading to reduced prediction accuracy in surrogate modeling.
summary_en.method: KKT-hPINN incorporates hard linear equality constraints via projection layers derived from KKT conditions, ensuring constraint satisfaction in neural network outputs.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves higher prediction accuracy than standard PINNs on Aspen models of a CSTR, extractive distillation, and a chemical plant.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical experiments on three chemical engineering simulation cases using Aspen models.

title: Generative Adversarial Model-Based Optimization via Source Critic Regularization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种通用的离线模型优化框架，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真替代建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not validate on FEA or biomechanics problems, lacks uncertainty quantification, and focuses on generative design tasks (e.g., protein design) rather than implant surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 离线优化中代理模型预测不准确，需要约束优化轨迹到可靠区域。
summary_zh.method: 提出自适应源批评正则化（aSCR）框架，动态调整约束强度。
summary_zh.result: 在多个离线生成设计任务上优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准离线优化基准任务上验证，未涉及FEA或生物力学案例。

summary_en.motivation: Offline model-based optimization suffers from inaccurate surrogate predictions, necessitating constraints to keep optimization within reliable regions.
summary_en.method: We propose an adaptive source critic regularization (aSCR) framework that dynamically adjusts the strength of the constraint to keep optimization trajectories in trustworthy surrogate regions.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms existing approaches on a suite of offline generative design tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard offline optimization benchmarks without FEA or biomechanics applications.

title: Energy-based PINNs for solving coupled field problems: concepts and application to the multi-objective optimal design of an induction heater
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了能量基PINN方法，可提高多物理场耦合问题的求解效率，对用户研究FEA替代模型具有方法迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and uses FEA data for training rather than solving expensive sampling problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高PINN求解多物理场耦合问题的计算效率，减少超参数。
summary_zh.method: 采用能量基PINN（ePINN）最小化变分能量，结合超网络实现几何参数到模型权重的映射。
summary_zh.result: 相比残差基PINN，ePINN计算效率更高，导数阶数更低，超参数更少。
summary_zh.validation: 通过感应加热石墨板的单目标和多目标优化设计案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve computational efficiency and reduce hyperparameter sensitivity of PINNs for solving coupled multiphysics problems.
summary_en.method: An energy-based PINN (ePINN) minimizes the variational energy of the steady thermal equation, while a hypernetwork maps inductor geometry parameters to network weights, and the magnetic problem is solved by a supervisedly trained DNN on FEA data.
summary_en.result: The ePINN approach outperforms standard residual-based PINN in computational efficiency, requiring lower-order derivatives and fewer hyperparameters.
summary_en.validation: Validated on single- and multi-objective optimal design of an induction heater for controlled heating of a graphite plate.

title: AI enhanced data assimilation and uncertainty quantification applied to Geological Carbon Storage
relevance_to_user: 该论文将代理模型与数据同化结合用于地质碳封存，其方法（FNO、T-UNet、不确定性量化）可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or any biomedical context; it focuses on geological carbon storage.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高地质碳封存模拟中数据同化的计算效率并保持高保真度。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于FNO和T-UNet代理模型的混合ESMDA和RML方法。
summary_zh.result: SH-RML方法在不确定性量化上优于传统ESMDA。
summary_zh.validation: 通过通道化油藏CO2注入模拟案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate data assimilation for geological carbon storage simulations while maintaining high-fidelity posterior states.
summary_en.method: Proposes surrogate-based hybrid ESMDA and RML methods using Fourier Neural Operators and Transformer UNet as surrogate models.
summary_en.result: The SH-RML method provides better uncertainty quantification than conventional ESMDA for the case study.
summary_en.validation: Validated on CO2 injection simulations in channelized reservoirs.

title: Surrogate Modeling and Control of Medical Digital Twins
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出用于医学数字孪生的替代建模与控制方法，可迁移至生物打印中的数字孪生与过程控制。
why_not_core: No experimental bioprinting validation, no integration into bioprinting workflow stages, and no autonomous decision-making demonstrated.

summary_zh.motivation: 医学数字孪生模型复杂，需简化以实现个性化干预。
summary_zh.method: 基于常微分方程推导替代模型，并应用最优控制方法。
summary_zh.result: 替代模型可有效计算干预措施，并映射回原始模型。
summary_zh.validation: 以基于智能体的模型为用例进行仿真验证。

summary_en.motivation: Medical digital twins are high-dimensional and stochastic, requiring surrogate models for practical optimal control of interventions.
summary_en.method: Surrogate models based on ordinary differential equations are derived from agent-based models, enabling the application of optimal control algorithms.
summary_en.result: The surrogate approach allows computation of effective interventions that can be lifted back to the original complex model.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation case studies on agent-based models in biomedicine.

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM多孔钽支架的力学性能与生物活性涂层，对骨植入物的应力匹配和骨整合有参考价值，但未涉及疲劳或应力遮挡分析。
why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding or implant stiffness matching, and lacks fatigue testing or explicit contact mechanics analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 修复大段骨缺损需要兼具力学适配与骨整合活性的多孔支架。
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备多孔钽支架，并通过水热法涂覆钙磷或镁掺杂钙磷涂层。
summary_zh.result: 涂层支架释放钙镁离子，体内外实验显示Mg-CaP组骨整合效果最佳。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体内动物实验和体外细胞实验验证生物相容性与成骨活性。

summary_en.motivation: Large bone defect repair requires porous scaffolds with both mechanical compatibility and osteogenic bioactivity.
summary_en.method: Porous tantalum scaffolds were fabricated by selective laser melting and coated with calcium phosphate or magnesium-doped calcium phosphate via hydrothermal method.
summary_en.result: Coated scaffolds released calcium and magnesium ions, with the Mg-CaP group showing superior osseointegration in vivo and in vitro.
summary_en.validation: Biocompatibility and osteogenesis were validated through in vivo animal experiments and in vitro cell assays.

title: Principled Preferential Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于偏好反馈的贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移到植入物设计中的多目标优化问题，但未涉及有限元仿真或生物力学约束。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification beyond preference feedback, or biomechanics/implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决仅有偏好反馈的黑箱函数优化问题
summary_zh.method: 基于似然比构建置信集，开发乐观算法
summary_zh.result: 首次给出偏好贝叶斯优化的信息论累积遗憾界
summary_zh.validation: 在GP采样、标准测试函数和热舒适优化上验证

summary_en.motivation: To optimize a black-box function using only pairwise preference feedback, which is common in human-in-the-loop settings.
summary_en.method: Constructs a confidence set for the black-box function via likelihood ratio and proposes an optimistic algorithm with efficient computation.
summary_en.result: Derives the first information-theoretic cumulative regret bound for preferential Bayesian optimization and demonstrates stable performance.
summary_en.validation: Validated on sampled Gaussian process instances, standard test functions, and a thermal comfort optimization problem.

title: Voronoi Candidates for Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效的贝叶斯优化候选点采样方法，可加速代理模型的优化过程，对植入物设计中的多目标优化和约束处理具有潜在应用价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化中采集函数的内部优化计算开销大，需高效候选点方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于Voronoi图边界的候选点采样策略，避免显式生成Voronoi图。
summary_zh.result: 在多维测试问题上，该方法在不损失精度下显著提升多起点连续搜索的执行时间。
summary_zh.validation: 通过高斯过程与期望改进的多个标准测试问题进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: The inner optimization of acquisition functions in Bayesian optimization is computationally expensive, motivating efficient candidate sampling.
summary_en.method: A candidate sampling method based on Voronoi tessellation boundaries is proposed, implemented without explicit tessellation generation.
summary_en.result: The proposed approach significantly reduces execution time of multi-start continuous search without loss of accuracy on benchmark problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks using Gaussian processes with expected improvement validate the efficiency and accuracy.

title: High-dimensional multidisciplinary design optimization for aircraft eco-design / Optimisation multi-disciplinaire en grande dimension pour l'éco-conception avion en avant-projet
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了针对高维、混合变量、约束优化问题的贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的代理模型优化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on aircraft eco-design and does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or biomedical FEA validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高维混合变量约束优化问题中EGO方法性能下降的难题
summary_zh.method: 采用偏最小二乘降维和适应离散变量的贝叶斯优化框架
summary_zh.result: 在飞机概念设计问题中减少了高维优化所需的模型评估次数
summary_zh.validation: 通过DRAGON混合飞机设计案例验证方法有效性

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the curse of dimensionality in EGO for constrained multidisciplinary optimization with mixed integer variables.
summary_en.method: Proposes dimensionality reduction via partial least squares and adapts Bayesian optimization for discrete and high-dimensional spaces.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates reduced number of evaluations in optimizing an innovative hybrid aircraft concept.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a realistic aircraft design case study (DRAGON hybrid airplane).

title: Dimensionality reduction can be used as a surrogate model for high-dimensional forward uncertainty quantification
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过降维构建随机代理模型，可解决高维输入下的不确定性量化问题，对生物力学植入物设计中的高效采样和UQ有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, does not handle constraints, and lacks experimental validation in a biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维输入下传统代理模型效率低，需新方法。
summary_zh.method: 从输入-输出空间的降维结果中直接提取随机代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 在两类高维不确定性问题中验证了方法的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个数值基准问题验证。

summary_en.motivation: To construct a stochastic surrogate model for high-dimensional forward uncertainty quantification without sequential dimensionality reduction and surrogate modeling.
summary_en.method: The proposed method extracts a surrogate model directly from dimensionality reduction results in the joint input-output space, avoiding reconstruction mapping.
summary_en.result: The method is demonstrated on two uncertainty quantification problems with high-dimensional input uncertainties, showing comparable performance to sequential approaches.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on two numerical benchmark problems with high-dimensional inputs.

title: A Novel Paradigm in Solving Multiscale Problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多尺度解耦范式与谱PINN方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context, no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification, and no demonstration on solid mechanics or structural FEA problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效模拟多尺度动力学，降低计算成本
summary_zh.method: 提出解耦范式，用谱PINN表征小尺度系统
summary_zh.result: 在K-S方程和Navier-Stokes方程上验证了精度和效率
summary_zh.validation: 通过一维至三维流体动力学数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently simulate multiscale dynamics by decoupling large- and small-scale systems, reducing computational cost.
summary_en.method: A decoupling paradigm is proposed where large-scale dynamics are modeled independently and small-scale dynamics are approximated by a Spectral Physics-Informed Neural Network.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates accuracy and efficiency on the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation and 2D/3D Navier-Stokes equations, with extensions to non-uniform meshes and noisy data.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on canonical fluid dynamics problems, including one-dimensional to three-dimensional cases.

title: Interpretable Multi-Source Data Fusion Through Latent Variable Gaussian Process
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多源数据融合框架可迁移至生物力学代理模型，解决稀疏数据下的预测问题。
why_not_core: No validation on FEA surrogate or implant/biomechanics design; no uncertainty quantification or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有方法无法融合多源数据且忽略数据质量差异。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于潜变量高斯过程的多源数据融合框架，将数据源映射到可解释潜空间。
summary_zh.result: 在稀疏数据问题上，融合模型优于单源和无源感知模型。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数学和材料科学案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing methods fail to fuse multi-source data and ignore differences in data quality and comprehensiveness.
summary_en.method: A multi-source data fusion framework based on Latent Variable Gaussian Process (LVGP) maps data sources into a physically interpretable latent space.
summary_en.result: The proposed fusion model provides better predictions for sparse-data problems compared to single-source and source-unaware models.
summary_en.validation: Validated on two mathematical and two materials science case studies.

title: Densely Multiplied Physics Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的密集乘法PINN架构可提高求解PDE的精度，有望迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型。
why_not_core: No validation on FEA surrogate tasks, no biomedical or implant mechanics context, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高PINN求解非线性PDE的精度和效率。
summary_zh.method: 提出密集乘法PINN架构，将隐藏层输出与后续所有层输出相乘。
summary_zh.result: 在四个基准PDE上精度和效率均优于现有PINN结构。
summary_zh.validation: 在Allan-Cahn、Helmholtz、Burgers和1D对流方程上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and efficiency of physics-informed neural networks for solving nonlinear PDEs.
summary_en.method: Proposes a densely multiplied PINN architecture that multiplies the output of a hidden layer with outputs of all subsequent hidden layers without adding trainable parameters.
summary_en.result: The proposed architecture achieves superior accuracy and efficiency on four benchmark PDEs compared to existing PINN variants.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks including Allan-Cahn, Helmholtz, Burgers, and 1D convection equations.

title: Combining additivity and active subspaces for high-dimensional Gaussian process modeling
relevance_to_user: 该论文结合可加性和活性子空间方法，提出了一种高维高斯过程建模的多保真策略，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的高维输入问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant design problems, lacks constraint handling and multi-objective optimization, and does not demonstrate transferability to biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高维高斯过程建模中的维度灾难问题
summary_zh.method: 结合可加性和活性子空间，采用多保真策略进行高维GP建模
summary_zh.result: 在合成函数和数据集上展示了方法的优势
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the curse of dimensionality in Gaussian process regression for high-dimensional inputs.
summary_en.method: A multi-fidelity strategy combining additivity and active subspaces is proposed for high-dimensional GP modeling.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates improved performance on synthetic functions and benchmark datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using numerical benchmarks on synthetic functions and datasets.

title: Beyond State Space Representation: A General Theory for Kernel Packets
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种新的核包方法，可扩展高斯过程回归到大规模数据，对构建高效代理模型有潜在价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification beyond GP regression, or biomechanics/implant design applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 高斯过程回归在大规模应用中计算成本高，现有状态空间方法局限于网格数据且无法处理多维散点。
summary_zh.method: 提出核包框架，通过前向和后向状态空间表示识别紧支撑核包，实现线性时间训练和对数或常数时间预测。
summary_zh.result: 在百万级样本的加性和乘积形式GP上，核包方法实现了精确、内存高效的推理，优于SDE和低秩方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过大规模数值实验验证，对比SDE和低秩GP方法。

summary_en.motivation: Gaussian process regression suffers from high computational cost in large-scale applications, and existing state space methods are limited to gridded inputs and cannot handle multi-dimensional scattered data.
summary_en.method: This paper proposes a kernel packet framework that identifies compactly supported kernel packets via forward and backward state space representations, enabling exact inference with linear-time training and logarithmic or constant-time prediction.
summary_en.result: On large-scale additive and product-form GPs with millions of samples, the kernel packet method achieves exact, memory-efficient inference where SDE-based and low-rank GP methods fail.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic large-scale datasets compare the proposed method against SDE-based and low-rank GP approaches.

title: Standard Gaussian Process is All You Need for High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了标准高斯过程在高维贝叶斯优化中的表现，其方法可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification beyond point prediction, or biomechanics/implant design applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 质疑标准高斯过程在高维贝叶斯优化中性能不佳的普遍观点。
summary_zh.method: 通过系统基准测试和理论分析，比较不同核函数和初始化策略。
summary_zh.result: Matérn核优于平方指数核，且提出鲁棒初始化方法提升SE核性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在12个基准问题上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To challenge the long-held belief that standard Gaussian processes underperform in high-dimensional Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.method: Systematic benchmarking across twelve benchmarks and theoretical analysis comparing kernel functions and initialization strategies.
summary_en.result: Matérn kernels consistently outperform squared exponential kernels, and a robust initialization method significantly improves SE kernel performance.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on twelve benchmark optimization problems.

title: PINN-BO: A Black-box Optimization Algorithm using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该方法将物理信息神经网络与贝叶斯优化结合，提高了黑箱优化采样效率，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not validate on any biomedical or implant design problem, lacks uncertainty quantification beyond regret bounds, and does not address multi-objective or constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高黑箱优化在噪声和昂贵函数下的采样效率
summary_zh.method: 利用物理信息神经网络结合偏微分方程知识指导贝叶斯优化
summary_zh.result: 在多种优化任务上比现有方法更高效
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve sample efficiency of black-box optimization for noisy and expensive functions by incorporating domain knowledge from partial differential equations.
summary_en.method: Proposes PINN-BO, which integrates physics-informed neural networks into Bayesian optimization to leverage PDE information alongside function evaluations.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates tighter regret bounds theoretically and superior sample efficiency across various optimization benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark optimization tasks, comparing against standard Bayesian optimization and other baselines.

title: Learning solutions of parametric Navier-Stokes with physics-informed neural networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用PINN学习参数化Navier-Stokes方程的解，方法可迁移至生物力学中参数化FEA代理建模。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context; no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification; validation only on fluid dynamics benchmark.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN在高度非线性参数化PDE中收敛困难的问题
summary_zh.method: 将参数作为输入，在数值解上训练PINN，并加入PDE正则化
summary_zh.result: PINN比纯神经网络更准确地预测梯度，尤其是涡量场
summary_zh.validation: 在2D圆柱绕流问题上对不同雷诺数进行数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the convergence limitations of PINNs for highly nonlinear parametric PDEs like Navier-Stokes equations.
summary_en.method: Treat parameters as additional inputs and train PINNs on numerical solutions of parametric PDEs with PDE regularization in the loss.
summary_en.result: PINNs yield more accurate gradient predictions than conventional neural networks, particularly in vorticity fields.
summary_en.validation: Validated on the 2D flow past cylinder problem across a range of Reynolds numbers using numerical simulation data.

title: High-dimensional Bayesian Optimization via Covariance Matrix Adaptation Strategy
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的高维贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题，但未涉及约束处理或生物力学验证。
why_not_core: No constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and no application to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高维黑箱函数全局优化中贝叶斯优化效率低的问题
summary_zh.method: 利用协方差矩阵自适应策略划分局部搜索区域，结合现有贝叶斯优化器进行优化
summary_zh.result: 在多个合成和实际基准问题上优于现有方法
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准问题上进行性能对比

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of Bayesian optimization in high-dimensional expensive black-box functions.
summary_en.method: Proposes a meta-algorithm that uses covariance matrix adaptation to define local regions and incorporates existing BO optimizers for global optimization.
summary_en.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art methods on various benchmark synthetic and real-world problems.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on standard numerical benchmark problems.

visual.caption: Figure 1 : Illustration of the proposed CMA-based meta-algorithm. In step (1), a hyper-ellipsoid local region is initialized. In step (2), a BO optimizer (e.g., BO , TuRBO , BAxUS ) is used in this local region to collect a population of candidates (data points to be evaluated). In step (3), the local region is updated using the CMA technique. The process is conducted iteratively until the evaluation budget is depleted.

title: Functional SDE approximation inspired by a deep operator network architecture
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的SDEONet架构可用于不确定性量化，与用户对FEA代理模型中UQ的需求相关。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on SDE approximation rather than PDE-based FEA surrogate modeling, and does not address implant/biomechanics design or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决随机微分方程求解中采样效率低和维数灾难问题。
summary_zh.method: 基于DeepONet架构，利用多项式混沌展开学习稀疏截断的Wiener混沌展开。
summary_zh.result: 在1D和高维数值实验中展示了良好性能。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试验证收敛性和复杂度。

summary_en.motivation: To address the curse of dimensionality and sampling inefficiency in solving stochastic differential equations.
summary_en.method: Proposes SDEONet, a DeepONet-inspired architecture that learns a sparse truncation of the Wiener chaos expansion via polynomial chaos expansion.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates promising performance in 1D and higher-dimensional numerical experiments.
summary_en.validation: Convergence and complexity analysis supported by numerical benchmarks.

visual.caption: Figure 1: Sketch of the SDEONet action working on input G G (processed Brownian motion, left), approximation 𝒜 \mathcal{A} and reconstruction ℛ \mathcal{R} of the SDE solution (right).

title: Architectural Strategies for the optimization of Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了物理信息神经网络的架构优化策略，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, no implant or biomechanics application, only tested on standard PDE benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN训练困难问题，从架构角度优化。
summary_zh.method: 利用神经正切核分析激活函数，提出预条件神经网络架构。
summary_zh.result: 高斯激活函数优于其他激活，预条件架构提升优化效果。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准PDE基准上验证理论结果。

summary_en.motivation: To address the training difficulties of physics-informed neural networks by optimizing neural architecture.
summary_en.method: Leveraging the Neural Tangent Kernel to compare activation functions and proposing a preconditioned neural architecture based on numerical linear algebra insights.
summary_en.result: Gaussian activations outperform alternatives, and the preconditioned architecture enhances optimization.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical findings are validated on established PDE benchmarks from the literature.

title: Accelerating PDE Data Generation via Differential Operator Action in Solution Space
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种加速PDE数据生成的方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的训练数据生成。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant-related FEA problems; no uncertainty quantification; no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经算子需要大量高精度训练数据，生成成本高。
summary_zh.method: 提出DiffOAS算法，通过组合基本解并施加微分算子快速生成精确数据点。
summary_zh.result: 生成10000个实例的数据集加速300倍，仅用5%时间即可达到相当性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE基准上比较生成时间和神经算子训练性能。

summary_en.motivation: Neural operators require large high-precision training datasets, whose generation is computationally expensive.
summary_en.method: DiffOAS generates PDE data by combining a few basic solutions and applying differential operators to produce accurate data points efficiently.
summary_en.result: The method accelerates large-scale dataset generation by 300x, and neural operators trained on 5% of the generation time achieve comparable performance.
summary_en.validation: Validation on standard PDE benchmarks comparing generation time and neural operator training performance.

title: Vanilla Bayesian Optimization Performs Great in High Dimensions
relevance_to_user: 该论文改进了高维贝叶斯优化的性能，可迁移至代理模型辅助的植入物设计优化。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification beyond standard GP.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维贝叶斯优化性能差，现有方法复杂且限制多。
summary_zh.method: 提出缩放高斯过程长度尺度先验以降低模型复杂度。
summary_zh.result: 标准贝叶斯优化在高维任务中显著优于现有算法。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个常用高维真实世界任务上对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: High-dimensional Bayesian optimization suffers from the curse of dimensionality, and existing algorithms impose restrictive assumptions to mitigate this.
summary_en.method: A simple scaling of the Gaussian process lengthscale prior with dimensionality is proposed to reduce model complexity without structural restrictions.
summary_en.result: Standard Bayesian optimization with this modification drastically outperforms state-of-the-art algorithms on multiple real-world high-dimensional tasks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on commonly considered real-world high-dimensional optimization tasks.

title: Accelerating Look-ahead in Bayesian Optimization: Multilevel Monte Carlo is All you Need
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多级蒙特卡洛方法可加速贝叶斯优化中的嵌套期望计算，对代理模型辅助的植入物设计优化具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification for point predictions, or biomechanical implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 多步前瞻贝叶斯优化中嵌套期望的蒙特卡洛计算效率低
summary_zh.method: 利用多级蒙特卡洛方法加速嵌套期望和最大化计算
summary_zh.result: 达到规范蒙特卡洛收敛速率，独立于维度且无需平滑假设
summary_zh.validation: 在多个基准测试上数值验证

summary_en.motivation: Multi-step look-ahead Bayesian optimization suffers from expensive nested expectations and maximizations when computed via naive Monte Carlo.
summary_en.method: Multilevel Monte Carlo is leveraged to achieve the canonical Monte Carlo convergence rate for nested operations, improving computational efficiency.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves dimension-independent convergence without smoothness assumptions, verified on benchmark examples.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on several benchmark optimization problems demonstrate the benefits of MLMC for BO.

title: Challenges in Training PINNs: A Loss Landscape Perspective
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究PINN训练中的损失景观和优化策略，对提高代理模型训练效率有参考价值，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not handle constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 揭示PINN训练中损失景观导致的优化困难
summary_zh.method: 分析微分算子导致的病态条件，提出NysNewton-CG二阶优化器
summary_zh.result: Adam+L-BFGS组合优于单独优化器，NNCG显著提升性能
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE基准上数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To understand and mitigate training difficulties in Physics-Informed Neural Networks caused by ill-conditioned loss landscapes.
summary_en.method: Analyzed the connection between differential operators and loss ill-conditioning, and proposed a novel second-order optimizer NysNewton-CG (NNCG).
summary_en.result: The Adam+L-BFGS combination outperformed individual optimizers, and NNCG significantly improved PINN performance.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard PDE benchmarks with numerical experiments.

visual.caption: Figure 5: Absolute errors of the PINN solution at optimizer switch points. The first column shows errors after Adam, the second column shows errors after running L-BFGS following Adam, and the third column shows the errors after running NNCG folllowing Adam+L-BFGS. L-BFGS improves the solution obtained from first running Adam, and NNCG further improves the solution even after Adam+L-BFGS stops making progress. Note that Adam solution errors (left-most column) are presented at separate scales as these solutions are far off from the exact solutions.

title: Resolution invariant deep operator network for PDEs with complex geometries
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的分辨率不变算子网络可处理复杂几何上的PDE，对生物力学有限元代理建模具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant mechanics problems, no uncertainty quantification, and no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子要求输入输出空间域相同，限制了在复杂几何和边界条件映射上的应用。
summary_zh.method: 提出分辨率不变深度算子（RDO），解耦输入输出空间域，无需重新训练。
summary_zh.result: 在多种数值实验中，RDO优于DeepONet和FNO。
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准PDE数值基准测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operators require identical input and output spatial domains, limiting their applicability to problems with complex geometries and boundary condition mappings.
summary_en.method: A resolution-invariant deep operator (RDO) is proposed, decoupling input and output domains and eliminating the need for retraining when the domain changes.
summary_en.result: RDO outperforms DeepONet and FNO on various numerical PDE benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard numerical PDE benchmarks.

title: High temperature oxidation treated 3D printed anatomical WE43 alloy scaffolds for repairing periarticular bone defects:
first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics, Peking University Third Hospital, Beijing, 100191, China.; Engineering Research Center of Bone and Joint Precision Medicine, Ministry of Education, Beijing, 100191, China.

corresponding_authors.name: Yun Tian
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics, Peking University Third Hospital, Beijing, 100191, China.; Engineering Research Center of Bone and Joint Precision Medicine, Ministry of Education, Beijing, 100191, China.

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接涉及增材制造生物医用WE43镁合金支架的制备与体内外验证，与研究方向高度相关。
why_not_core: Does not explicitly quantify stress shielding reduction or fatigue behavior; focuses on corrosion resistance and biocompatibility of HTO-treated WE43 scaffolds.
